types.name: PasswordBehavior
types.summary: A single-line password field: Enter submits, line breaks are rejected, every codepoint renders as the mask character, copy/cut are blocked unless [[AllowCopy]], and native input uses secure entry. The stored text remains plain text; [[Revealed]] only changes its presentation.
attributes: TypeDescription("Single-line password: mask input; block copy; secure native keyboard")

properties.name: MaskChar
properties.summary: Glyph shown for every hidden character.
attributes: Tooltip("Single glyph shown for each hidden character (an emoji like 🔒 works). Only the first codepoint of a longer string is used — masking is one glyph per character.")

properties.name: AllowCopy
properties.summary: Whether copy and cut may expose the stored password.
attributes: Tooltip("Allow Copy/Cut of the value. Off (default) blocks it — the iOS/Android secure-field convention. Turn on for password-manager / reveal-and-copy flows.")

properties.name: Revealed
properties.summary: Show-password toggle for an "eye" control: when, the text renders unmasked. Affects only this layer's rendering — in native-overlay mode the OS field owns its own reveal. Does not change [[AllowCopy]].

types.name: PasteControlCornerStyle
types.summary: Apple UIPasteControl corner radius style (iOS 16+ only).

fields.name: Capsule
fields.summary: Fully rounded pill. Apple default, share-sheet aesthetic.

fields.name: Dynamic
fields.summary: Radius scales with OS-wide control-size setting.

fields.name: Fixed
fields.summary: Fixed radius regardless of OS settings.

fields.name: Small
fields.summary: Small radius — compact toolbar buttons.

types.name: PasteControlDisplayMode
types.summary: Apple UIPasteControl content style (iOS 16+ only).

fields.name: IconAndLabel
fields.summary: Clipboard glyph + localised "Paste" label. Apple default.

fields.name: IconOnly
fields.summary: Glyph only — compact toolbars (chat composer ribbon, etc.).

fields.name: LabelOnly
fields.summary: Localised "Paste" text only.

types.name: PlaceholderDecorator
types.summary: Shows a target while the field is empty and hides it once there is text. The classic placeholder.
attributes: TypeDescription("Show a target while the field is empty; hide it once text is entered")

properties.name: Target
properties.summary: Text object shown only while the edited document is empty.
attributes:
Tooltip("Object shown only while the field is empty. Set its text on the component itself. " +
                 "A platform-native field replica shows this text as its own placeholder.")

types.name: PlatformKeySemantics
types.summary: Runtime resolution of the host platform's keyboard convention — the single authority every shortcut consumer (platform key map, formatting commands, custom behaviors) reads instead of compile-time platform symbols. Detected once per session: macOS player/editor, iOS/iPadOS (hardware keyboards send Cmd), and WebGL running in a browser on an Apple OS all get Command semantics; everything else gets Control.

properties.name: PrimaryModifierIsCommand
properties.summary: Whether the primary shortcut modifier on this host is Command rather than Control.

properties.name: PrimaryModifier
properties.summary: The primary shortcut modifier bit for this host: Cmd on Apple platforms, Ctrl elsewhere.

types.name: ReferencedStyle
types.summary: Toggles whichever style the component carries for the chosen modifier type, in that style's own markup syntax. The optional parameter is passed to the rule, so a parameterised rule (an XML-like tag) writes it into the markup. Several styles share a modifier type — the first in resolution order wins.
attributes: TypeDescription("Apply a style on the component, by modifier")

properties.name: Modifier
properties.summary: Modifier signature used to resolve the configured component style.

properties.name: Parameter
properties.summary: Optional markup parameter passed when the style is toggled.

types.name: RestoreOnCancelBehavior
types.summary: Restores the focused-session text and releases input focus when editing is cancelled.
attributes: TypeDescription("Restore the focused-session text and release focus when editing is cancelled")

types.name: ReturnKeyType
types.summary: Return-key actions with defined iOS, Android, and Web mappings.
types.remarks: The key performs what it declares. A field that accepts line breaks spends the key on them, so it always shows the plain return key and its declared action reaches the native field presenter instead, which surfaces it as its own control. iOS-only labels are selected through [[IOSReturnKeyOverride]].

fields.name: Default
fields.summary: Done for a field that accepts no line breaks, the plain return key otherwise.

types.name: SelectAllOnFocusBehavior
types.summary: Selects all text when the editor gains focus and preserves it through the focusing pointer gesture.
attributes: TypeDescription("Select all text when the field gains focus")

types.name: SingleLineBehavior
types.summary: Single-line form-field semantics, matching the web <input> contract: every Enter press submits, newlines are stripped from all inserted text (typing, paste, IME commit — multi-line pastes are joined), and submit releases focus unless [[KeepFocusOnSubmit]]. Without it the editor is a document — Enter inserts a newline. Pair with the UniText's Word Wrap turned off for the classic horizontally-scrolling field.
attributes: TypeDescription("Single-line: Enter submits, newlines are stripped (form field)")

properties.name: KeepFocusOnSubmit
properties.summary: Whether focus survives submission.
attributes:
Tooltip("Keep focus after submit. Off (default) releases focus — the form-field convention; " +
                 "chat composers use SubmitKeyBehavior, which always keeps focus.")

types.name: SmartFeatureMode
types.summary: Tri-state policy for an iOS smart-input feature.

fields.name: Default
fields.summary: Follow the user's system preference (default).

fields.name: Yes
fields.summary: Force the feature on.

fields.name: No
fields.summary: Force the feature off.

types.name: SpellChecking
types.summary: Spell-checking policy requested from native text input.
types.remarks: Android maps [[Disabled]] to its combined no-suggestions behavior.

fields.name: Default
fields.summary: Use the user's system preference.

fields.name: Enabled
fields.summary: Force spell checking on.

fields.name: Disabled
fields.summary: Force spell checking off.

types.name: StripFormatOnPasteBehavior
types.summary: Drops one formatting modifier from pasted content even though the field renders it — paste a styled passage and this format alone arrives as plain text. Use when a field offers a format in its own UI but should not inherit it from the clipboard (e.g. keep authored colors, reject pasted ones). Formats the field has no style for are dropped already; this opts out one it does have.
attributes: TypeDescription("Drop one format from pasted content, keeping the text")

properties.name: Format
properties.summary: Modifier signature removed from attributed pasted content.
attributes: Tooltip("The modifier whose formatting is removed from pasted content.")

types.name: StyleStateHandler
types.summary: Edge-triggered toolbar-state handler: tracks whether typing now produces the configured style ([[IsStyleActive]] — pending typing styles win) and raises [[Changed]] only when the value flips, plus once with the initial state on attach.
attributes: TypeDescription("Style state: fires a bool when the configured style turns on/off at the caret")

properties.name: Style
properties.summary: Modifier signature whose active caret state is observed.
attributes: Tooltip("The modifier whose caret state drives the events.")

events.name: Changed
events.summary: Occurs when the configured style's caret state flips and once on attach.

types.name: SubmitKey
types.summary: Key combination that submits in [[SubmitKeyBehavior]].

fields.name: Enter
fields.summary: Enter submits; Shift+Enter inserts a newline (Slack / Discord default).

fields.name: ModifierEnter
fields.summary: Ctrl/Cmd+Enter submits; Enter inserts a newline.

types.name: SubmitKeyBehavior
types.summary: Binds the Enter key to submit instead of inserting a newline: [[Enter]] submits on Enter (Shift+Enter makes a newline), [[ModifierEnter]] submits on Ctrl/Cmd+Enter (Enter makes a newline). Fits chat composers, comment boxes, prompt and search fields alike. Focus survives submit by default; turn [[KeepFocusOnSubmit]] off for submit-and-close surfaces (comment forms, modal editors). For a field that accepts no newlines at all, use [[SingleLineBehavior]] instead.
attributes: TypeDescription("Bind Enter / Ctrl+Enter to submit instead of newline")

properties.name: Submit
properties.summary: Key combination that submits the editor.

properties.name: KeepFocusOnSubmit
properties.summary: Whether focus survives submission.
attributes:
Tooltip("Keep focus after submit. On (default): focus stays, composers keep typing. Off: " +
                 "release focus — for submit-and-close surfaces (comment forms, modal editors).")

types.name: SupportingTextDecorator
types.summary: Drives a text target with helper text, replacing it with the validation message and an error color while the field is invalid. The supporting-text slot of a form field.
attributes: TypeDescription("Helper text below the field that becomes the validation message on error")

properties.name: Target
properties.summary: Text component that displays helper or validation text.

properties.name: Helper
properties.summary: Guidance shown while the field has no validation error.
attributes: Tooltip("Guidance shown while the field is valid.")

properties.name: ErrorColor
properties.summary: Colour used while the field has a validation error.
attributes: Tooltip("Text color while the field is invalid.")

types.name: TabKeyBehavior
types.summary: Makes plain Tab insert a tab character instead of moving focus to the next control. Modified combinations (Shift+Tab, Ctrl+Tab) pass through for navigation. Add this for code editors and multi-line composers.
attributes: TypeDescription("Tab inserts a tab character instead of moving focus")

types.name: TextChangeReason
types.summary: Hierarchical reason string carried by [[DocumentChanged]]. Integrators switch on these to react differently to user typing vs paste vs programmatic mutation. Format is dotted-prefix so consumers can match by prefix: input.* is exclusively user-originated (so reason.StartsWith("input.") means "the user did this"), program.* is integrator code, sync.* is network / collaborative sync. Narrower prefixes refine further — e.g. reason.StartsWith("input.type") covers [[Type]] and [[TypeCompose]].

fields.name: Type
fields.summary: User-driven character input (keyboard, mobile keyboard, on-screen).

fields.name: TypeCompose
fields.summary: IME composition commit. Distinguish from plain [[Type]] for CJK/emoji autocorrect handling.

fields.name: Paste
fields.summary: Paste from system clipboard (Ctrl+V, context-menu, programmatic Paste).

fields.name: Delete
fields.summary: Deletion of an explicit range (selection) — no direction.

fields.name: DeleteBackward
fields.summary: Backward deletion from the caret — Backspace, word / line-start variants.

fields.name: DeleteForward
fields.summary: Forward deletion from the caret — Delete key, word / line-end variants.

fields.name: Cut
fields.summary: Cut to clipboard — copy followed by selection deletion.

fields.name: Drop
fields.summary: Drag-and-drop text insertion. Reserved; emitted when drop pipeline lands.

fields.name: Programmatic
fields.summary: Integrator-driven mutation via SetText / SetTextProgrammatic — not user input, hence outside input.*.

fields.name: Format
fields.summary: Autoformat conversion — typed markup replaced by its styling.

fields.name: Restore
fields.summary: Undo / Redo replay. User-visible restoration of a prior document state.

fields.name: Network
fields.summary: Network / collaborative-sync inbound — not user input, hence outside input.*. Reserved for P2.S.

types.name: TextFormattingBehavior
types.summary: User-driven formatting commands, each binding a style source ([[IFormatStyleSource]]) to an optional primary-modifier shortcut (Ctrl on Windows/Linux, Cmd on macOS). A command toggles its style on the selection, or as a typing style at a collapsed caret ([[ToggleStyle{T}]] semantics), in the syntax the resolved style's rule speaks. Toolbar buttons and context menus call [[Toggle]] / [[Toggle]]; button state comes from [[IsStyleActive{T}]] via [[CaretContextBehavior]]. Default commands: bold (B), italic (I), underline (U), clear formatting (\).

methods.name: Toggle
methods.summary: Toggles the command at index. Returns whether the style is now on.

methods.name: Toggle
methods.summary: Toggles the command named name (case-insensitive).

properties.name: ClearFormattingKey
properties.summary: Primary-modifier shortcut that clears formatting; None disables it.
attributes: Tooltip("Clear-formatting shortcut (primary modifier + key): strips every style from the selection; at a caret the next typed text is plain. None = no shortcut.")

properties.name: MarkupVisibility
properties.summary: How authored markup characters are exposed while editing.
attributes: Tooltip("How markup tags display: Hidden (styled, tags invisible), RevealActiveRange (tags show around the caret), Raw (tags always visible).")

properties.name: RichPaste
properties.summary: Whether structured clipboard formatting is accepted on paste.
attributes: Tooltip("Off: paste always inserts the clipboard's plain text — HTML/Markdown/UniText formatting from the source app is ignored.")

properties.name: PlainTextPaste
properties.summary: How plain clipboard text is interpreted by the markup parser.
attributes: Tooltip("How plain-text paste is interpreted: Auto (by tag visibility — Raw parses, else literal), Literal (verbatim), Parse (as this field's markup).")

properties.name: TypingMarkup
properties.summary: Whether markup typed by the user is parsed or inserted literally.
attributes: Tooltip("How hand-typed markup is treated: Parse (typed <b> styles), Literal (typed <b> stays literal text). Commands, programmatic styling and paste are unaffected.")

properties.name: ArrowKeyEscape
properties.summary: Whether a repeated outward arrow clears retained typing formatting.
attributes: Tooltip("A repeated outward arrow at a formatting boundary clears an explicitly retained typing context. Range edges are outside formatting by default.")

types.name: TextLengthUnit
types.summary: How text length is measured. The user-facing default is [[Graphemes]] — what a person counts as one character (a family emoji, an accented letter) — unlike codepoints or UTF-16 units, which can be higher than expected.

fields.name: Graphemes
fields.summary: User-perceived characters (UAX #29 grapheme clusters). A ZWJ emoji or base + combining mark counts as one.

fields.name: Utf16Units
fields.summary: UTF-16 code units — matches string.Length in C#/JS/Java, for parity with such a backend.

fields.name: Utf8Bytes
fields.summary: UTF-8 bytes — for a field backed by a byte-sized DB column or wire field.

fields.name: Codepoints
fields.summary: Unicode codepoints (scalar values). Surrogate-safe, but still splits emoji/ZWJ sequences.

types.name: TextMeasure
types.summary: Measures and truncates text by [[TextLengthUnit]]. Truncation cuts only on a codepoint or grapheme boundary, so it never splits a surrogate pair, a multi-byte codepoint, or a grapheme cluster.

methods.name: Count
methods.summary: Length of text in unit.

methods.name: Count
methods.summary: Length of the whole document in unit. Measures the document SOURCE — in a markup-bearing field hidden tag characters count too; keep limits and counters on plain fields, or accept that they measure source, not the visible projection. For the per-keystroke grapheme path prefer [[GraphemeCountCache]].

methods.name: CountRange
methods.summary: Length of the document's codepoint range [startCodepoint, startCodepoint + codepointCount) in unit.

methods.name: TruncatedCharLength
methods.summary: Char count of the longest prefix of text whose length in unit is at most budget, cut on a boundary. Pass the result to Substring.

types.name: TypingMarkupPolicy
types.summary: Whether markup the user types by hand is recognized or kept literal. Applies to direct keyboard / IME editing of that text; formatting commands, programmatic styling, inline objects, and paste are unaffected.

fields.name: Parse
fields.summary: Typed markup is parsed into styles (default): x renders bold.

fields.name: Literal
fields.summary: Typed markup triggers are escaped to literal text: x stays visible characters.

types.name: UniTextEditable
types.summary: Editing capability for [[UniTextSelectable]]: text storage (gap buffer), undo/redo, IME composition, validators, caret rendering, input intents, touch gesture pipeline, keyboard / clipboard handling, and the public mutation API (InsertText, Cut/Copy/Paste, Undo/Redo, etc.).
types.remarks: The component requires [[UniTextSelectable]] on the same GameObject as [[UniTextBase]]; form-field policies are composed through input behaviors. Add a [[ContentSizeFitter]] or place it under a layout group to size its RectTransform from the text; sizing is measured through the [[UniTextBase]] component's own [[ILayoutElement]] implementation. A pointer click activates it and places the caret; Unity UI navigation reaches it through the hidden [[UniTextFocusable]] the editor manages automatically. Put it directly under a [[RectMask2D]] to make that parent the clipping viewport and enable internal scrolling when content overflows.

methods.name: CopyTextTo
methods.summary: Copies the currently navigable editing view into a caller-provided buffer. Returns the number of UTF-16 units written without allocating; use [[Text]] for serialized markup.

methods.name: TextEquals
methods.summary: Compares the currently navigable editing view to a known string without allocation.

methods.name: TextEquals
methods.summary: Compares the currently navigable editing view to a known string without allocation.

methods.name: GetBehavior
methods.summary: Returns the first attached behavior of type T, or.

methods.name: GetBehaviors
methods.summary: Appends every attached behavior of type T (local then preset) to results.

methods.name: SetText
methods.summary: Replaces the entire text content, resetting selection and undo history and discarding any in-progress composition.

methods.name: SetTextProgrammatic
methods.summary: Replaces the text from a non-user source (network sync, state restoration, remote collaboration), discarding any in-progress composition first.

params.name: value
params.description: The text to set. is treated as empty.

params.name: recordUndo
params.description: When, the swap is recorded as a single Replace entry the user can undo / redo. When (default), the swap itself is not recorded and preserveHistory decides what happens to existing history.

params.name: preserveHistory
params.description: Only meaningful with recordUndo. Default () clears the undo history — positions recorded against the old text are meaningless against the new one. rebases entry positions through the swap's minimal diff shape instead; entries overlapping the changed region are dropped (with their far side of the undo pointer, keeping the replay chain contiguous). Because the diff factors out the common prefix/suffix, a network echo that only appends or edits elsewhere keeps the user's local history — a whole-document rewrite drops everything, which is the honest semantics.

params.name: reason
params.description: [[TextChangeReason]] reported to [[DocumentChanged]]; = [[Programmatic]]. Collaborative integrators pass [[Network]] to distinguish their own writes.

methods.name: MoveCaretTo
methods.summary: Programmatically moves the caret to codepointIndex (clamped).

methods.name: Select
methods.summary: Programmatically selects the range [start, end] (clamped).

methods.name: ClearUndoHistory
methods.summary: Clears the undo/redo history.

methods.name: Activate
methods.summary: Activates the editor, optionally requests a soft keyboard, and makes the caret visible. Queues the request while another editor is still releasing its input source.

methods.name: Deactivate
methods.summary: Begins releasing the current editing session and completes after its input source has quiesced. The editor remains active until completion; repeated requests are idempotent.

methods.name: Defocus
methods.summary: Releases input focus the canonical way: clears the EventSystem selection when this editor holds it (which deactivates via OnDeselect), otherwise deactivates directly.

methods.name: OnAttachedToCell
methods.summary: Invoked by a virtualised list host (Android RecyclerView, iOS UITableView, Unity scroll-pool, custom) when this editor's GameObject is recycled into a new cell position. Re-arms input lazily on the next focus. The owning component is expected to call [[RestoreState]] first when state needs to be preserved across reuse.

methods.name: OnDetachedFromCell
methods.summary: Releases editing state and invokes completion when the object may be safely recycled by its virtualised-list host.

exceptions.description: completion is null.

methods.name: RefreshMarkup
methods.summary: Re-renders after a [[MarkupChrome]] mutation.

methods.name: InsertText
methods.summary: Inserts text at the current caret position, replacing any active selection. Convenience overload that accepts a string. See [[InsertText]].

params.name: text
params.description: The text to insert. Null or empty strings are ignored.

methods.name: InsertText
methods.summary: Inserts text at the current caret position, replacing any active selection. Applies the configured input-filter chain and records the accepted edit for undo.

params.name: text
params.description: The text to insert. Empty spans are ignored.

methods.name: DeletePrevious
methods.summary: Deletes the current selection or the grapheme cluster before the caret.

methods.name: DeleteNext
methods.summary: Deletes the grapheme cluster after the caret, or deletes the current selection. Equivalent to the Delete key. Document-space cluster resolution — see [[DeletePrevious]].

methods.name: DeleteSelection
methods.summary: Deletes the currently selected text range and collapses the selection to the start of the deleted range. Does nothing if there is no selection.

methods.name: DeleteWordPrevious
methods.summary: Deletes from the caret to the previous word boundary, or deletes the selection. Equivalent to Ctrl+Backspace (Windows) / Option+Backspace (macOS).

methods.name: DeleteWordNext
methods.summary: Deletes from the caret to the next word boundary, or deletes the selection. Equivalent to Ctrl+Delete (Windows) / Option+Delete (macOS).

methods.name: DeleteToLineStart
methods.summary: Deletes from the caret to the start of the current line. Equivalent to Cmd+Backspace (macOS).

methods.name: DeleteToLineEnd
methods.summary: Deletes from the caret to the end of the current line. Equivalent to Ctrl+K (macOS Emacs kill-line).

methods.name: TransposeCharacters
methods.summary: Swaps the two grapheme clusters before the caret. If the caret is at position 0, does nothing. If the caret is at position 1 (only one cluster before it), does nothing. Equivalent to Ctrl+T (macOS Emacs transpose-chars).
methods.remarks: Outer boundaries stick outward (first [[Before]], second [[After]]) so each cluster carries its own adjacent formatting tags through the swap; the shared inner boundary sticks [[Before]] on both sides so the two source ranges stay contiguous.

methods.name: Copy
methods.summary: Copies the selected text to the system clipboard. Does nothing if there is no selection or if the field is in password mode. Walks every built-in clipboard adapter and writes the resulting items as one atomic multi-format clipboard transaction (plain text + custom UniText format + optional HTML / Markdown), so the consumer's paste picks the richest format it understands. When the selection's markup is visible to the user — Raw, or a revealed range under [[RevealActiveRange]] — the copy carries only that visible text as plain text and no semantic channels: what is on screen is what pastes.

methods.name: Cut
methods.summary: Cuts the selected text to the system clipboard (copy + delete selection). Does nothing if there is no selection or if the field is in password mode.

methods.name: Paste
methods.summary: Pastes text from the system clipboard at the current caret position, replacing any active selection. Probes the built-in clipboard adapters by [[Priority]] descending — a cheap [[HasFormat]] availability check, then one payload transfer, then deserialize; the first success wins, so only one format ever crosses the clipboard. UniText source (lossless custom format) wins over HTML / Markdown, which win over plain text. The adapter resolves the payload to visible text and destination formatting spans, then inserts both in one document transaction. A format transfers only when the field has a style that renders it; unmatched formatting degrades to plain text. Plain text inserts verbatim.
methods.remarks: Applies a hard upper bound on paste size to prevent out-of-memory conditions: a safety cap of 1,000,000 characters before insertion. Any attached [[LengthLimitBehavior]] then truncates to the real limit. This prevents [[EnsureCapacity]] from doubling to 128MB+ when an extremely large clipboard payload (e.g. 100MB+ log file) is pasted.

methods.name: PastePlain
methods.summary: Pastes the plain-text clipboard channel only, ignoring rich formats — the paste-without-formatting command (Ctrl+Shift+V / Shift+Cmd+V).

methods.name: PasteAsync
methods.summary: Async variant of [[Paste]]. Required on WebGL for programmatic paste (toolbar icon, context menu, autofill). This is the batched collect-all read: every requested format arrives in ONE underlying clipboard access via [[GetItemsAsync]] (WebGL's single-user-activation rule allows exactly one read); must be awaited from a user-activation context on WebGL. A provider without the async seam degrades to the sync [[Paste]] probe. Runs the same pipeline, including the [[MediaReceived]] hook.

methods.name: PastePlainAsync
methods.summary: Async variant of [[PastePlain]] — the WebGL-safe paste-without-formatting command. Same activation-context contract as [[PasteAsync]].

methods.name: PasteFromItems
methods.summary: Pastes pre-extracted clipboard items through the adapter pipeline, bypassing [[Provider]]. Used by iOS UIPasteControl and drag-drop drop sites to avoid a second pasteboard read (which on iOS would surface the system permission prompt). A format transfers only when the field has a style that renders it.

methods.name: Undo
methods.summary: Undoes the most recent edit (a whole transaction group counts as one edit) and restores the pre-edit selection (anchor / focus / affinity).

methods.name: Redo
methods.summary: Redoes the most recently undone edit (a whole transaction group counts as one edit), placing the caret at the end of the re-applied text.

methods.name: SelectAll
methods.summary: Selects the entire text content (anchor = 0, focus = codepointCount).

methods.name: ApplyStyleRange
methods.summary: Applies T to the visible codepoint range. Undoable.

methods.name: SetStyle
methods.summary: The single style-edit primitive over the document range: applies the modifier (on = true) or removes it. Apply, remove, toggle, and clear all route here. A null exemplar with on false clears every recognised style.

methods.name: ApplyStyle
methods.summary: Applies T with parameter to the selection, or stores it as the pending typing style at a collapsed caret (SET semantics for value pickers).

methods.name: RemoveStyleRange
methods.summary: Removes T's tags from the codepoint range. Undoable.

methods.name: ToggleStyle
methods.summary: Toggles T on the selection — wraps when any part is unstyled, strips when fully styled. With a collapsed caret, flips the pending typing style. Returns whether on.

methods.name: ToggleStyle
methods.summary: Toggles the component's style matching exemplar (by modifier signature — a composite matches its ordered child types) on the selection, or the pending typing style at a caret. No-op when the component has no matching style with a wrappable rule. Returns whether on.

methods.name: ClearFormatting
methods.summary: Strips every style tag from the selection (clear-formatting), or resets typing styles at a collapsed caret so the next inserted text is plain. At a range edge, the default typing context is already outside; an explicitly retained context is cleared as one set.

methods.name: InsertObject
methods.summary: Inserts an inline object styled by T at the caret — a self-closing tag when the component has a tag style for it, otherwise a bare Object Replacement Character.

methods.name: RequestDefocusAfterSubmit
methods.summary: Called by a submit-defining behavior during [[Submitted]] dispatch to release focus once the dispatch completes — deferred so every subscriber observes a still-focused editor regardless of subscription order.

methods.name: IsStyleActive
methods.summary: Whether typing now would produce T-styled text — the toolbar state query: a pending typing style wins, otherwise the spans at the caret decide.

methods.name: IsStyleActive
methods.summary: Whether typing now would produce text matching exemplar's style (by modifier signature — a composite matches its ordered child types). A pending typing style wins; otherwise the spans at the caret decide.

methods.name: TryGetStyleParameter
methods.summary: The parameter the active T style carries at the caret / selection — the color-swatch query for toolbars. A pending typing style wins; otherwise the covering span's parameter is returned. when the style is not active.

methods.name: TryGetStyleParameter
methods.summary: The parameter the active style matching exemplar carries at the caret / selection — the color-swatch query for toolbars. A pending typing style wins; otherwise the covering span's parameter is returned. when the style is not active or its value is mixed.

methods.name: SetValidation
methods.summary: Sets the validation state and fires [[ValidationChanged]]. The editor only holds the state; what to validate and when lives in an [[AutoValidateBehavior]] or app code (set [[Pending]] while an async check runs, then the result).

methods.name: HandleScroll
methods.summary: Handles mouse wheel scroll. Arrives through the editor's own [[IScrollHandler]]; custom gesture pipelines call directly. No-op standalone (no clipping viewport) or while the content fits the viewport.

methods.name: GetCaretScreenPosition
methods.summary: Screen-space caret position for codepointIndex (document space) — bottom picks the caret rect's bottom or top edge. The geometry query selection-UI implementations ([[ISelectionHandles]], [[IMagnifier]], system toolbars) issue against [[ActiveEditor]] to place themselves.

properties.name: CaretRenderer
properties.summary: Renderer used for the blinking caret.
attributes: Tooltip("Caret renderer for the blinking cursor. If null, one is created on first activation. Subclass InputCaretRenderer for custom shapes (block cursor, underline, gradient).")

properties.name: InputFilter
properties.summary: Hook: veto or rewrite any document mutation before it applies — typing, paste, IME commit, deletions, cut, transpose. Not consulted for in-progress IME composition, undo/redo replay, or programmatic [[Text]] writes. Hooks run by ascending order, each seeing the previous one's result; equal orders retain subscription order and [[Rejected]] is sticky. Behaviors subscribe in their OnEnable.

properties.name: KeyResolver
properties.summary: Ordered hook for contributing a key-to-action binding before the platform key map. Lower orders resolve first; after one sets an action, later hooks must preserve it.

properties.name: KeyboardResolver
properties.summary: Ordered hook for composing keyboard configuration each time the soft keyboard is shown. Lower orders contribute first; equal orders retain subscription order.

properties.name: LengthLimit
properties.summary: Length cap published by the enforcing behavior ([[LengthLimitBehavior]]) for counters to display; [[Max]] 0 = none. Read-only for consumers — enforcement and configuration live on the behavior, and it republishes on every edit, so an external write here would neither cap input nor survive.

properties.name: Selectable
properties.summary: Sibling selection component on the same GameObject. Resolved once via [[GetComponent{T}]]; [[RequireComponent]] guarantees presence.

properties.name: Selection
properties.summary: Current caret or selection range.

properties.name: TextComponent
properties.summary: Text component whose document this editor mutates.

properties.name: CodepointCount
properties.summary: Number of codepoints in the currently navigable editing view: visible document in Hidden, synthesized source in Raw or Reveal.

properties.name: CharCount
properties.summary: Number of UTF-16 units in the currently navigable editing view.

properties.name: Version
properties.summary: Monotonic document version incremented after committed edits.

properties.name: Text
properties.summary: Serialized source representation of the attributed document. Setting imports configured markup; getting preserves the imported source byte-for-byte until an edit and otherwise exports current spans.

properties.name: VisibleText
properties.summary: Visible document text without serialized markup, independent of the current markup presentation mode.

properties.name: CaretPosition
properties.summary: Caret position (codepoint index). Equivalent to Selection.Focus.

properties.name: SelectionStart
properties.summary: Selection start (codepoint index, inclusive).

properties.name: SelectionEnd
properties.summary: Selection end (codepoint index, exclusive).

properties.name: SelectedText
properties.summary: Currently selected text. Allocates a string. Empty when no selection.

properties.name: ReadOnly
properties.summary: Read-only mode. Text can be selected and copied but not edited.

properties.name: ArrowKeyEscapesFormatting
properties.summary: Whether a repeated outward arrow at a formatting boundary clears an explicitly retained typing context. Off unless published by [[TextFormattingBehavior]].

properties.name: IsActive
properties.summary: True while the editor is active, including while its input source is completing release.

properties.name: IsComposing
properties.summary: True while an IME composition (marked text) is in progress.

properties.name: CanUndo
properties.summary: True when an undo step is available.

properties.name: CanRedo
properties.summary: True when a redo step is available.

properties.name: ActiveEditor
properties.summary: Currently active editor across the application — THE "current editor" authority. Selection UI ([[ISelectionHandles]] / [[IInsertionHandle]], [[IMagnifier]], [[ITextContextMenu]]) pulls geometry and document state from here at call time — implementations are never bound to a specific field, so they can never render against a stale one. Set on [[Activate]], cleared when [[Deactivate]] completes.

properties.name: MarkupVisibility
properties.summary: How this field presents its markup tags — hidden and atomic (default), revealed around the caret, or shown as raw source. Replaces the former AutoConvert flag.

properties.name: MarkupChrome
properties.summary: Rules styling the markup tag characters wherever they are visible — every tag under [[Raw]], the caret's tags under [[RevealActiveRange]]. Each rule's [[Selector]] picks which markup it targets; rules of different modifier kinds compose, same-kind rules resolve by specificity. Call [[RefreshMarkup]] after mutating at runtime.

properties.name: PlainTextPaste
properties.summary: How plain-text paste is interpreted: [[Literal]] inserts it verbatim, [[Parse]] reparses it as this field's markup, [[Auto]] (default) picks by [[MarkupVisibility]].

properties.name: RichPaste
properties.summary: Whether paste reads the formatting channels (UniText source, HTML, Markdown). Off — every paste inserts the clipboard's plain text only, regardless of what the source app offers.

properties.name: TypingMarkup
properties.summary: Whether hand-typed markup is parsed or kept literal — see [[TypingMarkupPolicy]]. Default [[Parse]].

properties.name: ModifiersAtCaret
properties.summary: Modifiers currently covering the caret / selection. Reused list — copy to keep.

properties.name: Validation
properties.summary: Current content-validity state — written by validators (via [[AutoValidateBehavior]]) or app code through [[SetValidation]], read by field decorators.

events.name: MediaReceived
events.summary: Hook: consume media — a paste, a drag-and-drop, or a picker selection — before the text-adapter pipeline. Behaviors subscribe in their OnEnable; see [[MediaInputBehavior]].

events.name: EditApplied
events.summary: Occurs synchronously after a committed edit and before the frame-coalesced [[TextChanged]] event.

events.name: TextChanged
events.summary: Occurs when document text or attributed ranges change. Read the navigable view without allocation through [[CharCount]], [[CopyTextTo]], and [[TextEquals]]; read serialized markup through [[Text]].

events.name: ValueChanged
events.summary: Occurs when document text or attributed ranges change. Provides the full serialized source string and allocates only when subscribed.

events.name: DocumentChanged
events.summary: Occurs when the text content has changed, alongside [[TextChanged]], with the originating [[TextChangeReason]] string — distinguishes user typing (input.type) from paste (input.paste), programmatic mutation (program.set), IME commit (input.type.compose), and undo/redo replay (input.restore). Everything under input.* is user-originated.

events.name: Submitted
events.summary: Occurs when the user has submitted. Enter inserts a newline by default — a submit-resolving behavior defines what submits: [[SingleLineBehavior]] (Enter, form field) or [[SubmitKeyBehavior]] (Enter or Ctrl/Cmd+Enter, composer). Gamepad submit (EventSystem) also fires this. Carries the current text snapshot. Post-submit focus is the submit-defining behavior's policy — both carry KeepFocusOnSubmit with archetype defaults: [[SingleLineBehavior]] releases focus (form), [[SubmitKeyBehavior]] keeps it (composer); without one, focus stays.

events.name: Cancelled
events.summary: Occurs when the user has cancelled editing — Escape (desktop), system back (mobile). The editor does not deactivate automatically; add [[DefocusOnCancelBehavior]] or subscribe directly when cancellation should release focus. Android delivers the back key only where the platform routes it to the app: an app opted into OnBackInvokedCallback dispatch (Unity's Predictive Back Support), and Android 13/14 while the keyboard is showing, dismiss the keyboard without raising this.

events.name: Focused
events.summary: Occurs when the editor has gained input focus (activated) — by pointer, navigation, or programmatic select.

events.name: Defocused
events.summary: Occurs when the editor has lost input focus (deactivated), carrying how the session concluded. [[Submitted]] and [[Cancelled]] report the user's intent while editing continues; this reports the end itself.

events.name: SelectionChanged
events.summary: Frame-coalesced selection-change notification. Parameters: (selectionStart, selectionEnd) in codepoint indices. Fires at most once per frame after [[SelectionChanged]] mutations have settled.

events.name: CompositionStateChanged
events.summary: Occurs when IME composition state changes — fires on start, on commit or cancel.

events.name: CaretContextChanged
events.summary: Occurs (frame-coalesced) when the set of modifiers covering the caret / selection has changed — on caret movement, selection change, or reflow — and when a pending typing style flips (re-query [[IsStyleActive{T}]]). Subscribe from an [[InputBehavior]] or see [[CaretContextBehavior]] for the inspector-wired form.

events.name: ValidationChanged
events.summary: Occurs when [[Validation]] has changed.

types.name: UniTextFocusable
types.summary: Navigation / focus primitive for an interactive UniText surface — the EventSystem tab stop that lets the GameObject hold focus. Created and owned at runtime (hidden, not serialized) by [[Sync]]; never added manually.

types.name: UniTextPasteControl
types.summary: Cross-platform Paste widget. On iOS 16+ overlays a native UIPasteControl on top of this RectTransform (bypasses the system paste-permission prompt). Elsewhere triggers [[Paste]] through an optional sibling/child Button.

methods.name: TriggerPaste
methods.summary: Programmatic paste through [[Paste]]. On iOS 16+ outside a user-action context this surfaces the system prompt — prefer the native overlay (real tap) on that OS.

properties.name: Target
properties.summary: Editable text receiving pasted content.

properties.name: FallbackButton
properties.summary: Unity button used when a native paste control is unavailable.

properties.name: DisplayMode
properties.summary: Content displayed by the native iOS paste control.

properties.name: CornerStyle
properties.summary: Corner treatment used by the native iOS paste control.

events.name: Pasted
events.summary: Occurs when a paste has succeeded (native overlay tap or fallback click).

types.name: ValidationState
types.summary: Validation state of a field — an open [[Status]] token (empty = valid) plus a human-readable [[Message]]. Held on [[UniTextEditable]], set by validators or app code, read by decorators.

properties.name: Status
properties.summary: Open status token; empty when valid. See [[ValidationStatus]] for common values.

properties.name: Message
properties.summary: Human-readable reason a supporting-text decorator shows.

properties.name: IsValid
properties.summary: True when [[Status]] is empty.

types.name: ValidationStatus
types.summary: Well-known [[Status]] tokens. The status is an open string — a project may use its own (e.g. "warning", "available") and have decorators react to it; these are just the common ones.

fields.name: Pending
fields.summary: Asynchronous validation is in flight; the result is not yet known.

types.name: ColorFontCore
types.summary: Runtime for a color font (CBDT/sbix bitmap or COLRv0/COLRv1 vector). Plain [[Core]] subclass — not a ScriptableObject; constructable on worker threads. Owns the color-glyph rasterization pipeline: color-format detection, FreeType/Blend2D rendering into the shared color atlas, and color glyph metrics. The system emoji font ([[EmojiFont]]) and the [[UniTextColorFont]] asset are both built on this base. A glyph an effect decorates also gets a silhouette field in the SDF atlas, derived from the same bitmap's alpha when it is packed.

methods.name: CreateFromPath
methods.summary: Creates a color-font runtime from a font file path (.ttf,.ttc,.otf).

methods.name: LoadFromPath
methods.summary: Maps a font file and loads it into this runtime. Returns false if the file cannot be opened or decoded. Shared by the system emoji font and the color-font factory.

methods.name: CreateFromData
methods.summary: Creates a color-font runtime from raw font file bytes. Detects the colour format (sbix, CBDT, COLRv0/v1) and picks the closest bitmap strike to pixelSize.

methods.name: LoadFromData
methods.summary: Loads and configures this runtime from raw font bytes: detects the colour format (sbix, CBDT, COLRv0/v1), picks the closest bitmap strike to pixelSize, builds face metrics, and creates the shared color atlas. Returns false when the bytes cannot be loaded. Shared by the system emoji font and the color-font asset.

methods.name: HasGlyphInAtlas
methods.summary: Returns whether the shared color atlas contains the glyph.

methods.name: FitBitmapToAtlas
methods.summary: Downscales a bitmap larger than the atlas content size in place (pooled buffers swapped), preserving its aspect.

methods.name: ComputeGlyphMetrics
methods.summary: Design-unit metrics of a rendered bitmap. The bitmap's pixel-to-design ratio follows the colour format: the COLRv1 render size, the sbix strike, the CBDT advance, or the requested pixel size.

methods.name: Dispose
methods.summary: Releases color-renderer face pools together with the base runtime's shaping, FreeType and atlas resources.

methods.name: DisposeFacePool
methods.summary: Releases the parallel color-renderer pool and the shared sequential FreeType face when it currently represents this font.

properties.name: AtlasSize
properties.summary: Color atlas page side in pixels (square).

properties.name: ColorPixelSize
properties.summary: Pixel size at which color glyphs are rasterised.

properties.name: DiagnosticNamePrefix
properties.summary: Diagnostic name prefix for this runtime's [[Name]]. Lets the system emoji font keep its own label.

properties.name: FontDataHash
properties.summary: Process-unique runtime identity used by the shared color atlas and shaper registries.

fields.name: DefaultSize
fields.summary: Default color-glyph pixel size — 128 on desktop/mobile, 64 on WebGL.

types.name: EmojiFont
types.summary: Platform system emoji provider. Owns the primary face and any platform fallback faces required by individual emoji clusters.
types.remarks: On iOS the face is opaque; a valid instance has no raw [[FontData]].

methods.name: EnsureInitialized
methods.summary: Forces eager creation of [[Instance]].

exceptions.description: The platform-selected system emoji face cannot be initialized.

methods.name: GetCachedInstanceId
methods.summary: The emoji font is keyed in the resolution chain by its reserved [[FontId]], not its byte hash.

properties.name: Disabled
properties.summary: Global toggle for emoji rendering. Setting invalidates the codepoint cache and raises [[DisableChanged]].

properties.name: Instance
properties.summary: Primary system emoji runtime. Auto-creates on first access and returns null when disabled or unavailable.

properties.name: IsAvailable
properties.summary: Gets whether emoji rendering is available on this platform, initializing the system face when needed.

fields.name: FontId
fields.summary: Reserved font ID for the primary system emoji face (-1).

events.name: DisableChanged
events.summary: Occurs when the [[Disabled]] property has changed.

types.name: SystemEmojiFont
types.summary: Utility for locating file-addressable system emoji fonts across platforms.
types.remarks: Provides automatic file-path detection of color emoji fonts on: Windows: Segoe UI Emoji (seguiemj.ttf) macOS: Apple Color Emoji (.ttc) Android: NotoColorEmoji, Samsung/Huawei vendor fonts (via fonts.xml or API) Linux: Noto Color Emoji, Symbola On iOS, system emoji is exposed only as an opaque native face and has no font-file path. In the Unity Editor, also searches for emoji fonts in the EmojiCore/Editor folder.

methods.name: GetDefaultEmojiFont
methods.summary: Gets the path to the default system emoji font for the current platform.
methods.remarks: In Editor, first checks EmojiCore/Editor folder for bundled fonts. Validates fonts by checking for color glyph support and basic emoji (U+1F600). On iOS, the system emoji face is available only through the native emoji runtime, so this method returns null.
methods.returns: Full path to the emoji font file, or null if not found.

types.name: AxisDefault
types.summary: One variable-font axis pinned to a custom default value, keyed by its OpenType tag (4-char tag packed big-endian, same bits as the HarfBuzz uint tag).

types.name: Core
types.summary: Plain runtime for a font: owns face access, glyph tables, lookup dictionaries, curve cache and atlas pipeline. Constructable on worker threads (no Unity object lifecycle). Dispose instances constructed directly; a [[UniTextFont]] owns and disposes the runtime exposed by its asset.

methods.name: Core
methods.summary: Constructs an independently owned runtime from font bytes and the rendering settings normally supplied by the [[UniTextFont]] wrapper. The byte array is shared without copying and must not be modified while the runtime is alive. Safe to call from worker threads; the caller must dispose it.

methods.name: ReadFontDefinition
methods.summary: Rebuilds the runtime glyph and character lookup tables.

methods.name: HasGlyphInAtlas
methods.summary: Returns whether the glyph has an entry in the selected distance-field atlas for this font's default variation.

methods.name: Dispose
methods.summary: Releases font faces, outline sources, curve caches, batch buffers, atlas entries and styled fallback clones, and unregisters from the live registry. Idempotent.

properties.name: FontData
properties.summary: Creates a managed snapshot of the complete raw font file.

properties.name: FontDataHash
properties.summary: Process-unique runtime identity, so distinct font sources and faces can never alias in shaping or atlas registries.

properties.name: RawFontDataHash
properties.summary: Raw bytes-derived hash. Subclasses override to forward to their bytes source.

properties.name: Name
properties.summary: Worker-thread-safe display name (mirrors [[CachedName]]).

properties.name: GlyphLookupTable
properties.summary: (varHash48, glyphIndex) → atlas-resident glyph. Lazy-built on first access.

types.name: FaceInfo
types.summary: Font face metrics from OpenType/TrueType tables. All metric values are in font design units unless noted otherwise.

fields.name: faceIndex
fields.summary: Index of this face within a font collection (TTC).

fields.name: familyName
fields.summary: Font family name from the name table.

fields.name: styleName
fields.summary: Font style name (Regular, Bold, Italic, etc.).

fields.name: weightClass
fields.summary: CSS font-weight value from OS/2 usWeightClass (1-1000). 0 if unavailable.

fields.name: isItalic
fields.summary: Whether this font face is italic (from FreeType style_flags).

fields.name: unitsPerEm
fields.summary: Font design units per em (typically 1000 for CFF, 2048 for TrueType).

fields.name: lineHeight
fields.summary: Distance between consecutive baselines, from the metric pair FreeType selects: typo when the font sets USE_TYPO_METRICS ([[useTypoMetrics]]), otherwise hhea.

fields.name: ascentLine
fields.summary: Baseline to top of the tallest glyph, positive. Typo ascender when the font sets USE_TYPO_METRICS, otherwise hhea ascender.

fields.name: capLine
fields.summary: Top of capital letters (OS/2 sCapHeight).

fields.name: meanLine
fields.summary: Top of lowercase letters, x-height (OS/2 sxHeight).

fields.name: descentLine
fields.summary: Baseline to bottom of the lowest glyph, negative. Typo descender when the font sets USE_TYPO_METRICS, otherwise hhea descender.

fields.name: typoAscent
fields.summary: Typographic ascent (OS/2 sTypoAscender): the designer's intended content-box top, tighter than [[ascentLine]] for fonts that pad hhea. 0 when the font has no OS/2 table.

fields.name: typoDescent
fields.summary: Typographic descent (OS/2 sTypoDescender), negative below baseline. 0 when unavailable.

fields.name: typoLineGap
fields.summary: Typographic line gap (OS/2 sTypoLineGap): leading the designer suggests between lines.

fields.name: winAscent
fields.summary: Windows clip-box ascent (OS/2 usWinAscent), positive: the extent Windows GDI/DirectWrite will not clip. 0 when unavailable.

fields.name: winDescent
fields.summary: Windows clip-box descent (OS/2 usWinDescent), stored negative below baseline. 0 when unavailable.

fields.name: useTypoMetrics
fields.summary: Font sets OS/2 USE_TYPO_METRICS (fsSelection bit 7): consumers should prefer the typo metrics for line layout.

fields.name: superscriptOffset
fields.summary: Vertical offset for superscript glyphs (OS/2 ySuperscriptYOffset).

fields.name: superscriptSize
fields.summary: Suggested point size for superscript glyphs (OS/2 ySuperscriptYSize).

fields.name: subscriptOffset
fields.summary: Vertical offset for subscript glyphs (OS/2 ySubscriptYOffset).

fields.name: subscriptSize
fields.summary: Suggested point size for subscript glyphs (OS/2 ySubscriptYSize).

fields.name: underlineOffset
fields.summary: Vertical position of the underline relative to baseline (post table).

fields.name: underlineThickness
fields.summary: Thickness of the underline stroke (post table).

fields.name: strikethroughOffset
fields.summary: Vertical position of the strikethrough relative to baseline (OS/2 yStrikeoutPosition).

fields.name: strikethroughThickness
fields.summary: Thickness of the strikethrough stroke (OS/2 yStrikeoutSize).

fields.name: tabWidth
fields.summary: Width of a tab character, derived from space advance.

types.name: FaceInfoOverride
types.summary: Optional FaceInfo override. Every field defaults to the unset sentinel.

fields.name: italicTriState
fields.summary: Tri-state italic: -1 unset, 0 false, 1 true.

types.name: FontFamily
types.summary: A font family: primary font plus optional variant faces (Bold, Italic, Variable, etc.).

methods.name: FontFamily
methods.summary: Creates a family with detached face storage.

methods.name: WithFaces
methods.summary: Returns a copy of this family with detached replacement faces.

methods.name: CaptureStateSnapshot
methods.summary: Captures the family and its face-array storage without retaining mutable aliases.

methods.name: StateEquals
methods.summary: Compares serialized family configuration while ignoring the derived runtime lookup.

properties.name: Faces
properties.summary: Additional faces such as bold, italic, and variable variants.

fields.name: name
fields.summary: Optional identifier referenced by <font=...> rich-text tags. Case-sensitive; duplicates across a stack trigger a warning and first-wins lookup. Leave empty for families that should not be addressable by name.
attributes: Tooltip("User-facing identifier used by <font=...> rich-text tags (case-sensitive, unique per stack). Leave empty to make this family unaddressable by name.")

fields.name: primary
fields.summary: Primary font asset. Provides strut metrics (if first family) and codepoint lookup.

fields.name: preferredLanguage
fields.summary: Optional BCP 47 language hint (e.g. zh-Hans, ja, en-GB). When a text run carries a matching language tag, this family is preferred during codepoint-to-font resolution. Use for single-stack multi-locale setups; leave empty for locale-agnostic families.
attributes: Tooltip("Optional BCP 47 tag (e.g. zh-Hans, zh-Hant, ja, ko, en-US). When text carries a matching language tag, this family wins during codepoint-to-font resolution. Leave empty for locale-agnostic families.")

types.name: FontNormalizeMetric
types.summary: Reference metric for matching each font's visual size to the primary font (CSS font-size-adjust).

fields.name: None
fields.summary: No normalization; each font renders at its own design size.

fields.name: XHeight
fields.summary: Match lowercase x-height to the primary font. Best for body text.

fields.name: CapHeight
fields.summary: Match capital cap-height to the primary font. Best for all-caps or symbol fonts.

types.name: FontVariationMemoryStats
types.summary: Snapshot of exact variable-font registrations shared across providers.

properties.name: RegistrationCount
properties.summary: Total exact coordinate registrations.

properties.name: ActiveRegistrationCount
properties.summary: Registrations leased by at least one live provider.

types.name: Glyph
types.summary: A glyph: visual representation of a character in a font atlas.

fields.name: index
fields.summary: Glyph index in the font (0 =.notdef / missing glyph).

fields.name: metrics
fields.summary: Glyph metrics for layout (size, bearings, advance).

fields.name: glyphRect
fields.summary: Position and size of this glyph in the atlas texture.

fields.name: atlasIndex
fields.summary: Index of the atlas texture containing this glyph.

types.name: GlyphAtlas
types.summary: GPU-resident glyph tile cache over the [[GpuAtlas{TEntry}]] engine: Burst CPU rasterization directly into acquired [[GpuUploadSlot]] memory for SDF/MSDF glyphs, ready color pixels for emoji/color fonts. This class owns everything glyph-shaped — pad tiers, tile-size classification, the [[GlyphTransformTable]] rows, raster jobs — while storage, delivery, slots, eviction, compaction and recovery live in the engine. The atlas is a disposable cache: on [[AnyAtlasContentLost]] consumers re-collect from font data.

methods.name: GetInstance
methods.summary: Returns the process-wide atlas; GPU initialization remains deferred to the main thread.

methods.name: DefaultVarHash
methods.summary: Computes default varHash48 for a non-variable font.

methods.name: ComputeVarHash48
methods.summary: Computes varHash48 for a variable font with specific axis values. Uses FNV-1a to mix fontDataHash with axis values. Returns DefaultVarHash if axisValues is empty.

fields.name: Pad
fields.summary: SDF distance scale: the atlas stores signed distance in em, clamped to ±this, and effect widths convert em→field units through it (the shader's DILATE_SCALE). NOT the tile rim — see [[TileFitPad]].

fields.name: TileFitPad
fields.summary: Tight-fit rim for an effect-free glyph, in glyph-height units — pad tier 0 (see [[PadTierToNorm]]). Small enough that the glyph nearly fills its tile, large enough for edge AA (must exceed the face SDF padding). Effects grow the tier per-glyph via re-rasterization, up to the full Pad/glyphH spread.

fields.name: pixelWidth
fields.summary: Rendered pixel width (color only, 0 for SDF).

fields.name: pixelHeight
fields.summary: Rendered pixel height (color only, 0 for SDF).

types.name: GlyphMetrics
types.summary: Metrics that define size, position and spacing of a glyph for text layout. Values are in font design units.

fields.name: width
fields.summary: Width of the glyph bounding box in design units.

fields.name: height
fields.summary: Height of the glyph bounding box in design units.

fields.name: horizontalBearingX
fields.summary: Horizontal distance from the origin to the left edge of the bounding box.

fields.name: horizontalBearingY
fields.summary: Vertical distance from the baseline to the top edge of the bounding box.

fields.name: horizontalAdvance
fields.summary: Horizontal distance to advance to the next glyph origin.

types.name: GlyphOverride
types.summary: Per-glyph overrides for one glyph index: SDF tile size plus advance, position and size adjustments applied wherever this glyph renders in the font.

fields.name: advanceScale
attributes: Tooltip("Advance (layout width) multiplier. 0 or 1 = unchanged; e.g. 0.3 shrinks an over-wide glyph such as an icon-font space. Affects line breaking and caret positions.")

fields.name: offset
attributes: Tooltip("Render shift in em. Visual only — does not change layout width. Y positive = up.")

fields.name: scale
attributes: Tooltip("Render size multiplier around the glyph's pen position. 0 or 1 = unchanged. Visual only.")

types.name: GlyphRect
types.summary: Position and size of a glyph within an atlas texture.

fields.name: x
fields.summary: Horizontal position in the atlas (pixels).

fields.name: y
fields.summary: Vertical position in the atlas (pixels).

fields.name: width
fields.summary: Width of the glyph region (pixels).

fields.name: height
fields.summary: Height of the glyph region (pixels).

types.name: LanguageMatching
types.summary: BCP 47 language tag matching: shorter tag matches longer tag sharing the same prefix (e.g. zh ↔ zh-Hans).

methods.name: Matches
methods.summary: True if the two BCP 47 tags are equal or one is a prefix of the other.

fields.name: fontName
attributes: Tooltip("Font name from the platform catalog. Empty = inherit from the Common tab.")

fields.name: sdfDetailMultiplier
attributes: Tooltip("SDF tile detail multiplier override. NaN = inherit.")

fields.name: tileSizeOffsetOverride
attributes: Tooltip("Tile size offset override. int.MinValue = inherit.")

types.name: SystemFont
types.summary: Resolves complete Unicode sequences through the platform font cascade and caches the exact source face plus variable-axis coordinates selected by the operating system. Returned runtimes are cache-owned and must not be disposed by callers.

methods.name: TryResolve
methods.summary: Returns the platform cascade face covering a codepoint, optionally carrying another system font's render settings.

methods.name: TryResolveStyled
methods.summary: Returns the closest platform cascade face for the requested CSS weight and slant. The returned face may be regular when the family has no real styled cut.

methods.name: TryResolveStyledFamily
methods.summary: Returns a covering cut of the named installed family, or null when the platform substitutes another family or no cut covers the codepoint.

methods.name: Trim
methods.summary: Evicts least-recently-used source faces beyond [[InactiveSourceCapacity]] and trims unreferenced font-file bytes to [[InactiveByteBudget]]. Faces leased by live providers are preserved.

methods.name: TrimUnused
methods.summary: Releases every inactive source face and unreferenced font-file byte immediately. Active text providers remain valid.

methods.name: Reset
methods.summary: Discards all request/source matches, styled companions and platform byte caches so subsequent resolution observes the current installed fonts.

properties.name: InactiveSourceCapacity
properties.summary: Maximum number of resolved source faces retained after their last text provider releases them. Active faces are never evicted. Set to zero to keep no inactive source faces.

properties.name: InactiveByteBudget
properties.summary: Maximum owned bytes retained by inactive memory-backed source faces and warm entries. Mapped files are released with their last native consumer and do not consume this budget.

properties.name: MemoryStats
properties.summary: Returns a consistent snapshot of SystemFont ownership and memory-backed retained bytes.

properties.name: Disabled
properties.summary: Turns off the automatically appended OS fallback and the OS-default primary used when no font is assigned. Explicitly assigned [[UniTextSystemFont]] assets remain active. Changing the value invalidates resolution caches and raises [[DisableChanged]].

properties.name: Default
properties.summary: The configured project system font, or the platform default sans-serif runtime used as the final family and as the primary when no font is assigned. Null when implicit fallback is disabled or unavailable.

events.name: Changed
events.summary: Raised whenever implicit system-font availability or resolved platform font sources change.

events.name: DisableChanged
events.summary: Raised when [[Disabled]] changes.

types.name: SystemFontMemoryStats
types.summary: Snapshot of SystemFont cache ownership. Counts include active and warm inactive entries; mapped file length is not reported as resident memory.

properties.name: SourceCount
properties.summary: Number of resolved source faces currently owned by SystemFont.

properties.name: ActiveSourceCount
properties.summary: Number of source faces leased by live text providers or an in-flight resolution pass.

properties.name: RequestCount
properties.summary: Number of cached sequence/style resolution results.

properties.name: ByteEntryCount
properties.summary: Number of shared file-backed or memory-backed source entries.

properties.name: RetainedByteCount
properties.summary: Total bytes owned by memory-backed source entries. File mappings report zero because their virtual length is not resident memory.

types.name: UniTextColorFont
types.summary: A color-font asset — embedded color-font bytes (CBDT/sbix bitmap or COLRv0/COLRv1 vector) rendered through the shared color-glyph pipeline. The color analog of [[UniTextFont]]: add it to a Font Stack like any other font and it serves the codepoints it covers via the normal resolution chain. The always-on system emoji font ([[EmojiFont]]) stays the privileged provider for emoji-presentation codepoints.
types.remarks: All color fonts share one color atlas whose tile pixel size grows to fit the largest color font loaded. Rasterization runs through FreeType/Blend2D on desktop, editor, iOS and Android. WebGL has no Blend2D, so an embedded color-font asset does not rasterize there (color-presentation codepoints fall back to the system emoji font; other color glyphs do not render).

properties.name: ColorPixelSize
properties.summary: Pixel size at which this font's color glyphs rasterize. Bitmap fonts snap to the nearest strike; vector fonts render at this size.

types.name: UniTextFont
types.summary: Serialized font definition that owns face and rendering metadata and resolves its immutable source lazily. Embedded sources stay in the asset in the Editor and WebGL; other players resolve build-generated disk-backed sources. The [[Core]] materializes only when glyph or shaping work first needs this face.

methods.name: CreateRuntime
methods.summary: Subclass hook: produce the Core, or null if bytes unavailable.

methods.name: InvalidateRuntime
methods.summary: Tears down the current runtime; next [[Runtime]] access rebuilds.

methods.name: SetResolvedMetadata
methods.summary: Updates coupled face metadata without exposing an observable half-updated runtime.

methods.name: BuildRuntime
methods.summary: Subclass hook: instantiate a Core from bytes. Default uses serialized config.

methods.name: CopyFontData
methods.summary: Creates a managed snapshot of the complete raw font file.

methods.name: GetCachedInstanceId
methods.summary: Cached Unity instance id, suitable for use as a dictionary key.

methods.name: LoadFontFace
methods.summary: Loads the underlying FreeType face. Returns the resulting error code, or [[Success]] if already loaded.

methods.name: ReadFontAssetDefinition
methods.summary: Builds glyph and character lookup dictionaries and synthesizes invisible control characters (tab, line separators, BOM marks).

methods.name: GetGlyphIndexForUnicode
methods.summary: Resolves a codepoint to a glyph index via HarfBuzz, with controlled fallbacks for NBSP/soft-hyphen.

methods.name: RegisterCharacterEntries
methods.summary: Adds (unicode, glyphIndex) pairs to the character table for entries discovered after the initial font load (e.g. variation selectors, emoji sequences).

methods.name: HasGlyphInAtlas
methods.summary: Returns whether the glyph has a committed or pending entry in the selected distance-field atlas for this font's default variation.

methods.name: ClearDynamicData
methods.summary: Drops the FT face, glyph caches and atlas entries owned by this font. Next access rebuilds on demand.

methods.name: InvokeChanged
methods.summary: Manually fires the [[Changed]] event. Use after editor edits that affect rendering but not atlas residency.

methods.name: ClearRuntimeData
methods.summary: Releases native and atlas data for all live runtimes while preserving their managed font definitions, then invalidates shared resolution caches.

methods.name: ComputeFontDataHash
methods.summary: Cheap content hash of font bytes (FNV-1a variant, sampling step on large files). Stable across runs.

methods.name: CreateFontAsset
methods.summary: Builds a runtime [[UniTextFont]] from font file bytes. FT face is loaded once to populate [[FaceInfo]] and units-per-em.

methods.name: CreateFontAsset
methods.summary: Builds a font asset of the given [[UniTextFont]] subtype from font file bytes, populating its source, hash, units-per-em and face metrics identically to [[CreateFontAsset]].

properties.name: Runtime
properties.summary: Lazy-built runtime that owns the FT face, glyph tables and atlas pipeline. First access after creation or source invalidation must occur on the main thread unless a provider has already captured the worker-safe slot.

properties.name: HasRuntime
properties.summary: True if Runtime is already materialized. Avoids triggering lazy build.

properties.name: FontData
properties.summary: Creates a managed snapshot of the raw TTF/OTF file. This compatibility property allocates the complete file; rendering and shaping use the source backing directly.

properties.name: HasFontData
properties.summary: True when font bytes are available (either serialized or supplied by a subclass).

properties.name: FontDataHash
properties.summary: Process-unique runtime identity used by atlas and shaping registries.

properties.name: FaceInfo
properties.summary: Font face metrics (ascender, descender, line height, etc.).

properties.name: UnitsPerEm
properties.summary: Font design units per em (typically 1000 or 2048). Fundamental scaling unit: scale = fontSize / unitsPerEm.

properties.name: FontScale
properties.summary: Visual scale multiplier. Compensates for fonts that render visually smaller/larger than peers at the same size (e.g. Dongle).

properties.name: ParticipatesInNormalization
properties.summary: Whether font-size normalization may scale this font to match the primary font. Disable to keep a decorative font's intrinsic proportions.

properties.name: ItalicStyle
properties.summary: Synthetic italic slant in percent of height (30 leans the top right by 0.30 of the height, ≈16.7°, not 30°), applied as a horizontal skew when an italic tag is set. 0 falls back to [[DefaultItalicStyle]].

properties.name: SpacingOffset
properties.summary: Baseline spacing added to every glyph's advance during shaping, in font design units. Layered additively with style-level letter-spacing.

properties.name: SpaceAdvance
properties.summary: Space (U+0020) advance for this font, in design units; replaces the width HarfBuzz reports. [[SpaceAdvanceUninitialized]] = use the font's own / HarfBuzz fallback.

properties.name: FakeBoldWeight
properties.summary: Baseline synthetic bold in CSS weight steps from the font's own weight (1 ≈ Regular → Bold). Renders thicker via SDF dilate and compensates advance to keep layout stable. No effect on color emoji fonts.

properties.name: AtlasPadding
properties.summary: Atlas gutter in pixels around each glyph tile, prevents bilinear bleeding.

properties.name: IsVariable
properties.summary: True if this font defines OpenType variable axes.

properties.name: IsColor
properties.summary: True for color (emoji/COLR) fonts — they bypass the SDF pipeline.

properties.name: CachedName
properties.summary: Cached name string usable on worker threads (Unity's name getter is main-thread-only).

properties.name: GlyphLookupTable
properties.summary: (varHash48, glyphIndex) → atlas-resident [[Glyph]]. Null until the font's lookup tables are built.

fields.name: fontDataHash
attributes: Tooltip("Hash of font data for identification.")

fields.name: DefaultItalicStyle

types.name: UniTextFontProvider
types.summary: Owns Unicode-sequence font resolution for a text object: composes the family chain from the assigned font and font stack, walks it (plus emoji and the always-on [[SystemFont]] fallback) to pick a covering runtime and exact variation instance when available, and otherwise returns the primary runtime as the intentional.notdef endpoint. Asset-backed faces are captured as worker-safe lazy slots; bare runtime companions and the emoji singleton flow through the same resolution path. The owner must dispose the provider after all processing and raster work finishes.

methods.summary: Initializes the provider. The resolution chain is primary (if set), then fontStack's families, then [[Default]] (the configured [[SystemFont]] or the OS default) as the always-on final fallback. With nothing assigned, [[Default]] becomes the primary. Main-thread only.

methods.name: GetNormalizationScale
methods.summary: Per-font multiplier matching a fallback/secondary font to the primary font's reference metric (CSS font-size-adjust). Derived from the runtime alone, so every id addressing one runtime — base or variation instance — yields the same multiplier. Returns 1 when normalization is off, the font is the primary, the font opts out, or a metric is unavailable.

methods.name: GetNormalizationScale

types.name: UniTextFontVariant
types.summary: A [[UniTextFont]] that takes only the raw font bytes from a [[Source]] font and defines everything else itself — face metrics, units-per-em, render settings and glyph overrides are fully independent and overridable. Use to render the same TTF/OTF with a different look or metrics without duplicating the bytes. Each variant has its own atlas and shaper cache (the base mixes the asset instance id into [[FontDataHash]]), so variants and their source coexist without overwriting each other's glyphs. On first assignment the face metrics are seeded from the source font; after that they are owned by the variant.

types.name: UniTextSystemFont
types.summary: UniTextFont that resolves its font bytes from the host OS at runtime from a per-platform pick (Common / Windows / macOS / Linux / iOS / Android). WebGL is unsupported.
types.remarks: A regular font: it participates only when added to a font stack. Automatic gap-filling for codepoints no font covers is a separate, always-on mechanism — [[SystemFont]] — independent of this asset. FaceInfo, SDF detail multiplier and tile-size offset can be overridden per platform. Each field defaults to an "unset" sentinel; unset fields use values extracted from the loaded font. Glyph overrides are not supported — they reference indices specific to a particular font file, which a system font does not pin.

types.name: LinkModifier
types.summary: Marks text ranges as clickable hyperlinks and dispatches their click/hover events.
types.remarks: Carries no base visual styling — colour and underline are separate modifiers. Combine it with [[ColorModifier]] and [[UnderlineModifier]] in a [[CompositeModifier]] (as the built-in Link preset does) so a link's appearance is fully author-controlled. Parameter: the URL. State feedback follows web convention: no hover background (underline / colour composition already reads as hover affordance), a subtle grey rounded pressed/activation flash is composed through the same [[ModifierRule]] graph available to every interactive range. Subscribe to [[LinkClicked]] to handle activation (a confirmed click / tap — raised from the interaction machine's Activated event), or let the modifier open the URL via [[OpenURL]] when [[AutoOpenUrl]] is set.
types.example:
var linkMod = uniText.GetModifier<LinkModifier>();
linkMod.LinkClicked += url => Debug.Log($"Link clicked: {url}");

types.name: RangeState
types.summary: Interaction state of an interactive range — the machine [[InteractiveModifier]] runs per range: Normal → Hovered → Pressed → back, the CSS LVHA / UIKit UITextItem model. Activation (a confirmed primary click / tap) is a transition event, not a state — it is raised as [[Activated]] between [[Pressed]] and the release state.

fields.name: Hovered

fields.summary: A primary press is held inside the range. Entered instantly on press for every pointer kind — delayed touch feedback reads as lag.

fields.name: Disabled
fields.summary: The range does not react to input because [[IsRangeEnabled]] returned.

types.name: SpoilerModifier
types.summary: Hides text ranges behind an opaque decoration until activated and exposes the revealed state as a typed range signal for arbitrary modifier, property or externally driven rules.
types.remarks: The revealed set is keyed by stable source identity, so unchanged entities keep their state across parsing and layout. The default presentation is an ordinary transient [[HighlightModifier]] above the text; replace or extend [[Rules]] to use blur, glyph modifiers, custom geometry or a project animation driver.
types.example:
var spoiler = new SpoilerModifier();
uniText.Styles.Add(new Style { Modifier = spoiler, Source = new TagRule("spoiler") });
attributes: TypeDescription("Hides text behind an animated modifier rule until activated.")

types.name: TextPointerEvent
types.summary: Mutable carrier for consumable pointer events emitted by [[UniTextBase]]. On click/context resolution, [[Consumed]] suppresses propagation to parent UI. During [[PointerPressed]] it suppresses later ordered component defaults such as caret placement while preserving parent drag/scroll propagation.
types.remarks: The host reuses ONE instance across emissions (zero allocation per pointer event, the PointerEventData model) — do not retain a reference beyond the callback; copy the fields you need. Multi-tap detection (double / triple click → word / line selection) is the consumer's responsibility — the host emits one event per click, without aggregating taps.

methods.name: TextPointerEvent
methods.summary: Creates an empty reusable carrier that the host populates before dispatch.

methods.name: TextPointerEvent
methods.summary: Creates a pointer-event snapshot.

params.name: hit
params.description: Range hit produced at the event position, or [[None]].

params.name: trigger
params.description: Semantic pointer action that produced the event.

params.name: screenPosition
params.description: Originating position in screen coordinates.

params.name: eventCamera
params.description: Camera used for screen-to-local conversion, or null for overlay UI.

params.name: modifiers
params.description: Keyboard modifiers held at dispatch time.

params.name: kind
params.description: Physical pointer device class.

params.name: pointerId
params.description: Pointer identity for this contact.

properties.name: Hit
properties.summary: The hit-test result produced from the originating screen position.

properties.name: Trigger
properties.summary: What initiated the event. Use to distinguish primary clicks from context-menu requests (right-click on desktop, long-press on touch / pen).

properties.name: Kind
properties.summary: Physical device class behind the event.

properties.name: PointerId
properties.summary: Platform pointer identity, stable for the lifetime of one pointer contact.

properties.name: ScreenPosition
properties.summary: Originating pointer position in screen coordinates. Useful for placing context-menu UI directly under the press without re-deriving from the hit's glyph position (which lives in text-local space).

properties.name: EventCamera
properties.summary: Camera that owns the event (null for screen-space overlay canvases). Required for any subsequent screen-to-local conversions on the consumer side.

properties.name: Modifiers
properties.summary: Keyboard modifier keys held at the moment of the event.

properties.name: Consumed
properties.summary: Set to by a subscriber that claimed the event. Meaning is phase-specific: a press suppresses later ordered component defaults; release suppresses the pending click; resolved click/context also suppresses propagation to the parent UI.

types.name: FitBudgets
types.summary: Uniform text-fitting adjustments resolved by the auto-size fit ladder and applied on top of shaped advances: extra tracking per non-zero-advance glyph, a horizontal glyph-scale multiplier, and a line-height multiplier.

properties.name: IsIdentity
properties.summary: Whether every adjustment is at its neutral value.

properties.name: IsAdvanceIdentity
properties.summary: Whether the advance-affecting adjustments are at their neutral values.

properties.name: Identity

fields.name: lineHeightScale
