types.name: AttributeChannel
types.summary: Single owner of the pipeline work behind one attribute key: subscribes the passes that read the keyed buffer and holds the per-range state those passes consume.
types.remarks: One channel exists per key per component however many modifiers write that key, so a pass runs once over the merged buffer instead of once per writer. Writers only fill the buffer from [[OnApply]]; anything a pass reads belongs here, never on a writer. [[OnActivate]] runs when the first writer enables and [[OnDeactivate]] when the last one disables, so subscriptions match the writers' active span exactly. [[OnRelease]] runs when the key's last writer is destroyed. Passes may run on the rebuild worker — no Unity API calls.

methods.name: OnActivate
methods.summary: Subscribes the channel's passes.

methods.name: OnDeactivate
methods.summary: Unsubscribes the channel's passes.

methods.name: OnRelease
methods.summary: Releases pooled state acquired by [[OnActivate]].

methods.name: OnProviderChanged
methods.summary: Rebinds whatever [[OnActivate]] captured from [[Provider]], after that writer left with others still active. A channel that captures nothing needs no override.

methods.name: OnBeginCycle
methods.summary: Brings state the writers append to back to a valid start, once per apply cycle before the first [[OnApply]] of that cycle. Every writer of the key re-applies within one cycle, so entries collected here are always complete.

properties.name: Key
properties.summary: The attribute key this channel owns.

properties.name: Provider
properties.summary: An active writer, for dispatching hooks a pass needs from the writer's type. Any of them serves: a pass reads the merged buffer and this channel's state, never a writer's fields.

fields.name: uniText
fields.summary: The component this channel serves, from its first writer until release.

fields.name: buffers
fields.summary: Text-processing buffers of [[uniText]].

fields.name: ColorGlyphField
fields.summary: Per-codepoint silhouette-field request for colour glyphs, written by effects that apply to them (see ColorGlyphField).

types.name: BaseModifier
types.summary: Base class for logic that alters the appearance, layout, semantics, or behavior of ranges emitted by a [[RangeSource]].
types.remarks: Subclass and override the protected hooks ([[OnEnable]], [[OnDisable]], [[OnDestroy]], [[OnApply]], optionally [[PrepareForParallel]]). Lifecycle dispatching is driven by the framework ([[Style]], the parse pipeline, [[CompositeModifier]]) — user code instantiates modifiers and hands them to [[Style]]; it should not invoke the lifecycle itself. Cycle (per parse pass on a UniText component): [[OnEnable]] runs once when the modifier first participates in a cycle — allocate pooled buffers and subscribe to UniText events here. [[OnApply]] runs for every tag/range matched in the current text. [[OnDisable]] runs at the start of the next cycle to unsubscribe event handlers; allocated buffers should stay alive so the next [[OnEnable]] can reuse them. [[OnDestroy]] runs when the modifier is removed from the component (style changed, font reload, component destroyed) — release pooled buffers and any other resources [[OnEnable]] acquired. Guaranteed to run exactly once per [[OnEnable]]-initiated resource acquisition, even when an intervening [[OnDisable]] has already cleared the subscription state. Granular reapplication re-runs [[OnApply]] over retained spans without a re-parse, once per span — so accumulators [[OnApply]] appends to must be cleared once per cycle, never at the start of [[OnApply]] itself. Override [[BeforeApply]] for that: the framework compares the host's apply-cycle stamp on each dispatch and calls it lazily before the modifier's first range of a new cycle (full parse and granular re-apply alike). There is no separate reset phase.

methods.name: GetRanges
methods.summary: Collects this modifier's materialized ranges from the current parse, in text order.

exceptions.description: The modifier is not attached to a text component.

methods.name: Ranges
methods.summary: Starts a query over this modifier's materialized ranges; chain filters, then materialize with [[Collect]] or take standing ownership with [[Own{TModifier,TValue}]].

methods.name: Own
methods.summary: Takes standing ownership of one parameter across every range of this modifier, now and after every future parse.

exceptions.description: The modifier is not attached to a text component.

methods.name: MarkRenderDirty
methods.summary: Marks the mesh stage dirty without queueing a range re-apply — for members whose applied values the modifier re-resolves before each rebuild. Does nothing when hasRanges is; an unowned instance raises the structural mesh notification instead, so authoring-time edits still reach consumers.

methods.name: MarkNestedStateChanged
methods.summary: Forwards an exact transition owned by nested reusable state.

methods.name: BeforeApply
methods.summary: Runs once per apply cycle (full parse and granular re-apply alike), lazily before this modifier's first [[OnApply]] of the cycle. Bring accumulated state back to a valid start: clear buffers [[OnApply]] appends to (ranges?.FakeClear()), release externally held resources the re-run re-acquires (gradient ramp rows), restore derived flags. A granular re-apply replays the cycle inside the mesh phase without re-running the parse, shaping, or — while positions stay valid — layout, so state whose only producer is one of those phases must never be cleared or overwritten here and belongs in a container this method does not touch. Runs on the rebuild worker — keep it idempotent and free of Unity API calls. Overwrite-style attribute buffers need nothing here.

methods.name: OnEnable
methods.summary: Allocate buffers, subscribe to UniText events, and bring the modifier into the active state. Pairs one-to-one with [[OnDisable]] and [[OnDestroy]].

methods.name: OnDisable
methods.summary: Unsubscribe from UniText events. Buffers and persistent state should remain allocated — [[OnDestroy]] is responsible for releasing them. Runs once per active cycle (at the start of the next parse pass).

methods.name: OnDestroy
methods.summary: Release resources allocated by [[OnEnable]] (pooled buffers, attribute data, registry subscriptions). Always runs after [[OnEnable]] ran at least once, even when the most recent cycle already drained subscriptions via [[OnDisable]].

methods.name: OnApply
methods.summary: Applies this modifier to one entity segment. Override this hook to access identity, payload, source, revision and layered parameters without materializing a merged value.

params.name: context
params.description: Synchronous immutable application context.

properties.name: IsInitialized
properties.summary: between [[OnEnable]] and the next [[OnDisable]]/[[OnDestroy]]: event handlers are currently subscribed. Useful for diagnostics and for nested composites that mirror the child lifecycle.

fields.name: uniText
fields.summary: The UniText component this modifier is bound to. Assigned by the framework via SetOwner; available to subclasses from [[OnEnable]] onward.

fields.name: buffers
fields.summary: Shared text-processing buffers (codepoints, runs, shaped glyphs, attribute storage). Assigned by the framework alongside [[uniText]].

types.name: BoldMode
types.summary: How bold is realized. Auto prefers a real bold face and synthesizes only as a fallback.

fields.name: Auto
fields.summary: Prefer a real bold face (family cut or variable wght axis); synthesize only when none matches.

fields.name: Synthetic
fields.summary: Keep the current real face and synthesize only the positive weight difference needed to reach the target.

fields.name: Real
fields.summary: Use a real bold face only; stay at the natural weight when none matches.

types.name: BoldModifier
types.summary: Applies bold styling to text using the CSS font-weight scale (1-1000).
types.remarks: First parameter: CSS font-weight 1-1000; 0 or omitted = auto (max(700, baseWeight+300)). Second parameter — mode: f (<b=700,f>) keeps the current real face and supplies any missing weight synthetically (SDF dilate + advance correction); r (<b=700,r>) uses a real bold face only, staying at the natural weight when none matches. Default (no mode) prefers a real face — Font Family static cut or variable wght axis — and synthesizes only as a fallback. One buffer carries both: the top 2 bits select the mode, the low 10 bits the weight.
attributes: TypeDescription("Makes text thicker by expanding the distance field via shader dilate and adjusting glyph advances.")

properties.name: Weight
properties.summary: CSS font-weight 1–1000, or 0 (the default) for auto — max(700, base weight + 300), so bold never falls below the font's own weight. Any explicit 1–1000 (including 700) is honoured exactly. A per-range value overrides it.

properties.name: Mode
properties.summary: How bold is realized. A per-range value overrides it; this is the default for a bare tag or whole-text use.

types.name: BoolRuleValue
types.summary: Bool ParameterRule target.

types.name: BuiltInScalarSignal
types.summary: Built-in scalar signals selectable from serialized rule graphs.

fields.name: LongPressProgress
fields.summary: Touch or pen hold progress.

fields.name: LoadingProgress
fields.summary: Application loading progress.

fields.name: DragProgress
fields.summary: Custom drag recognizer progress.

fields.name: VoiceProgress
fields.summary: Voice, karaoke or transcript playback progress.

types.name: CharacterWidthModifier
types.summary: Fits every character of a range into a cell of one width, centering the glyph inside it. Advances and offsets change; glyphs are never substituted.
types.remarks: Parameter: the cell width with a unit — 1em for a full-width CJK cell, 0.5em for a half-width one, or a raw pixel amount. auto, and any non-positive width, measures the range and uses its widest glyph. Runs ahead of letter and word spacing, whose tracking is added on top of the finished cell.

properties.name: Width
properties.summary: Cell width every character of a range is fitted to; a non-positive width measures the range's widest glyph. A per-range value overrides it.
attributes: Tooltip("Cell width. 0 — as wide as the widest glyph in the range.")

types.name: ColorGlyphPolicy
types.summary: Whether a layer effect decorates the colour glyphs — emoji and inline sprites — inside its range.

fields.name: Inherit
fields.summary: No value at this layer (see [[PaintInherit]]); an unresolved chain means the effect's own default.

fields.name: Skip
fields.summary: The effect leaves colour glyphs untouched.

fields.name: Apply
fields.summary: The effect renders on the glyph's silhouette, a distance field the atlas derives from the bitmap's alpha at the 50% threshold.

types.name: ColorModifier
types.summary: Applies color to text ranges using hex codes or named colors.
types.remarks: Parameter: a color value in hex or by name. Supported formats: - Hex: #RGB, #RRGGBB, #RRGGBBAA - Named colors: white, black, red, green, blue, yellow, cyan, magenta, orange, purple, gray, lime, brown, pink, navy, teal, olive, maroon, silver, gold The alpha channel of the color parameter is multiplied with the component's base alpha (per W3C alpha compositing). A fully opaque parameter inherits the component alpha; a semi-transparent parameter scales it further.
attributes: TypeDescription("Changes the color of the text.")

methods.name: TryGetColor
methods.summary: Tries to get the custom color for a cluster from the specified buffers.
methods.returns: True if a custom color exists for the cluster; otherwise, false.

params.name: buffers
params.description: The UniText buffers containing color attribute data.

params.name: cluster
params.description: The cluster index to look up.

params.name: color
params.description: The color if found.

properties.name: Color
properties.summary: Default text colour used when a range does not override it.

types.name: ColorRuleValue
types.summary: Color ParameterRule target.

methods.name: ColorRuleValue
methods.summary: Creates the value at opaque white.

types.name: CompositeModifier
types.summary: Combines modifiers and splits semicolon-delimited parameters by child order.
attributes: TypeDescription("Combines multiple modifiers into one, splitting parameters by ';'.")

methods.name: FindLeaf
methods.summary: The style-level capability test: returns root itself, or the first composite leaf (depth-first), assignable to modifierType; null when none. Every "does this style speak X" lookup goes through here so composites are never invisible.

types.name: DirectionModifier
types.summary: Sets the paragraph base writing direction (UAX #9). Apply whole-text.
attributes: TypeDescription("Base writing direction of the text (auto / left-to-right / right-to-left).")

properties.name: Direction
properties.summary: Base writing direction. A per-range value overrides it; this is the default for a bare tag or whole-text use.

types.name: EffectModifier
types.summary: Base class for modifiers that append duplicate glyph geometry behind or in front of the face (outline, shadow, extrude, glow, custom effects).
types.remarks: Contract: At the geometry-consumer tail of onGlyph, after glyph transformations, the subclass's [[OnGlyphEffect]] decides whether the current glyph needs an effect quad and, if so, calls [[EnqueueDuplicate]] with an arbitrary payload integer — typically an index into the modifier's own per-emit data table. At onMainPassFinalize, the per-modifier emit queue is flushed via [[OnFlush]]. The default implementation reserves 4 vertices for each pending emit (copying source geometry, recording the quad at the modifier's [[LayerSequence]]) and calls [[OnEmitQuad]] so the subclass can fill colour, UV2, offsets. Multi-layer effects override [[OnFlush]] to flush per-layer buffers. Painter order is the single layer axis: every quad — face and duplicates — records its [[LayerSequence]], and the generator sorts the index buffer by it, so stacking follows the order layers appear in Styles. The base class deliberately knows nothing about colour, dilate, softness, offsets, gradients, or any effect-specific parameter. Those live entirely inside the subclass. Common write patterns (solid colour + UV2, per-vertex gradient, offset, expand) are exposed via the static [[CoverageQuadOps]] helpers so subclasses share the implementation without sharing the data layout.

methods.name: OnGlyphEffect
methods.summary: Called once per glyph during mesh generation. The subclass decides whether the current glyph ([[currentCluster]]) needs an effect quad and invokes [[EnqueueDuplicate]] if so. A colour glyph (font.IsColor) may be decorated only when [[HasColorFaceField]] holds and the range's colour-glyph policy is [[Apply]]; its duplicates then sample the silhouette field instead of the bitmap.

methods.name: ResolveBlend
methods.summary: Resolves this effect's range blend override against its inherited mode.

methods.name: ResolveBlend
methods.summary: Resolves this effect's range blend override against its inherited mode by the parameter's own slot — for effects that read no other parameter through a reader.

methods.name: ResolveSpread
methods.summary: Resolves this effect's range spread override against its inherited value. Reads the slot before the colour-glyph policy, so call it after every other paint parameter the effect reads.

methods.name: ResolveColorGlyphs
methods.summary: Resolves the range's colour-glyph policy — Inherit falls through to [[DefaultColorGlyphPolicy]]. Reads the final parameter slot, so call it last.

methods.name: ResolveColorGlyphs
methods.summary: Resolves the range's colour-glyph policy by the parameter's own slot — for effects that read no other parameter through a reader.

methods.name: RequestColorGlyphField
methods.summary: Asks the atlas pipeline for the silhouette fields of the colour glyphs in [start, end) (codepoint indices), reserving at least reachEm of rim beyond the glyph edge. Call from [[OnApply]] for every range whose policy is [[Apply]]; the fields exist by the time the mesh is built.

methods.name: OnEmitQuad
methods.summary: Writes the actual per-vertex data into a reserved effect-quad slot. The base has already copied geometry (positions, UV0, UV1) from the source face quad and queued the triangle indices; destBaseIdx points at the first of the four duplicate vertices. The subclass writes [[Colors]], [[Uvs2]], and (if needed) re-positions [[Vertices]] through [[CoverageQuadOps]] helpers.

params.name: sourceBaseIdx
params.description: First vertex of the source face quad — read-only reference for alpha modulation, gradient evaluation, etc.

params.name: destBaseIdx
params.description: First vertex of the reserved effect quad — destination of all writes.

params.name: payload
params.description: Arbitrary subclass-defined tag captured at [[EnqueueDuplicate]] time.

methods.name: ResetOwnRequests
methods.summary: Resets per-cycle emit state. Subclasses with extra buffers (e.g. multi-layer effects) override and chain to clear their own storage.

methods.name: EnqueueDuplicate
methods.summary: Queues a duplicate of the given face quad for emission at onMainPassFinalize, recorded at this modifier's [[LayerSequence]] — raised by the generator's current [[sequenceBias]], captured here — so it stacks at its layer position inside whichever band the glyph is emitted into.

params.name: sourceBaseIdx
params.description: First vertex of the source face quad (use gen.faceBaseIdx).

params.name: payload
params.description: Arbitrary integer carried verbatim into [[OnEmitQuad]]. Typically an index into a per-emit table the subclass maintains alongside its per-range data.

methods.name: EnqueueDuplicate
methods.summary: Queues a duplicate at an explicit layer sequence — a claimed fill's output sequence rather than this modifier's own.

methods.name: OnFlush
methods.summary: Flushes the pending emit queue. Default implementation processes [[emits]] in the order they were enqueued — correct for single-layer effects. Multi-layer effects (e.g. extrude) override and iterate their own per-layer buffers in layer-major order, calling [[ReserveQuad]] + [[OnEmitQuad]] directly.

methods.name: ReserveQuad
methods.summary: Reserves a 4-vertex effect-quad slot: copies positions, UV0 and UV1 from the source quad — or, for a colour face that carries a silhouette field, builds the SDF quad over that field — records the quad at sequence with blend, and advances [[vertexCount]].
methods.remarks: [[Colors]] and [[Uvs2]] are not initialised here — the subclass writes both in [[OnEmitQuad]] via the [[CoverageQuadOps]] helpers. Leaving them untouched keeps the base ignorant of per-effect data layout.
methods.returns: First vertex index of the new quad.

properties.name: Blend
properties.summary: How this effect's emitted quads composite with the layers rendered beneath them.

properties.name: PaintSpread
properties.summary: Gradient continuation outside the paint's mapping frame, honoured by effects that project a paint; Inherit uses the swatch's value.

properties.name: ColorGlyphs
properties.summary: Whether the effect decorates colour glyphs — emoji and inline sprites — through their silhouette; Inherit uses the effect's own default ([[DefaultColorGlyphPolicy]]). The final parameter slot of every effect, so any parameter added later must follow it.

properties.name: DefaultColorGlyphPolicy
properties.summary: The colour-glyph policy an unresolved [[Inherit]] chain resolves to: skip, unless the effect reads naturally on a silhouette (a shadow, a glow).

types.name: EllipsisModifier
types.summary: Truncates text that overflows its container and appends an ellipsis (...).
types.remarks: Overflow is detected against the container's width without word wrap, and against its height with word wrap. Without word wrap the text keeps one line and the parameter (0-1) places the cut inside it: 0 takes the marker to the beginning, 0.5 to the middle, 1 (the default) to the end. With word wrap the text is clamped to the lines that fit the box: the tail of the last of them gives way to the marker and every line below is hidden, so the parameter has no effect there — a hidden line still occupies its place in the layout, and keeping the lower lines instead would draw them outside the box.
attributes: TypeDescription("Truncates overflowing text with an ellipsis.")

properties.name: Position
properties.summary: Where the marker sits inside the truncated line (0 start, 0.5 middle, 1 end); without effect once word wrap clamps whole lines. A per-range value overrides it; this is the default for a bare tag or whole-text use.

properties.name: ShowEllipsis
properties.summary: When, overflow is truncated without rendering the "..." marker and no marker width is reserved.

types.name: EmptyModifier
types.summary: A no-op modifier that performs no action.
types.remarks: Used as a placeholder or for tags that should be parsed but have no visual effect. Can be associated with custom parse rules to extract data without modifying rendering.
attributes: TypeDescription("An empty modifier with no effect. Use as a starting point for custom logic.")

types.name: EnumRuleValue<TEnum>
types.summary: Enum ParameterRule target, closed over the driven enum type.

types.name: ExtrudeModifier
types.summary: Adds a 3D extrude/bevel effect by appending a stack of progressively offset duplicate quads behind the face, shaded across a near→far colour gradient.
types.remarks: Layers are flushed back-to-front in layer-major order across all glyphs (every glyph's deepest slice first, then every glyph's next-deeper slice, …, then face). Naïve per-glyph fanout would invert that order at glyph boundaries when the cumulative offset exceeds glyph advance, leaving farther slices of glyph N+1 covering closer slices of glyph N. Per-layer buffers preserve the painter order regardless of overlap. Parameter: offset ("x y") + [,#nearColor][,#farColor][,dilate][,softness]. Defaults: offset = (0.3, -0.3) in em (scaled by the glyph metric factor; with [[FixedPixelSize]] the values are fixed pixels instead), near = white, far = black, dilate = 0, softness = 0.
attributes: TypeDescription("Adds a 3D extrude effect behind the text.")

methods.name: OnFlush
methods.summary: Layer-major flush: every glyph's deepest slice first, then every glyph's next slice, …, then the face. Each layer maintains its own emit buffer, so painter order survives inter-glyph overlap when the cumulative extrusion offset exceeds glyph advance. All slices record the sequence captured for their glyph; the generator's stable sort then keeps the deepest-first emission order within the layer.

methods.name: OnEmitQuad
methods.summary: Not used — [[ExtrudeModifier]] bypasses the base emit-queue indirection and writes all per-layer slots directly inside its [[OnFlush]] override.

properties.name: Offset
properties.summary: Per-step displacement of the extrusion. A per-range value overrides it.

properties.name: NearColor
properties.summary: Colour of the face-adjacent (near) slice. A per-range value overrides it.

properties.name: FarColor
properties.summary: Colour of the deepest (far) slice. A per-range value overrides it.

properties.name: Dilate
properties.summary: SDF dilation applied to each slice. A per-range value overrides it.

properties.name: Softness
properties.summary: Edge softness of each slice. A per-range value overrides it.

properties.name: Steps
properties.summary: Number of extrude layers stacked behind the face (minimum 1). More layers produce a smoother depth gradient and a longer apparent extrusion at the cost of additional duplicate-quad geometry per glyph.

properties.name: Bevel
properties.summary: When, layers alternate between the near and far face colours rather than blending across, producing a faceted bevel highlight. The layer count effectively doubles ([[Steps]] × 2) because each step contributes a near face and a side face.

properties.name: FixedPixelSize
properties.summary: When, the per-range offsetX / offsetY / dilate / softness values are interpreted in fixed pixels and compensated by the glyph metric factor so the extrusion has constant on-screen geometry independent of font size.

types.name: FloatRuleValue
types.summary: Float ParameterRule target.

types.name: FontFeatureModifier
types.summary: Turns OpenType features on or off over a text range.
types.remarks: Parameter: a comma-separated list of settings, each a four-character OpenType tag with an optional value — kern 0 (no kerning), -liga (no standard ligatures), +dlig, tnum (tabular figures), ss01 2. A bare tag means 1, a - prefix means 0, and the value may follow a space, colon or equals sign. Features are merged, not replaced: overlapping ranges and other feature-writing modifiers (small caps, superscript) keep their settings, and the innermost value wins a shared tag. Tags the font does not carry are ignored by the shaper.
attributes: TypeDescription("Turns OpenType features on or off (kerning, ligatures, figures, stylistic sets).")

properties.name: Features
properties.summary: Feature settings, e.g. kern 0, -liga. A per-range <feature=…> value overrides it; this is the default for a bare tag or whole-text use.

types.name: FontModifier
types.summary: Overrides the font used for a text range by selecting a [[FontFamily]] from the component's [[UniTextFontStack]] by its [[name]].
types.remarks: Parameter: the target family name (case-sensitive). Example: <font=pixel>Score</font>. Priority: a matched font wins over [[preferredLanguage]] selection and over the regular FontStack fallback chain. If the chosen family's primary lacks a glyph for a codepoint, the normal fallback chain still kicks in for that codepoint. If the name is not found in the FontStack, a warning is logged once per unresolved name and affected codepoints render with the default fallback behavior.
attributes: TypeDescription("Selects a font by FontFamily.name from the component's FontStack for this range.")

properties.name: FamilyName
properties.summary: Target [[name]]. A per-range <font=…> value overrides it; this is the default for a bare tag or whole-text use.

types.name: FontSizeMatchModifier
types.summary: Normalizes mixed fonts to a common visual size by matching x-height or cap-height (CSS font-size-adjust). Target 0 = match the primary font; >0 = match that aspect value (metric ÷ font size) for every font. Apply whole-text.
attributes: TypeDescription("Scales fonts to a shared x-height / cap-height so mixed fonts look consistent.")

properties.name: Metric
properties.summary: Which metric fonts are matched on. A per-range value overrides it; this is the default for a bare tag or whole-text use.

properties.name: Target
properties.summary: Target aspect value; 0 matches the primary font. A per-range value overrides it; this is the default for a bare tag or whole-text use.

types.name: GlyphModifier<T>
types.summary: Base class for modifiers that store per-glyph attribute data.
types.remarks: GlyphModifier provides automatic buffer management for per-glyph attributes. Derived classes implement [[GetOnGlyphCallback]] to receive callbacks during mesh generation, where they can modify vertex data based on attribute values. Optionally override [[GetOnShapedCallback]] to also receive a callback after shaping completes, for modifying glyph advances or run widths.

methods.name: DoApply
methods.summary: Implements the modifier's effect on one entity segment. The attribute buffer is guaranteed to have sufficient capacity when this is called.

params.name: context
params.description: Synchronous immutable application context.

methods.name: GetOnShapedCallback
methods.summary: Returns a callback to invoke after shaping completes. Override to modify glyph advances or run widths. Returns null by default (no shaped callback). Shaping runs only in a full pass, while the apply cycle also replays without it, so a value this callback refines into the attribute buffer is erased by the next replay; keep such a refinement in a buffer the apply cycle does not fill.

types.name: GlyphResolutionModifier
types.summary: Raises the atlas tile resolution of the glyphs in its range by up to two size classes above the font default. Grow-only and shared: the atlas key ignores tile size, so every component that shows the glyph reads one tile at the highest boost any range requested, and the tile only ever grows.
types.remarks: Cost scales with the promoted tile: each class up is ~4× the tile memory (a +2 glyph is 16× a 64px one), and a promoted glyph stays large while referenced (reclaimed by eviction once unused). Scope it to the glyphs that need the crispness (a heading, an emphasized word), not whole paragraphs. Parameter form: resolutionBoost (0–2), defaulting to the serialized field.
attributes: TypeDescription("Raises atlas tile resolution for the glyphs in range (grow-only, shared).")

properties.name: ResolutionBoost
properties.summary: Size-class boost applied to the glyph's tile: 0 = font default, 1/2 = one/two classes crisper. Grow-only and shared across components.

types.name: IMarkupValue
types.summary: A serializable parameter value with a custom single-token markup form. Implement on a struct used as a [[ParameterAttribute]] field so the inspector and markup round-trip it through one token (e.g. a colour-or-swatch, or a mode-plus-value union). The editor discovers this by interface, so a user-defined modifier can add its own parameter types without touching the package. Simple types (numbers, enums, colours, [[UnitValue]]) don't need this — they round-trip generically.

methods.name: ToToken
methods.summary: Serialize to the markup token (empty string for the default/unset form).

methods.name: FromToken
methods.summary: Restore from a markup token — as produced by [[ToToken]] or authored in markup.

types.name: IModifierCommitChanges
types.summary: Declares which observable outputs a modifier changes when reapplied.

properties.name: CommitChanges
properties.summary: Output categories changed by this modifier.

types.name: IModifierRuleWeightReceiver
types.summary: Receives the normalized weight of a transient modifier application.

methods.name: SetRuleWeight
methods.summary: Sets the weight used by subsequent range applications in the current pass.

types.name: IndentModifier
types.summary: Adds left indentation that begins where the tag opens and persists across wrapped lines until the tag closes.
types.remarks: Two complementary mechanisms produce a continuous visual indent: Every line whose first codepoint falls inside the tagged range is pushed right by the resolved value (line-start margin). If the tag opens in the middle of a line (i.e. the codepoint preceding the tag is not a mandatory line break), the advance of that previous codepoint is widened by the indent so that content following the open boundary visibly shifts right within the current line. As soon as the tag closes, subsequent codepoints carry no extra indent, so the next line wraps back to the container edge. Indents from overlapping or nested ranges accumulate, so writing <indent=1em>outer <indent=1em>inner</indent></indent> indents the inner content by two ems. Negative values pull the line back, which can be used to outdent a nested run or to balance an outer indent. Parameter — single value with optional unit: 20 or 20px — layout units; like every other UniText geometric modifier these scale together with auto-sized text. 1.5em — multiplied by the current shaping font size. 10% — fraction of the host RectTransform's width, resolved into render space using the active glyph scale so the on-screen indent stays at the requested percentage with or without auto-size. Ignored when the rect has no finite width. +5 / -5 — explicit delta. Functionally identical to the unsigned form because indents always compose additively.
attributes: TypeDescription("Indents content from the tag opening through every wrapped line within the range.")

properties.name: Indent
properties.summary: Left indent added across the range. A per-range value overrides it.

types.name: InstantPlayback
types.summary: Applies the target contribution immediately and removes it immediately on exit.
attributes: TypeDescription("Instant: switch to the target value without interpolation")

types.name: InteractionRangeStateSelector
types.summary: Matches required and excluded built-in interaction signals.
attributes: TypeDescription("Interaction signals: required/excluded Hovered, Pressed, Focused, Disabled")

properties.name: Required
properties.summary: Signals that must all be true.

properties.name: Excluded
properties.summary: Signals that must all be false.

types.name: InteractionSignalMask
types.summary: Built-in boolean flags addressable without a custom selector subclass.

fields.name: None
fields.summary: No condition.

fields.name: Hovered
fields.summary: Hovered must match.

fields.name: Pressed
fields.summary: Pressed must match.

fields.name: Focused
fields.summary: Focused must match.

fields.name: Disabled
fields.summary: Disabled must match.

types.name: IntRuleValue
types.summary: Int ParameterRule target.

types.name: IParameterOps<TValue>
types.summary: Provides one parameter value type's parsing, interpolation, and arithmetic contract; reported capabilities remain stable for the provider's lifetime.

methods.name: Lerp
methods.summary: Interpolates from from to to at normalized progress, with zero selecting the former and one selecting the latter.

methods.name: Add
methods.summary: Combines the current and owned values when [[CanAdd]] is true.

methods.name: Multiply
methods.summary: Combines the current and owned values when [[CanMultiply]] is true.

methods.name: TryParse
methods.summary: Attempts to parse one value, returning fallback through value on failure.

properties.name: CanAdd
properties.summary: Whether additive composition and its identity are supported.

properties.name: CanMultiply
properties.summary: Whether multiplicative composition and its identity are supported.

properties.name: AddIdentity
properties.summary: Owned value that leaves the current value unchanged under [[Add]] when [[CanAdd]] is true.

properties.name: MultiplyIdentity
properties.summary: Owned value that leaves the current value unchanged under [[Multiply]] when [[CanMultiply]] is true.

types.name: ItalicMode
types.summary: How italic is realized. Auto prefers a real italic face and shears synthetically only when none exists; the others force one behaviour.

fields.name: Auto
fields.summary: Prefer a real italic face (family cut, variable ital/slnt axis, OS fallback); shear synthetically only if none exists.

fields.name: Synthetic
fields.summary: Always shear by [[slant]] percent of height, ignoring real faces.

fields.name: FontSlant
fields.summary: Shear synthetically using the run font's own [[ItalicStyle]].

fields.name: RealOnly
fields.summary: Use a real italic face only; leave the text upright when none is available.

types.name: ItalicModifier
types.summary: Renders italic by slanting glyphs. Tags: <i> = auto, <i=20> = synthetic shear of 20% of height, <i=f> = the run font's own slant, <i=r> = a real italic face only.
attributes: TypeDescription("Slants glyphs to italic. Prefers a real italic face; a parameter forces synthetic shear or real-only.")

properties.name: Style
properties.summary: Gets or sets the complete italic configuration.

properties.name: Mode
properties.summary: How italic is realized. A per-range value overrides it; this is the default for a bare tag or whole-text use.

properties.name: Slant
properties.summary: Synthetic shear in percent of height (−100…100; 30 leans the top right by 0.30 of the height, ≈16.7°, not 30°), applied when [[Mode]] is [[Synthetic]]. A per-range value overrides it.

types.name: ItalicStyle
types.summary: Italic choice: a mode plus, for [[Synthetic]], a shear percentage. Serializes to a single markup token — empty for auto, the percentage for synthetic, f for font-slant, r for real-only.

types.name: LanguageModifier
types.summary: Applies a BCP 47 language tag to a text range for OpenType-aware shaping.
types.remarks: The language tag is forwarded to HarfBuzz as hb_language_t, which drives the OpenType locl (Localized Forms) GSUB feature. This is essential for pan-CJK fonts such as Noto Sans CJK and Source Han Sans, where a single code point renders with different region-specific glyphs (Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Japanese, Korean) depending on the language tag. Common tags: zh-Hans, zh-Hant, zh-HK, ja, ko, en, ar, he. HarfBuzz converts BCP 47 to OpenType language tags automatically (zh-Hans → ZHS, ja → JAN, etc.). Apply to the entire text via Style.WholeText for a global default, or per-range via the rich-text tag <lang=zh-Hans>...</lang> for mixed-language content.
attributes: TypeDescription("Applies a BCP 47 language tag that activates OpenType 'locl' region-specific glyph variants (critical for CJK).")

properties.name: Language
properties.summary: BCP 47 language tag. A per-range <lang=…> value overrides it; this is the default for a bare tag or whole-text use.

types.name: LetterSpacingModifier
types.summary: Applies character spacing (tracking) adjustments to text ranges.
types.remarks: Parameter: spacing value with unit. 10 — add 10 pixels between characters -5 — reduce spacing by 5 pixels 0.5em — add 0.5 em (relative to font size) Overlapping ranges resolve innermost-wins and never compound, across modifiers as well as across nested tags: one tracking value reaches each character, whichever range set it. For cursive joining scripts (Arabic, Syriac, N'Ko, Adlam, etc.), visual kashida (tatweel) bars are rendered between connected letter pairs using 9-slice SDF rendering, preserving the appearance of cursive connections at any spacing value.

properties.name: Spacing
properties.summary: Extra tracking between characters used when a range does not override it.

types.name: LineHeightModifier
types.summary: Sets each line's height, per paragraph.
types.remarks: Parameters (comma-separated): Value, Mode, Scale, Leading — all optional. Mode: content (grow to the tallest font on the line — default), primary (primary font only, so fallback glyphs never enlarge the line), or scaled (exactly Scale × fontSize). Value: optional nudge on top of the mode — 150% or 1.5em (multiplier), 40 (absolute pixels), +10 / -5 (delta pixels). A bare number is pixels, not a multiplier; 0 or empty means no nudge. Scale: the multiplier for scaled mode; ignored otherwise. Leading: how extra spacing is split — halfLeading (CSS), leadingAbove (Figma), leadingBelow (Android). To set a later parameter without the earlier ones, leave them empty: <lh=,primary>, <lh=,scaled,2>. When several ranges set an absolute height on a line, the largest wins.
attributes: TypeDescription("Adjusts the vertical spacing between lines.")

properties.name: HeightValue
properties.summary: Optional height nudge on top of the mode (multiplier, absolute px, or delta). A per-range value overrides it.

properties.name: Mode
properties.summary: How the base line height is derived. A per-range value overrides it.

properties.name: Scale
properties.summary: Multiplier used in [[Scaled]] mode.

properties.name: Leading
properties.summary: How extra line spacing is split above/below the text.

types.name: ListItemInfo
types.summary: Contains information about a single list item for rendering.

types.name: ListMarkerPlacement
types.summary: Controls how the list marker is placed relative to the content.

fields.name: Inside
fields.summary: Marker takes inline space at the line start; content begins immediately past the marker, so items with different marker widths (e.g. 1. and 10.) start at different positions. Default — matches Google Docs, MS Word, and Discord visual behavior. Equivalent to CSS list-style-position: inside. Direction-aware: the marker sits on the leading side of the line for both LTR and RTL paragraphs.

fields.name: Outside
fields.summary: Marker is aligned against a fixed content column — its trailing edge meets the content start, so all items have content at the same position regardless of marker width. Markers wider than the reserved column hang past the line start into the leading margin (left in LTR paragraphs, right in RTL). Equivalent to CSS list-style-position: outside. Use when a strictly aligned content column is required and the indent is wide enough to fit the widest marker.

types.name: ListModifier
types.summary: Renders list markers (bullets or numbers) for text items with automatic indentation.
types.remarks: Parameter: optional level:number for numbered lists. Without parameter, renders a bullet. Features: - Supports nested lists with configurable indentation per level - Bullet markers are customizable per nesting level - Ordered lists support decimal, alphabetic, and Roman numeral styles - Automatically handles RTL text direction
attributes: TypeDescription("Formats text as a bulleted or numbered list.")

properties.name: Level
properties.summary: Nesting level default. A per-range value overrides it; this is the default for a bare tag or whole-text use.

properties.name: Number
properties.summary: Display number for ordered items; -1 renders a bullet. A per-range value overrides it; this is the default for a bare tag or whole-text use.

properties.name: MarkerPlacement
properties.summary: Places markers inline or against a fixed content column. Changing it reflows the list.

types.name: LowercaseModifier
types.summary: Transforms text to lowercase within marked ranges.
types.remarks: No parameter. The transformation happens during Apply, after parsing but before shaping, ensuring correct glyph rendering for lowercase characters. Uses the bundled UCD case mapping table rather than char.ToLowerInvariant to avoid runtime gaps in Mono/IL2CPP.

types.name: ManualPlayback
types.summary: Leaves parameter handles under project control. External tween/Animator/Playable code uses [[GetParameter{TModifier,TValue}]] and releases the instance.
attributes: TypeDescription("Manual: external code owns parameter values and lifetime")

types.name: MaterialGlyphContext
types.summary: Per-glyph context passed to [[glyphDataWriter]] and [[OnWriteGlyphUV]].

fields.name: glyphIndexInSelection
fields.summary: Monotonic 0-based index of this glyph across all ranges selected by this modifier in the current rebuild. Useful for staggered per-glyph animations. Not reset between ranges.

types.name: MaterialModifier
types.summary: Applies a user-authored [[Material]] to a text range by emitting a dedicated sub-mesh with its own CanvasRenderer.
types.remarks: The custom shader must include UniText_Custom.cginc — see Assets/Create/UniText/Custom Material Shader for a working template. The glyph atlases are global shader bindings and must NOT appear in the shader's Properties block; per-glyph user data is written into TEXCOORD2 / TEXCOORD3 (see [[constantUv2]], [[constantUv3]], [[glyphDataWriter]] and [[OnWriteGlyphUV]]). Default [[renderOrder]] is [[Replace]]: the base pass is suppressed on the range (the face quad is claimed and not recorded into the main mesh). Use [[Keep]] to keep the base pass and stack the custom material as its own layer, ordered by this modifier's position in Styles. Parameter: optional tint color. Format: <mat=#RRGGBBAA> or <mat=red>. The tint multiplies the vertex color that the shader receives. Replace suppresses the base face structurally: the glyph's base quad is not recorded, so the result is independent of where the modifier sits among other Styles. Paint layers (stroke, shadow, glow) are separate quads at their own sequence and still render over/under it. Emoji glyphs are handled identically to text — the unified vertex-mode contract lets the one custom material render every glyph mode.
attributes: TypeDescription("Applies a custom Material to a text range via a dedicated sub-mesh and CanvasRenderer.")

methods.name: OnWriteGlyphUV
methods.summary: Override to write per-glyph data into the sub-mesh's TEXCOORD2 / TEXCOORD3. Called once per included glyph. Default implementation returns [[constantUv2]] / [[constantUv3]].
methods.remarks: Ignored when [[glyphDataWriter]] is set. Marked virtual instead of abstract so that a basic [[MaterialModifier]] with only inspector-level configuration is usable as-is without subclassing.

properties.name: Material
properties.summary: Custom material applied to this modifier's ranges.
attributes: Tooltip("Custom material to apply to the range. The shader must include UniText_Custom.cginc.")

properties.name: RenderOrder
properties.summary: How the custom material composes with the base text pass.
attributes: Tooltip("How the custom material composes with the base text pass. Replace suppresses the base pass on the range.")

properties.name: SortIndex
properties.summary: Tie-break used to order this modifier's sub-mesh.
attributes: Tooltip("Tie-break for this modifier's sub-mesh (lower renders first). Order relative to other modifiers follows their position in Styles.")

properties.name: ConstantUv2
properties.summary: Constant TEXCOORD2 value written to every glyph vertex.
attributes: Tooltip("Constant value written to TEXCOORD2 of every glyph vertex in the sub-mesh.")

properties.name: ConstantUv3
properties.summary: Constant TEXCOORD3 value written to every glyph vertex.
attributes: Tooltip("Constant value written to TEXCOORD3 of every glyph vertex in the sub-mesh.")

properties.name: QuadPaddingOverride
properties.summary: Optional em-space expansion applied to emitted glyph quads.
attributes:
Tooltip("Expand each glyph quad outward by this many em-units so shader effects (glow, edge, etc.) " +
                 "aren't clipped by the glyph's tight bounding box. Negative = read from shader's " +
                 "_UniTextMeshPadding property (shader-driven default).")

properties.name: CloneMaterial
properties.summary: Whether the source material is cloned before UniText binds runtime state.
attributes:
Tooltip("When true (default) the material is cloned via UniTextCustomMaterialCache so runtime " +
                 "keyword / texture changes are isolated from the source asset and other usages. " +
                 "When false the source material is used directly — shader property edits (material.SetColor " +
                 "etc.) are reflected immediately across all MaterialModifiers that reference it. " +
                 "The atlas textures are bound automatically in both modes.")

properties.name: Tint
properties.summary: Color multiplied into vertices emitted for this modifier.

properties.name: UseVirtualWriter
properties.summary: When true, [[OnQuadAppended]] calls [[OnWriteGlyphUV]] even if [[glyphDataWriter]] is null. Set to in subclasses that override [[OnWriteGlyphUV]].

fields.name: glyphDataWriter
fields.summary: Optional per-glyph data writer. Takes precedence over [[OnWriteGlyphUV]].

types.name: MaterialRenderOrder
types.summary: Controls whether the custom material replaces the base text pass on the range or renders alongside it.

fields.name: Replace
fields.summary: Base text pass is suppressed on the range (the face quad is not recorded into the main mesh); only the custom material shows.

fields.name: Keep
fields.summary: Base text pass is kept; the custom material renders as its own layer, stacked by this modifier's position in Styles.

types.name: MathMode
types.summary: Controls the initial OpenType math style used for a formula.

fields.name: Inline
fields.summary: Uses compact text-style fractions, operators, and limits.

fields.name: Display
fields.summary: Uses display-style fractions, large operators, and stacked limits.

types.name: MathModifier
types.summary: Typesets formulas captured by [[MathParseRule]] with metrics and stretchy glyphs from a dedicated OpenType MATH font.
attributes: TypeDescription("Typesets formulas from MathParseRule with an OpenType MATH font.")

types.name: ModifierBufferExtensions
types.summary: Extension methods for working with modifier attribute buffers.

methods.name: HasFlag
methods.summary: Checks if a byte flag is set at the specified index.

methods.name: HasAnyFlags
methods.summary: Checks if any flags are set in the buffer.

methods.name: HasFlag
methods.summary: Checks if a ushort flag is set at the specified index.

methods.name: HasAnyFlags
methods.summary: Checks if any ushort flags are set in the buffer.

methods.name: SetFlagRange
methods.summary: Sets byte flags for a range of indices.

methods.name: HasValue
methods.summary: Checks if a uint value is non-zero at the specified index.

methods.name: GetValueOrDefault
methods.summary: Gets a uint value or returns 0 if out of bounds.

methods.name: SetValueRange
methods.summary: Sets uint values for a range of indices.

types.name: ModifierGraphModifier
types.summary: Modifier node that instantiates and forwards to a [[ModifierGraphPreset]] while preserving the ordinary modifier lifecycle, parameters, effects and graph traversal.
attributes: TypeDescription("Modifier graph preset: reuse one appearance or state recipe with any source")

properties.name: Preset
properties.summary: Shared authored recipe instantiated for this modifier owner.

types.name: ModifierGraphPreset
types.summary: Shareable modifier-only recipe that can be paired with different range sources through [[ModifierGraphModifier]]. Runtime consumers instantiate the asset so modifier ownership and transient state never leak between UniText components.

methods.name: Validate
methods.summary: Validates the complete authored graph, including topology, nested presets, channels, actions, effects, and property bindings.

properties.name: Root
properties.summary: Root modifier or Composite applied by every reference to this recipe.

events.name: Changed
events.summary: Occurs when Inspector or code changes this recipe.

events.name: NodeChanged
events.summary: Raised with exact affected-node, member, and replay context.

types.name: ModifierGraphPresetChange
types.summary: Describes one exact structural or nested state transition in a modifier graph preset.

properties.name: Modifier
properties.summary: Gets the affected authored modifier node.

properties.name: Source
properties.summary: Gets the replayable node that owns [[Member]], when scalar replay is available.

properties.name: Member
properties.summary: Gets the exact generated member token for a nested scalar transition.

properties.name: Flags
properties.summary: Gets the modifier-owned consequence of the changed parameter.

properties.name: Structural
properties.summary: Gets whether modifier graph topology changed.

types.name: ModifierKey<TModifier>
types.summary: Stable typed modifier-node reference used by code-first rule lookup.

methods.name: ModifierKey
methods.summary: Addresses the supplied modifier within the rule owner's graph.

types.name: ModifierNodeId
types.summary: Stable identity of one node within its modifier graph.

properties.name: IsValid
properties.summary: Whether this identity has been assigned.

types.name: ModifierParameters
types.summary: Carries source output and source defaults separately until a concrete modifier consumes them. Composites project both layers by child without materializing a merged string.

methods.name: GetReader
methods.summary: Reads resolved tokens using explicit values before source defaults.

types.name: ModifierRange
types.summary: One materialized range of a modifier: the working unit whose parameters resolve through the cascade and can be taken into ownership.
types.remarks: Obtained from [[GetRanges]]. The range stays addressable across text edits for as long as the parser preserves its [[Identity]]; an edit inside the range retires the identity, and ownership taken on it is released.

methods.name: Units
methods.summary: This range's units of unit granularity, in logical order, each clipped to [[Range]]. Enumerating allocates nothing.

exceptions.description: The range's modifier is not attached to a text component.

methods.name: CountUnits
methods.summary: How many units of unit granularity this range holds. A unit the range only partly covers counts as one.

exceptions.description: The range's modifier is not attached to a text component.

methods.name: Own
methods.summary: Takes one parameter of this range into ownership. The owned value composes on the cascade result under composition until the handle is released or the range's identity retires.

methods.name: Resolve
methods.summary: Resolves one parameter of this range: cascade plus owned values.

properties.name: Modifier
properties.summary: The modifier whose application produced this range.

properties.name: Identity
properties.summary: Stable source-scoped identity of the entity.

properties.name: Segment
properties.summary: The concrete segment of the entity this range covers.

properties.name: Range
properties.summary: Covered codepoint range in rendered text space.

properties.name: PrimaryValue
properties.summary: Opaque semantic value emitted by the source, or null.

properties.name: Label
properties.summary: The #label anchor authored on the range's tag, or null.

properties.name: Channel
properties.summary: Optional project asset used for semantic routing.

properties.name: IsValid
properties.summary: Whether this instance addresses a parsed range.

types.name: ModifierRule
types.summary: Adds a modifier template only while its selector or event playback is active.
attributes: TypeDescription("Modifier rule: apply a transient modifier or Composite to matching ranges")

properties.name: ModifierTemplate
properties.summary: Transient modifier graph applied to active entity segments.

properties.name: DirtyStage
properties.summary: Minimum invalidation needed by the transient graph.

types.name: NoBreakModifier
types.summary: Keeps the tagged range together as one word — no soft break is taken inside it.
types.remarks: The range takes no soft, CJK, or dictionary break inside it, so it moves whole to the next line when it does not fit. Wrapping stays allowed immediately before and after it, so it behaves as a single word — and, like any word, a range wider than the text box still breaks to fit rather than overflowing. Applied to the character span of a visible markup tag (via a [[ChromeRule]]), it makes the tag a cohesive word. Pair with a [[TagRule]] (conventional tag name nobr): uniText.Styles.Add(Style.Tag(new NoBreakModifier(), "nobr")).
attributes: TypeDescription("Keeps the range together as one unbreakable word (white-space: nowrap).")

types.name: NotRangeStateSelector
types.summary: Negates one child selector.
attributes: TypeDescription("Not: logical negation of one selector")

properties.name: Selector
properties.summary: Predicate whose result is negated.

types.name: OrderedMarkerStyle
types.summary: Specifies the numbering style for ordered list markers.

fields.name: Decimal
fields.summary: Decimal numbers (1, 2, 3...)

fields.name: LowerAlpha
fields.summary: Lowercase letters (a, b, c...)

fields.name: UpperAlpha
fields.summary: Uppercase letters (A, B, C...)

fields.name: LowerRoman
fields.summary: Lowercase Roman numerals (i, ii, iii...)

fields.name: UpperRoman
fields.summary: Uppercase Roman numerals (I, II, III...)

types.name: OwnedParameter<TValue>
types.summary: Ownership of one parameter on one materialized range. The owned value composes on the range's cascade result under [[Composition]]; releasing the handle — or the range's identity retiring with a text edit — returns the parameter to its cascade.
types.remarks: Writing changes only this ownership; the serialized modifier field and other ranges keep their values. Members other than [[IsAlive]] and [[Release]] throw [[ObjectDisposedException]] once the ownership is dead.

methods.name: Release
methods.summary: Releases the ownership; the parameter falls back to its cascade. Idempotent.

properties.name: Value
properties.summary: The owned value.

properties.name: Baseline
properties.summary: The cascade result beneath this ownership.

properties.name: Composition
properties.summary: How the owned value combines with the cascade result.

properties.name: IsAlive
properties.summary: Whether the ownership still holds.

types.name: OwnedParameterSet<TModifier, TValue>
types.summary: Standing ownership of one parameter across every range its query currently matches. The set re-materializes after each parse: ranges that stop matching release their owned value, newly matching ranges receive the broadcast [[Value]], surviving ranges keep theirs, and members follow text order.
types.remarks: Obtained from [[Own{TModifier,TValue}]]. Per-member values written through [[SetValue]] live until the next parse; a driver distributing values re-applies them from [[Changed]].

methods.name: GetRange
methods.summary: Returns the member at a text-order index.

methods.name: SetValue
methods.summary: Writes one member's owned value; it lives until the next parse re-materializes the set.

methods.name: Withhold
methods.summary: Deactivates every member's owned value without releasing membership: the parameters fall back to their cascades or other owners until values are written again.

methods.name: Release
methods.summary: Releases every owned value; the parameters fall back to their cascades. Idempotent.

properties.name: Query
properties.summary: The query selecting this set's members.

properties.name: Parameter
properties.summary: The parameter this set owns on every member.

properties.name: IsAlive
properties.summary: Whether the set still owns its members.

properties.name: Count
properties.summary: Number of members in the current parse, in text order.

properties.name: Value
properties.summary: The value owned on every member. Setting it broadcasts to current members and to every member a later parse adds; reading returns the last broadcast value.

events.name: Changed
events.summary: Occurs after membership re-materialized against a new parse.

types.name: ParagraphSpacingModifier
types.summary: Adds vertical spacing between paragraphs (text separated by line breaks).
types.remarks: Parameters (comma-separated): After, Before — both optional. After opens a gap below each covered paragraph, Before above it; where two paragraphs meet the values add up (no CSS-style margin collapsing). Nothing is added at the block edges. Units: 10 (pixels), 50% or 0.5em (× font size). Negative values pull the neighbouring paragraphs together, down to full overlap; the gap never inverts. When several ranges cover one paragraph, the largest value per side wins.

properties.name: After
properties.summary: Gap opened below each covered paragraph. A per-range value overrides it.

properties.name: Before
properties.summary: Gap opened above each covered paragraph. A per-range value overrides it.

types.name: ParameterComposition
types.summary: Deterministic operation combining an owned value with a parameter's cascade result.

fields.name: Replace
fields.summary: The owned value fully replaces the cascade result; highest priority wins.

fields.name: Add
fields.summary: Owned values add to the cascade result in stable order.

fields.name: Multiply
fields.summary: Owned values multiply the cascade result in stable order.

fields.name: Custom
fields.summary: The descriptor's declared custom operation.

types.name: ParameterCompositions
types.summary: Composition capabilities a parameter supports.

types.name: ParameterDescriptor
types.summary: One modifier parameter: the unit through which markup tokens, rule defaults, the modifier field, and per-range ownership resolve to a single value.
types.remarks: A descriptor is a static identity declared once per (modifier type, parameter) in the modifier's nested Param class and aggregated by [[Descriptors]]. The cascade resolves, weakest first: the modifier field, the rule's default token, the explicit markup token, and finally owned values composed on top. Its invalidation is the field's own declared change notification, so a write through any stage raises exactly what a field write raises.

methods.name: Invalidate
methods.summary: Raises the owning modifier's declared invalidation for this parameter.

methods.name: Concat
methods.summary: Concatenates an inherited descriptor set with a declaring type's own, inherited first.

methods.name: Find
methods.summary: Finds a descriptor by [[Id]] in a modifier's declared set, or null.

methods.name: From
methods.summary: Creates a slotted descriptor: the markup slot is the accessor's position among marked parameter accessors, reordered to the markup contract — own-type fields first, then base-type fields.

methods.name: From
methods.summary: Creates a slotless descriptor for a parameter with no markup presence.

methods.name: Custom
methods.summary: Creates a descriptor over explicit delegates, for parameters whose root lives in nested state rather than a direct field of the modifier.

methods.name: FromEnum
methods.summary: Creates a slotted descriptor for an enum parameter, parsed by member name or unique initial.

methods.name: FromEnum
methods.summary: Creates a slotless descriptor for an enum parameter with no markup presence.

methods.name: SlotOn
methods.summary: Positional markup slot of this parameter on modifier's concrete type. A subclass's own parameters precede inherited ones in the markup contract, so a base-declared parameter sits later on a subclass range than [[Slot]] says.

properties.name: Id
properties.summary: Stable identifier persisted by rule bindings — the backing field name.

properties.name: DisplayName
properties.summary: Human-readable name for editor surfaces.

properties.name: Slot
properties.summary: Positional markup slot, or -1 when the parameter has no markup presence.

properties.name: ValueType
properties.summary: Concrete value type.

properties.name: ModifierType
properties.summary: Modifier type declaring this parameter.

properties.name: SupportedCompositions
properties.summary: Operations owned values may compose with.

fields.name: None
fields.summary: Shared empty descriptor set.

types.name: ParameterDescriptor<TModifier, TValue>
types.summary: Typed descriptor of one TModifier parameter.

methods.name: WithCustom
methods.summary: Declares the custom composition operation and its neutral element.

methods.name: WithOperations
methods.summary: Replaces the value type's default parsing, interpolation, and arithmetic contract while preserving any declared parser and custom composition.

exceptions.description: operations is null.

methods.name: WithParser
methods.summary: Declares this parameter's own markup-token vocabulary in place of the type's default parsing.

methods.name: ReadRoot
methods.summary: Reads the root (field) value.

methods.name: SetRoot
methods.summary: Writes the root (field) value through the modifier's own transition.

methods.name: Resolve
methods.summary: Resolves the full cascade for one applied range: explicit markup token, rule default, modifier field — then owned values composed on top.

methods.name: ResolveCascade
methods.summary: Resolves markup token, rule default and field — without owned values.

methods.name: ApplyOwned
methods.summary: Composes the owned values of one range on top of its cascade result.

methods.name: ResolveNext
methods.summary: Resolves one slot at the reader's current position — for parsers whose token stream carries a prefix the fixed slot index cannot express. Advances the reader by one slot.

methods.name: TryResolve
methods.summary: Resolves like [[Resolve]] and reports whether the value was set for the range — by a markup token, a rule default, or ownership — rather than falling back to the root.

methods.name: Lerp
methods.summary: Interpolates between two values under this parameter's type contract.

methods.name: Compose
methods.summary: Combines one owned value with the running result, or throws when unsupported.

methods.name: Identity
methods.summary: Returns the neutral owned value for a composition, or throws when unsupported.

types.name: ParameterReader
types.summary: Steady-state allocation-free tokenizer for comma-separated modifier parameters, including quoted tokens and escaped delimiters.

methods.name: Next
methods.summary: Reads the next comma-delimited token after quote and escape decoding.

methods.name: Next
methods.summary: Reads the next token and reports whether the slot was explicitly set. A bare empty slot is unset; "" and '' are set empty strings.

methods.name: TryPeek
methods.summary: Reads the next comma-delimited token (trimmed) without consuming it — a following [[Next]] returns the same token. Returns false if no tokens remain. The optional-slot idiom: peek, test, and call [[Next]] only on a match, so a non-matching token flows to the following slot instead of being eaten.

methods.name: TryPeekOptional
methods.summary: Peek for an optional positional slot. An explicitly-empty slot (a bare comma) is a positional skip: it is consumed here and reported as absent (returns ). A non-empty token is left in place — the caller tests it and either claims it with [[Next]] or lets it flow to the following slot. Centralizes the empty-skip so a leading empty slot can never silently shift the remaining positional values.

methods.name: ParseFloat
methods.summary: Parses a span as float using InvariantCulture. For pre-extracted tokens where Next() was already called. NaN is recognized explicitly (the inherit sentinel of override tokens) — runtimes disagree on whether float.TryParse accepts it.

methods.name: NextFloat
methods.summary: Reads the next token as a float. Returns false if missing or unparseable; on failure value is left at defaultValue.

methods.name: NextVector2
methods.summary: Reads the next token as a space-separated "x y" vector; each unparseable axis keeps defaultValue's. Returns false when the token is missing/empty.

methods.name: NextInt
methods.summary: Reads the next token as an int. Returns false if missing or unparseable; on failure value is left at defaultValue.

methods.name: NextColor
methods.summary: Reads the next token as a Color32 via [[ColorParsing]]. Returns false if missing or unparseable; on failure value is left at defaultValue.

methods.name: NextEnum
methods.summary: Reads the next token as a value of enum T. Matches the full enum-member name case-insensitively; for single-character tokens, also matches against the first letter of any member whose initial is unique within the enum (e.g. r → Radial when no other member starts with R). Members whose initial collides with another member's keep working under their full name but lose the short alias. Returns false if missing or unmatched; on failure value is left at defaultValue.

methods.name: NextUnitFloat
methods.summary: Reads the next token as a float with an optional unit suffix. Missing or unparseable → defaultValue, [[Absolute]], false.

methods.name: NextUnitFloat
methods.summary: Reads the next unit token, falling back to fallback's value and unit when absent/unparseable. The fallback's unit is also the default coordinate space for a suffix-less number.
methods.returns: only when a token was parsed; the fallback is still written to the output values when this returns.

methods.name: NextUnitVector2
methods.summary: Reads the next token as a space-separated "x y" vector where each axis may carry a unit suffix (0.1em -0.1em). The reported unit is [[Em]] if either axis is em; every other combination resolves to [[Absolute]]. Missing/empty token keeps defaultValue and returns false.

methods.name: NextUnitVector2
methods.summary: Reads the next unit-vector token, falling back to fallback's value and unit when absent. The fallback's unit is also the default coordinate space for a suffix-less axis.
methods.returns: only when a token was parsed; the fallback is still written to the output values when this returns.

methods.name: NextString
methods.summary: Reads the next token as a string (allocates). Returns false if missing or empty.

properties.name: IsEmpty

types.name: RubyModifier
types.summary: Sets ruby (furigana) — small annotation text placed above a base run to show its reading or meaning, as used in Japanese and other East-Asian typography.
types.remarks: Pair it with [[RubyParseRule]] for standard markup <ruby>漢字<rt>かんじ</rt></ruby> and the shorthand <ruby=かんじ>漢字</ruby>: uniText.Styles.Add(new Style { Source = new RubyParseRule(), Modifier = new RubyModifier() }). The reading reaches the modifier as the range parameter, so any rule that supplies one works. A single base+reading is group-ruby; several <rt> segments give mono-ruby (one reading per character): <ruby>東<rt>とう</rt>京<rt>きょう</rt></ruby>. Layout follows CSS Ruby / JIS X 4051: the annotation is half the base size by default and is centered over the base. When the annotation is narrower than the base it is distributed by [[Align]] (default [[SpaceAround]] — the JIS 1:2:1 rule); when it is wider, the base columns are spread to fit it. The annotation raises the line height of the rows it sits on, so allow clearance above the first line (top padding or vertical centering). Horizontal, line-over annotations on left-to-right base text.
attributes: TypeDescription("Adds ruby (furigana) annotations above the base text.")

types.name: SubMeshModifier
types.summary: Base class for modifiers that emit a separate, owner-controlled sub-mesh rendered by its own CanvasRenderer with a user-supplied material (see [[MaterialModifier]]).
types.remarks: Lifecycle per frame: onRebuildStart — own buffers are cleared; any persistent state (e.g. Replace-mode claim of the base face) will be re-applied in the next onGlyph pass. The geometry-consumer tail of onGlyph — subclass overrides [[ShouldIncludeCurrentGlyph]] and, when true, the base class copies the completed face quad (4 verts) from the generator into its own buffer. SDF, MSDF and emoji glyphs share it — the per-glyph mode rides the vertex stream (UV1.w), so one material renders them all. onCollectSubMeshes — the base class appends one entry to the render-data list, with the material, order and sort index chosen by the subclass. Compared to [[EffectModifier]], which bakes its duplicates into the same mesh as the face pass, [[SubMeshModifier]] keeps its vertices in isolated local buffers because each sub-mesh is bound to a distinct material and CanvasRenderer.
