methods.summary: Publishes a signal for one concrete segment and updates entity aggregates.

methods.name: SetSignal
methods.summary: Publishes one entity-scoped signal to every current rule entity on a channel.

methods.name: SetSignalForAll
methods.summary: Publishes one entity-scoped signal to every current rule entity on this text.

methods.name: AdvanceManual
methods.summary: Advances only built-in drivers configured with the Manual clock.

methods.name: Own
methods.summary: Takes one parameter of a materialized range into ownership. The owned value composes on the range's cascade result under composition until the handle is released or the range's identity retires with a text edit.

methods.name: Own
methods.summary: Takes standing ownership of one parameter across every range the query matches, now and after every future parse; release the set to return them all to their cascades.

properties.name: Text
properties.summary: Text component whose ranges and modifiers this runtime resolves.

properties.name: PrefersReducedMotion
properties.summary: Whether built-in drivers collapse decorative timing to an immediate result.

events.name: RuleEntered
events.summary: Occurs after a driver's Enter callback for an externally observable playback.

events.name: RuleExited
events.summary: Occurs after a driver's Exit callback for an externally observable playback.

events.name: RuleUpdated
events.summary: Occurs when matched scalar or custom signals change without a selector edge.

events.name: RuleTriggered
events.summary: Occurs for an Activated or ContextRequested one-shot playback.

types.name: UnitKind
types.summary: Unit a numeric parameter value is expressed in.

fields.name: Absolute
fields.summary: Absolute pixels or a raw axis value (24; explicit 24px / 24abs).

fields.name: Percent
fields.summary: Percentage of the base value (150%).

fields.name: Em
fields.summary: Multiple of the em / font size (0.5em).

fields.name: Delta
fields.summary: Signed pixel delta relative to the base (+10 / -5 when the context default is absolute; explicit 10delta).

types.name: UnitRuleValue
types.summary: UnitValue ParameterRule target.

types.name: UnitValue
types.summary: A numeric parameter value paired with the unit it is expressed in — the serialized form of a unit token (24, 150%, 0.5em, +10). Used as a modifier field type so the authoring default carries both number and unit in one place.

methods.name: ResolvePx
methods.summary: Resolves to pixels against emSize (the font size): em multiplies, absolute/delta pass through.

methods.name: ResolvePx
methods.summary: Loose value/unit overload for values read via ParameterReader.NextUnitFloat.

types.name: UnitVector2
types.summary: A [[Vector2]] parameter value with a shared unit for both axes (e.g. 0.1em -0.1em).

types.name: UnitVector2RuleValue
types.summary: UnitVector2 ParameterRule target.

types.name: UppercaseModifier
types.summary: Transforms text to uppercase within marked ranges.
types.remarks: No parameter. The transformation happens during Apply, after parsing but before shaping, ensuring correct glyph rendering for uppercase characters. Uses the bundled UCD case mapping table rather than char.ToUpperInvariant to avoid runtime gaps in Mono/IL2CPP (e.g. Greek final sigma U+03C2 → Σ).

types.name: VariationModifier
types.summary: Controls variable font axis values per text range.
types.remarks: Parameter: positional axis values in order wght, wdth, ital, slnt, opsz. Use ~ to skip an axis. Each value supports absolute, percentage, or delta: 700 — absolute axis value 150% — percentage of font's default +200 — delta from font's default Examples: 700, ~,80, 700,~,~,-12
attributes: TypeDescription("Controls variable font axis values (weight, width, italic, slant, optical size).")

properties.name: Weight
properties.summary: Weight axis (wght). A per-range value overrides it; whole-text/bare uses this.

properties.name: Width
properties.summary: Width axis (wdth). A per-range value overrides it; whole-text/bare uses this.

properties.name: Italic
properties.summary: Italic axis (ital). A per-range value overrides it; whole-text/bare uses this.

properties.name: Slant
properties.summary: Slant axis (slnt). A per-range value overrides it; whole-text/bare uses this.

properties.name: OpticalSize
properties.summary: Optical-size axis (opsz). A per-range value overrides it; whole-text/bare uses this.

types.name: Vector2RuleValue
types.summary: Vector2 ParameterRule target.

types.name: WordSpacingModifier
types.summary: Adjusts the gap at spaces between words (the regular space and no-break space), leaving letter-to-letter spacing untouched. The CSS word-spacing analogue.
types.remarks: Parameter: spacing with a unit — 0.25em (relative to font size) or a raw pixel amount such as 4; negative values tighten. Applies at the regular space and no-break space; tabs and fixed-width spaces (U+2000–U+200A, U+3000) are left alone. Overlapping ranges resolve innermost-wins and never compound, across modifiers as well as across nested tags.
attributes: TypeDescription("Adjusts the spacing at spaces between words.")

properties.name: Spacing
properties.summary: Extra gap added at word-separating spaces. A per-range value overrides it.

types.name: AssetPaintProvider
types.summary: [[IPaintProvider]] backed by an explicit [[UniTextPaints]] asset reference.
attributes: TypeDescription("Resolves names through an explicit UniTextPaints asset reference.")

types.name: BaseLineModifier
types.summary: Base class for modifiers that render horizontal lines across text (underline, strikethrough).
types.remarks: Subclasses define the vertical offset of the line relative to the baseline. Lines break across wrapped text lines automatically. Decoration quads run through the standard [[onGlyph]] pipeline with [[isVirtualGlyph]] set, so per-glyph modifiers (color, gradient, outline, shadow) apply uniformly to face glyphs and decoration lines. An overlay range raises that whole stack — the line and every layer applied to it — above the text it crosses, instead of interleaving each layer at its own position in Styles.

methods.name: BeforeApply
methods.summary: The previous paint resolution must reset before the re-run [[OnApply]].

properties.name: Provider
properties.summary: Source of named paint swatches resolved by this decoration line.
attributes: Tooltip("Source of named paint swatches for the line's Paint parameter. Leave a tag's Paint unset to inherit the text fill (text-decoration-color: currentColor).")

properties.name: Paint
properties.summary: Line paint (inline colour or named swatch); the default inherits the text fill. A per-range value overrides it.

properties.name: Style
properties.summary: Line style (solid, double, dotted, dashed, wavy). A per-range value overrides it.

properties.name: Thickness
properties.summary: Line thickness; zero = auto (font metric). A per-range value overrides it.

properties.name: Offset
properties.summary: Vertical offset from the metric line position. A per-range value overrides it.

properties.name: SkipInk
properties.summary: Break the line where descenders/ascenders cross it. A per-range value overrides it.

properties.name: Blend
properties.summary: How the line composites; Inherit uses its paint or the fill inherited by currentColor.

properties.name: Overlay
properties.summary: Draws the line and every layer applied to it above the whole text, instead of stacking each layer at its own position in Styles. A per-range value overrides it.
attributes: Tooltip("Draw the line and its own stroke, shadow and glow above the text instead of interleaving them with the glyphs' layers.")

properties.name: AttributeKey
properties.summary: Stable name of the decoration this subclass draws.

types.name: BaseRangeDecorationModifier
types.summary: Base class for modifier-authored geometry attached to final visual text ranges. It owns range accumulation, paint resolution, renderer handles and main-thread rebuild timing; subclasses only translate one immutable [[RangeDecorationContext]] into a [[RangeMeshWriter]].
types.remarks: [[OnBuildDecoration]] runs synchronously after final layout. Fragment spans and the writer are borrowed for that call and must not be retained. Vertices, indices and render-key batches are copied into modifier-owned pooled buffers. Modifier apply may run on a rebuild worker, so Unity objects are neither created nor destroyed there. Backend handles are acquired lazily by the writer on the layout commit and released by a post-commit action or by the owning UniText component's main-thread teardown.

methods.name: OnDecorationEnable
methods.summary: Called after the base has subscribed its lifetime and paint receptors.

methods.name: OnDecorationDisable
methods.summary: Called before the base detaches its lifetime and paint receptors.

methods.name: OnDecorationDestroy
methods.summary: Releases subclass-owned pooled or managed resources.

methods.name: OnBeforeDecorationApply
methods.summary: Resets subclass-owned apply-cycle accumulators.

methods.name: OnDecorationApply
methods.summary: Observes one worker-side range application after the base has retained its immutable data.

methods.name: OnPrepareDecorationForParallel
methods.summary: Caches subclass main-thread state before parallel processing.

methods.name: OnBuildDecoration
methods.summary: Builds final geometry for one applied entity segment.

methods.name: ResolveDecorationPaint
methods.summary: Resolves an optional leading paint token or the authored field, applies the common projection override chain, and retains any gradient-ramp row until the next decoration rebuild.

methods.name: ResolveDecorationPaintSource
methods.summary: Resolves only the optional leading paint token or authored paint field.

methods.name: CreateDecorationPaint
methods.summary: Wraps a resolved paint and its owned ramp row for the geometry writer.

methods.name: DecorationPresentationChanged
methods.summary: Reconciles provider subscriptions and invalidates decoration output after presentation changes.

properties.name: Priority
properties.summary: Draw priority among decorations emitted by this modifier.
attributes: Tooltip("Draw priority among range decorations on the same side of the text. Higher values paint above lower values.")

properties.name: DecorationPaintProvider
properties.summary: Paint catalog used by [[ResolveDecorationPaint]].

properties.name: RequiresExactVisualGlyphs
properties.summary: Whether this modifier consumes exact final quads through [[VisualGlyphs]].

types.name: CornerStyle
types.summary: How a layer's offset iso-lines treat glyph corners.

fields.name: Round
fields.summary: Euclidean distance: correct round joins at any width, no seam artifacts.

fields.name: Sharp
fields.summary: Perpendicular distance: mitered sharp joins, clipped at [[MiterLimit]].

types.name: CoverageMode
types.summary: Coverage-mode codes written to TEXCOORD2.x. Must match UniText_Coverage.hlsl.

methods.name: WithCorner
methods.summary: Packs a corner code into the mode: mode + 16 × code, where code is 0 (legacy perpendicular field), [[RoundCorners]], or a Sharp miter limit quantized to 0.25 steps (1..8). Unallocated UV2 reads as 0 → Fill + legacy, so plain text is unaffected.

fields.name: RoundCorners
fields.summary: Corner code for round (Euclidean) corners; 0 = legacy perpendicular field (plain fill).

types.name: CoverageQuadOps
types.summary: Writes the unified paint vertex contract — colour, coverage (TEXCOORD2) and paint (TEXCOORD3) — into a reserved quad whose positions/UV0/UV1 were already copied from the glyph template by [[ReserveQuad]]. One writer shared by every layer kind so the contract lives in a single place.
types.remarks: TEXCOORD3 is written only when the buffer is allocated (text uses a gradient/texture paint). Plain solid text leaves UV2/UV3 unallocated, so the shader reads 0 → Fill + Solid for free.

methods.name: Write
methods.summary: Fills the four destination vertices. frame maps each vertex to its paint coordinate (gradient/texture); rampRow is the gradient's ramp row — for a texture paint a [[ColorMatrixAtlas]] row + 1 (≤ 0 = unfiltered), ignored for solid; fade (the component colour alpha) scales every layer's alpha so fading the text fades all layers together.

methods.name: Write
methods.summary: Array-targeted overload for sub-mesh paths (texture paint) that accumulate into their own pooled buffers instead of the generator's. verts supplies the quad positions each gradient/texture coordinate is mapped from.

methods.name: ApplyOffset
methods.summary: Displaces a reserved effect quad's four vertices in the X/Y plane (Z untouched).

methods.name: ModulateAlpha
methods.summary: Multiplies each destination vertex alpha by the GLYPH's own alpha at the source face vertex ([[FaceAlpha]] — the pre-claim stash when a fill claimed the quad, so a layer never inherits another layer's paint alpha) — the canonical formula keeping outline / shadow / extrude / textured-fill fades synchronised with face fades (per-character <alpha> ramps, [[ColorModifier]] alpha). Run after [[Write]], whose uniform alpha carries only the component-level fade.

types.name: FillModifier
types.summary: Fills the glyph interior with a colour, gradient, or texture. The first fill on a glyph claims the (default-suppressed) base quad; additional fills stack above it. Any fill present suppresses the implicit default fill.
types.remarks: Parameter: paint[,softness][,dilate] (paint = colour literal or swatch name) + projection overrides.
attributes: TypeDescription("Fills the glyph interior with a colour, gradient, or texture.")

properties.name: Paint
properties.summary: Fill paint (inline colour, named swatch, or default). A per-range value overrides it.

properties.name: Softness
properties.summary: Edge softness. A per-range value overrides it.

properties.name: Dilate
properties.summary: Outward dilation of the fill. A per-range value overrides it.

types.name: FilterModifier
types.summary: Applies a [[ColorFilter]] to everything rendered below it in the style stack — an adjustment layer for text. Within its ranges it recolours the glyph face, every paint layer stacked beneath it, and colour emoji; stacked filters compose bottom-up, and a filter at the end of the style list recolours the whole styled text. The filter transforms each layer's colour as it composites; non-Normal blend layers keep their blend against the backdrop.
types.remarks: Parameter: an optional strength scaling the whole filter for the range — 1 applies it as authored, 0 disables it (e.g. <sepia=0.5> with a sepia filter bound to the sepia tag).
attributes: TypeDescription("Recolours everything below it — greyscale, saturation, tint, and other colour filters.")

methods.name: ToString
methods.summary: The kind of filter applied, so the modifier reads as its choice rather than as its container.

properties.name: Filter
properties.summary: The colour adjustment applied below this position in the style stack. Null filters nothing; after mutating the assigned instance in place, reassign or mark the text dirty to re-render.

properties.name: Strength
properties.summary: How far the filter is applied: 1 as authored, 0 not at all, values between fade it out. A per-range value overrides it.
attributes: Tooltip("Scales the whole filter toward no change — 1 applies it as authored, 0 disables it.")

types.name: GeometryMapping
types.summary: How one logical segment is split into visual background figures.

fields.name: Glyph
fields.summary: One independently rounded figure per shaped glyph cluster.

fields.name: Line
fields.summary: One independently rounded figure per final line/BiDi fragment.

fields.name: Range
fields.summary: Final line/BiDi fragments with rounding only at the logical range endpoints.

fields.name: Block
fields.summary: One connected layout-space multi-line contour without internal seams.

types.name: GlobalSettingsPaintProvider
types.summary: [[IPaintProvider]] backed by the project-wide [[Paints]] asset. Use when the same paint swatches are shared across all UniText components.
attributes: TypeDescription("Resolves names through the project-wide UniTextSettings.PaintCatalog asset.")

types.name: GlowModifier
types.summary: Soft halo around the glyph (a shadow with no offset and a wide soft edge), with a colour, gradient, or texture.
types.remarks: Parameter: paint[,radius] + projection overrides.
attributes: TypeDescription("Adds a soft glow halo around the glyph.")

properties.name: Paint
properties.summary: Glow paint (inline colour, named swatch, or default). A per-range value overrides it.

properties.name: Radius
properties.summary: Halo radius. A per-range value overrides it.

properties.name: DefaultColorGlyphPolicy
properties.summary: A glow reads naturally on any silhouette, so emoji and sprites glow unless a range opts out.

types.name: HighlightModifier
types.summary: Paints non-interactive backgrounds for matched text ranges. The same presentation model renders live text selection without routing selection changes through the parser.
attributes: TypeDescription("Paints a range background with independent geometry and paint mappings.")

properties.name: Presentation
properties.summary: Visual definition used for every range emitted by this modifier.

types.name: HighlightPresentation
types.summary: Complete visual definition shared by authored highlights and the live text selection.

properties.name: Provider
properties.summary: Source of named solid, gradient and texture paints.
attributes: Tooltip("Source of named paint swatches for the highlight paint.")

properties.name: Paint
properties.summary: Authored highlight paint.

properties.name: GeometryMapping
properties.summary: How the logical range is split into visual figures.

properties.name: PaintMapping
properties.summary: How gradient or texture coordinates restart independently of geometry topology.

properties.name: Shape
properties.summary: Gradient geometry; Inherit uses the selected swatch.

properties.name: Fit
properties.summary: Texture fitting; Inherit uses the selected swatch.

properties.name: Angle
properties.summary: Paint projection rotation in degrees; NaN uses the selected swatch.

properties.name: Scale
properties.summary: Paint projection zoom; NaN uses the selected swatch.

properties.name: PaintOffset
properties.summary: Paint projection offset in normalized frame units.

properties.name: Height
properties.summary: Vertical extent used for visual fragments.

properties.name: Padding
properties.summary: Additional expansion around each figure; rounded corners contribute a geometric safe inset separately.

properties.name: CornerRadius
properties.summary: Corner radius of the range surface.

properties.name: MergeThreshold
properties.summary: Edge differences below this value snap to a shared edge across adjacent lines; a negative value uses the radius.

properties.name: Order
properties.summary: Whether the surface renders behind or above the text.

properties.name: Tint
properties.summary: Colour multiplied with the resolved solid, gradient, or texture paint.

properties.name: Blend
properties.summary: How the highlight composites; Inherit uses the selected paint.

properties.name: Spread
properties.summary: Gradient continuation outside the projection frame — visible where [[Scale]] or [[PaintOffset]] leaves part of the surface uncovered; Inherit uses the selected swatch. Occupies the final parameter slot: any parameter added later must follow it.

types.name: IHasPaintProvider
types.summary: Implemented by modifiers that expose an [[IPaintProvider]], so the editor can populate the @paints swatch dropdown.

types.name: InlinePaintProvider
types.summary: [[IPaintProvider]] with an inline list of named paints edited on the modifier.
attributes: TypeDescription("Inline list of named paints edited directly on the modifier.")

types.name: InnerShadowModifier
types.summary: Inset shadow that hugs the inner edge of the glyph, with a colour, gradient, or texture. The offset is a shader parameter (second SDF tap), not a quad displacement.
types.remarks: Parameter: paint[,offset][,blur] + projection overrides (offset = "x y"; px/em, applied as the SDF tap).
attributes: TypeDescription("Adds an inset shadow inside the glyph.")

properties.name: Paint
properties.summary: Inner-shadow paint (inline colour, named swatch, or default). A per-range value overrides it.

properties.name: Offset
properties.summary: Inner-shadow tap offset (applied as a second SDF tap). A per-range value overrides it.

properties.name: Blur
properties.summary: Inner-shadow blur radius. A per-range value overrides it.

types.name: IPaintProvider
types.summary: Resolves named [[PaintSwatch]] entries for paint parameters. Marker over [[INamedCatalog{TEntry}]] that scopes the [SerializeReference, TypeSelector] dropdown. Built-in: [[InlinePaintProvider]], [[AssetPaintProvider]], [[GlobalSettingsPaintProvider]].

methods.name: DrawLine
methods.summary: Emits one decoration-line quad spanning [startX, endX] at baselineY + lineYOffset, sampling the underscore SDF column described by [uvLeft, uvRight] (use centerX..centerX for stretch segments and -sdfPadding..centerX / centerX..aspect+sdfPadding for end caps).

params.name: thickness
params.description: Full visible line thickness in pixels (post.underlineThickness or OS/2.yStrikeoutSize at this font size). NaN falls back to the underscore glyph's natural rendered height. The quad height equals this thickness; SDF samples the full ink span vertically with a small padding margin for AA at top/bottom edges, so visible thickness scales linearly with the parameter regardless of underscore aspect.

methods.name: DrawDot
methods.summary: Emits one dot quad centered at (centerX, baselineY + lineYOffset), sized dotSize * aspect × dotSize where aspect is the bullet glyph's natural width/height ratio (typically ≈1). Samples the bullet glyph (U+2022) so the SDF gives a true round shape with antialiased edge. Falls back to a square dotSize×dotSize stretched-underscore mark when the resolved font has no bullet glyph or the atlas entry is missing.

types.name: LineStyle
types.summary: Visual style of decoration lines (CSS Text Decoration Module Level 4: text-decoration-style).

types.name: PaintLayerModifier
types.summary: Shared engine for paint layers (fill, stroke, shadow, glow, inner-shadow). Resolves a [[TextPaint]] from the parameter, precomputes gradient/texture mapping per styled range, and stamps coverage quads through [[CoverageQuadOps]]. Thin subclasses only pick a coverage mode and parse their geometry params — all paint/mapping logic lives here once.
types.remarks: Parameter grammar: paint, then the subclass's layer-geometry tokens ([[ParseExtra]]), then the shared projection overrides [,mapping][,shape][,fit][,angle][,scale][,offset][,corners][,miterLimit][,tint][,blend][,spread]. Projection values affect gradient/texture paints; tint multiplies every paint kind. The paint slot is optional-with-rewind: only a genuine paint token (colour literal or known swatch name) is consumed; anything else rewinds to the geometry slots, so <stroke=2px> reads as a width. Each projection value resolves through the override hierarchy, weakest → strongest: swatch → modifier field → default parameters → tag attribute ([[ApplyProjection]]).

methods.name: ParseExtra
methods.summary: Parses layer-specific tokens (after paint/mapping/shape/angle/scale) into coverage params and an optional quad offset. Read scalars with [[NextUnitFloat]] / vectors with [[NextUnitVector2]] and set the matching *Px flag from the unit ([[Absolute]] = px), so the value resolves to em at emit.

methods.name: BeforeApply
methods.summary: Clears the range accumulator AND releases the emitter's held gradient ramp rows — the re-run [[OnApply]] re-acquires them immediately, so an animated parameter never leaks a row reference per frame (the atlas sweep's grace period protects the currently displayed mesh). The winner buffer is zeroed here too: a granular re-apply replays without the OnEnable-time PrepareAttribute clear, and stale winner indices would point into the freshly reset [[ranges]] list.

methods.name: OnApply
methods.summary: Resolves the range's paint and geometry, then stamps the per-codepoint winner-index buffer: overlapping ranges of one modifier resolve innermost-wins ONCE here (an [[IsInner]] compare against the current holder), so the per-glyph hook reads a single buffer slot instead of scanning ranges. The buffer indexes at most 255 applied ranges per layer instance; ranges beyond that keep the earlier winner.

methods.name: OnGlyphEffect
methods.summary: O(1) per glyph: the winning range comes from the per-codepoint winner buffer resolved at apply time; no range scan happens here.

properties.name: Provider
properties.summary: Source of named paint swatches this layer resolves (e.g. <fill=ember>, <stroke=gold>). disables swatch resolution, leaving only inline colour tokens. A gradient or texture paint is only reachable through a swatch, so set this to give the layer a gradient/texture from code.
attributes: Tooltip("Source of named paint swatches for the paint parameter.")

properties.name: Mapping
properties.summary: How a gradient/texture paint spreads over the text (whole block, per line, per glyph, or per range). Inherit (default) uses the swatch's value; a per-range value overrides both.

properties.name: Shape
properties.summary: Gradient geometry (linear, radial, angular). Inherit (default) uses the swatch's value; a per-range value overrides both.

properties.name: Fit
properties.summary: How a texture paint fits its mapping frame. Inherit (default) uses the swatch's value; a per-range value overrides both.

properties.name: Angle
properties.summary: Rotation of the gradient/texture mapping, in degrees. NaN (default) uses the swatch's angle; a per-range value overrides both.

properties.name: Scale
properties.summary: Uniform zoom of the mapping frame; non-positive is treated as 1. NaN (default) uses the swatch's scale; a per-range value overrides both.

properties.name: PaintOffset
properties.summary: Pan of the paint's sample origin in normalized frame units. NaN per axis uses the swatch's offset; a per-range value overrides both.

properties.name: Corners
properties.summary: Corner treatment of this layer's offset iso-lines (outline rim, shadow spread). Round is artifact-free at any width; Sharp keeps mitered corners up to [[MiterLimit]]. Single-channel SDF mode has no perpendicular field — Sharp renders as Round there.

properties.name: MiterLimit
properties.summary: Sharp-corner miter limit as a multiple of the offset width (SVG stroke-miterlimit semantics); corners spikier than this are clipped.

properties.name: Tint
properties.summary: Colour multiplied with the resolved solid, gradient, or texture paint.

properties.name: PaintField
properties.summary: The subclass's own [Parameter] paint, used as the default when the markup carries no paint value.

properties.name: CoverageModeValue
properties.summary: Coverage mode written to TEXCOORD2.x (see [[CoverageMode]]).

properties.name: DefaultPaintColor
properties.summary: Solid colour applied when the paint token is omitted entirely. White for the face/fill; dark layers (stroke, shadow) override so a bare tag still renders sensibly without a paint provider. A present-but-unresolved name still falls back to white, not this.

properties.name: ClaimsBase
properties.summary: When true, the first hit on a glyph recolours the suppressed default base quad instead of emitting a duplicate (fill behaviour).

types.name: PaintMapping
types.summary: Frame a gradient/texture is mapped against — how the paint spreads over the text.

fields.name: Inherit
fields.summary: No value at this layer — resolves down the override chain (tag → default parameters → modifier field → swatch); a fully unresolved chain means [[Block]].

fields.name: Block
fields.summary: One mapping across the whole text block.

fields.name: Line
fields.summary: Restarts per line.

fields.name: Glyph
fields.summary: Restarts per glyph.

fields.name: Range
fields.summary: Spans the styled range the paint was applied to.

types.name: PaintMappingMath
types.summary: Adapts resolved text paint state to the shared projection-frame primitive.

methods.name: BuildFrame
methods.summary: Builds the shared projection frame from a flattened runtime paint and text-selected bounds. Texture dimensions captured before parallel layout are applied only to texture sources.

types.name: PaintOrderModifier
types.summary: Sets the painter order of a range's paint layers ([[PaintOrder]]): layer-major (the component default) draws each layer across all glyphs before the next layer; glyph-major composites every layer of one glyph before the next glyph, so a later glyph's stroke or shadow overlaps earlier glyphs' fill. The axis is a single per-component channel — all layer modifiers follow it, overlapping ranges resolve innermost-wins, and unmarked text stays layer-major. Characters connected by the Unicode cursive joining algorithm (Arabic, Syriac, N'Ko, Mongolian, …) never split: each connected stretch keeps layer order and composites as one unit, so glyph-major Arabic stacks per word rather than per letter.
types.remarks: Applies to same-material quads of the base mesh. Separate-material output (texture paints, the color-glyph segment) always stacks layer-major, and a blend-mode change between adjacent glyph-major quads splits the draw. Stylistic connected Latin fonts (script typefaces joining via ligatures and contextual alternates) carry no data signal that marks them cursive; their connections are not detected.
attributes: TypeDescription("Chooses per-layer or per-glyph painter order for a range.")

methods.name: BeforeApply
methods.summary: The winner buffer holds packed range bounds from the previous cycle; a granular re-apply replays every range, so stale winners must not out-compete the replayed stamps.

methods.name: OnApply
methods.summary: Stamps the range's resolved order into the shared per-codepoint axis ([[paintOrders]]); overlapping ranges resolve innermost-wins through packed (start, end) winner entries. Glyph-major stamping is joining-aware: a character cursively connected to a neighbour (Transparent characters skipped, edges probed past the range bounds) keeps layer order, and Transparent characters inherit their base's mode so a connected stretch stays one contiguous composition group.

properties.name: Order
properties.summary: Painter order applied when the markup carries no value. Defaults to glyph-major — the mode the tag exists to enable; pass layer to restore layer order inside a glyph-major range.
attributes: Tooltip("Layer draws each layer across all glyphs; Glyph composites each glyph fully before the next.")

types.name: PaintRef
types.summary: A paint layer's paint choice: an inline colour, a named provider swatch, or the layer default. This is the authored value on the modifier (and the default when markup omits the paint); the resolved runtime appearance is [[TextPaint]].

methods.name: Solid
methods.summary: An inline solid-colour paint.

methods.name: Named
methods.summary: A paint referencing a named provider swatch.

properties.name: IsDefault
properties.summary: No explicit paint — the layer falls back to its own default.

types.name: PaintRefKind
types.summary: Which source a [[PaintRef]] draws from.

fields.name: Default
fields.summary: No paint chosen — the layer applies its own default (inherit the text fill, or a built-in colour).

fields.name: Color
fields.summary: An inline solid colour ([[color]]).

fields.name: Swatch
fields.summary: A named swatch ([[swatch]]) resolved through the layer's paint provider — may be solid, gradient, or texture.

types.name: PaintSwatch
types.summary: A named paint in a [[UniTextPaints]] — a solid colour, gradient, or texture, plus how it projects and composites. [[paint]] is the reusable authored appearance, while [[mapping]] selects its text bounds. The swatch is the weakest layer of the projection override hierarchy (swatch → modifier fields → default parameters → tag attributes); an inherited mapping resolves to Block.

methods.name: CaptureStateSnapshot
methods.summary: Captures the swatch with detached gradient-stop storage.

methods.name: StateEquals
methods.summary: Compares all authored swatch state, including gradient contents.

fields.name: name
fields.summary: Name referenced by paint parameters and markup.

fields.name: paint

fields.name: mapping

types.name: RangeDecorationContext
types.summary: Immutable logical range data supplied while a range-decoration modifier builds final geometry. Fragment spans are borrowed scratch views: consume one before requesting another.

methods.name: LineFragments
methods.summary: Returns final per-line/BiDi fragments at the requested vertical extent. The span stays valid only until the next fragment query made through this context.

methods.name: GlyphFragments
methods.summary: Returns one final fragment per shaped cluster group. Ligatures and multiple glyphs belonging to one cluster produce one fragment. The span stays valid only until the next fragment query.

methods.name: VisualGlyphs
methods.summary: Returns final face quads for every rendered primary or modifier-injected glyph in this segment. Use this finer view when [[TransformKind]] is NonUniform. The span stays valid only until the next fragment or glyph query through this context.

methods.name: TextBlockBounds
methods.summary: Returns the union bounds of the entire rendered text block at the requested height.

properties.name: RuleWeight

types.name: RangeDecorationPaint
types.summary: A resolved paint together with the gradient-atlas row owned by its modifier.

types.summary: Conventional draw-order anchors shared by built-in and custom range decorations.

fields.name: Interactive

fields.name: Selection
fields.summary: Text selection.

fields.name: FindCurrent

fields.name: Diagnostics
fields.summary: Spell, grammar, lint or comparable diagnostic presentation.

types.name: RangeMeshWriter
types.summary: Synchronous writer for one modifier's owned range-decoration buffers. Geometry emitted with different texture paints or blend modes is split into render-key batches automatically.

methods.name: SetPaint
methods.summary: Selects paint, projection frame and render side for subsequent vertices. Changing a texture closes the previous render batch while compatible consecutive output remains batched.

methods.name: SetPaint
methods.summary: Selects paint with a colour multiplier for subsequent vertices.

methods.name: SetPaint
methods.summary: Builds the projection frame from bounds, then selects it for subsequent vertices.

methods.name: SetPaint
methods.summary: Builds the projection frame from bounds, then selects it with a colour multiplier.

methods.name: AddVertex
methods.summary: Adds one painted vertex and returns its writer-local index.

methods.name: AddVertex
methods.summary: Adds one painted vertex with a colour multiplier and returns its writer-local index.

methods.name: AddCoverageVertex
methods.summary: Adds a vertex carrying analytic edge coverage. Use 1 on the contour and 0 on a narrow exterior fringe; the decoration shader converts the interpolation into a screen-space antialiased edge with derivatives.

methods.name: AddTriangle
methods.summary: Adds a triangle referencing vertices emitted under the current paint batch.

methods.name: AddRect
methods.summary: Adds a flat painted rectangle.

methods.name: AddRoundedRect
methods.summary: Adds a painted rounded rectangle with independently selectable corners.

methods.name: AddRoundedRect
methods.summary: Adds a rounded rectangle mapped through one resolved final glyph transform.

methods.name: AddRoundedRectSection
methods.summary: Adds one rectangular section of a larger rounded box. Shape coordinates remain relative to fullBounds, allowing a box to be subdivided for independent paint frames without introducing rounding seams.

methods.name: AddRoundedRectSection
methods.summary: Adds one section of a rounded rectangle after applying a resolved glyph transform. Shape coordinates stay in the undeformed rectangle, preserving corner radius and Paint interpolation across affine and bilinear quad deformation.

types.name: RangePaintMapping
types.summary: Projection frame used by a range decoration independently of its geometry topology.

fields.name: InheritGeometry
fields.summary: Glyph/Line follow the matching geometry; Range/Block use one range frame.

fields.name: Glyph
fields.summary: Restart paint for every shaped glyph cluster.

fields.name: Line
fields.summary: Restart paint for every layout line.

fields.name: Range
fields.summary: Use one paint frame for the logical entity segment.

fields.name: TextBlock
fields.summary: Use one paint frame for the entire rendered text block.

types.name: RangeVisualFragment
types.summary: One final visual fragment of a logical text range.

properties.name: Bounds
properties.summary: Final component-local axis-aligned bounds after mesh deformation.

properties.name: LayoutBounds
properties.summary: Component-local bounds before mesh deformation.

properties.name: TransformKind
properties.summary: Whether one transform can represent every glyph in this fragment.

properties.name: Transform
properties.summary: Resolved layout-to-final transform. Valid for Identity and Uniform fragments. For a NonUniform fragment, use [[Bounds]] as an envelope or request visual glyphs when exact topology matters.

properties.name: LineIndex
properties.summary: Layout line containing this fragment.

properties.name: IsRightToLeft
properties.summary: Resolved direction of the fragment's shaping run.

properties.name: ContainsRangeStart
properties.summary: Whether this fragment contains the logical start of the selected range.

properties.name: ContainsRangeEnd
properties.summary: Whether this fragment contains the logical end of the selected range.

properties.name: RangeStartOnRight
properties.summary: Physical side on which the logical range start lies.

properties.name: RangeEndOnRight
properties.summary: Physical side on which the logical range end lies.

properties.name: ClusterStart
properties.summary: First selected cluster represented by this fragment.

properties.name: ClusterEnd
properties.summary: Exclusive selected cluster end represented by this fragment.

types.name: RangeVisualGlyph
types.summary: One rendered primary or modifier-injected glyph face after every mesh modifier has run.

properties.name: Cluster
properties.summary: Rendered codepoint cluster represented by this glyph.

properties.name: LineIndex
properties.summary: Layout line containing the source positioned glyph.

properties.name: BottomLeft
properties.summary: Final bottom-left face corner in component-local coordinates.

properties.name: TopLeft
properties.summary: Final top-left face corner in component-local coordinates.

properties.name: TopRight
properties.summary: Final top-right face corner in component-local coordinates.

properties.name: BottomRight
properties.summary: Final bottom-right face corner in component-local coordinates.

properties.name: Transform
properties.summary: Layout-to-final transform for this glyph face.

types.name: RangeVisualTransform
types.summary: Maps component-local layout coordinates to the final glyph quad after mesh modifiers. The mapping is bilinear, so it also represents custom non-parallelogram face deformation.

methods.name: TransformPoint
methods.summary: Maps one component-local layout point to its final component-local position.

types.name: RangeVisualTransformKind
types.summary: How final mesh deformation relates to one visual range fragment.

fields.name: Identity
fields.summary: The fragment kept its layout geometry.

fields.name: Uniform
fields.summary: Every glyph in the fragment shares one resolved transform.

fields.name: NonUniform
fields.summary: Glyphs have different transforms. [[Bounds]] remains a conservative final-space envelope; consume visual glyphs for their exact topology.

types.name: ShadowModifier
types.summary: Drop shadow behind the glyph — an offset, blurred duplicate with a colour, gradient, or texture paint.
types.remarks: Parameter: paint[,offset][,blur][,spread] + projection overrides (offset = "x y"; px/em).
attributes: TypeDescription("Adds a drop shadow behind the glyph.")

properties.name: Paint
properties.summary: Shadow paint (inline colour, named swatch, or default). A per-range value overrides it.

properties.name: Offset
properties.summary: Shadow offset. A per-range value overrides it.

properties.name: Blur
properties.summary: Shadow blur radius. A per-range value overrides it.

properties.name: Spread
properties.summary: Shadow spread. A per-range value overrides it.

properties.name: DefaultColorGlyphPolicy
properties.summary: A shadow reads naturally on any silhouette, so emoji and sprites cast one unless a range opts out.

types.name: StrikethroughModifier
types.summary: Renders a horizontal line through the middle of the text (strikethrough effect).
types.remarks: No parameter. The line position is determined by the font's strikethroughOffset property, or calculated from the x-height if not available. Supports line breaks and color inheritance from the text.
attributes: TypeDescription("Draws a line through the middle of the text.")

types.name: StrokeModifier
types.summary: Draws a real outline (a rim band around the glyph edge, not a filled blob) with a colour, gradient, or texture. Works with the fill off (stroke-only).
types.remarks: Parameter: paint[,width][,align][,softness] + projection overrides.
attributes: TypeDescription("Draws a real outline (rim) around the glyph.")

properties.name: Paint
properties.summary: Stroke paint (inline colour, named swatch, or default). A per-range value overrides it.

properties.name: Width
properties.summary: Stroke width. A per-range value overrides it.

properties.name: Align
properties.summary: Rim alignment relative to the glyph edge: −1 inside … +1 outside. A per-range value overrides it.

properties.name: Softness
properties.summary: Edge softness. A per-range value overrides it.

properties.name: RendersBehindFill
properties.summary: Outside strokes (align > 0) render behind the fill; centered/inside strokes stay in front so the opaque fill doesn't cover them.

types.name: TextPaint
types.summary: A resolved paint — flat colour, gradient, or texture — shared by every paint consumer. Built per application from a parameter token ([[Resolve]]); it is a runtime value, never a serialized field on a modifier. Invariant: projection fields carry only resolved values — never Inherit/NaN — so emitters and the shader contract read them without sentinel checks.

methods.name: Solid
methods.summary: Creates a runtime solid paint with the engine-default projection.

methods.name: Resolve
methods.summary: Resolves one paint token: a swatch name (via swatches) carrying the paint appearance (kind/colour/gradient/texture) and its full projection (the base layer of the override hierarchy — see [[ApplyProjection]]), or a colour literal (#RRGGBBAA / named) → solid with engine-default projection. The name is tried first unless the token is an explicit # hex; an unresolved token falls back to opaque white. Touches no Unity APIs (worker-thread safe); texture pixel dimensions are filled separately on the main thread.

methods.name: Resolve
methods.summary: Resolves an authored [[PaintRef]] by its explicit kind — a colour literal, a named swatch (via swatches), or opaque white for the default (the layer swaps in its own default colour afterward).

methods.name: ApplyProjection
methods.summary: The single projection-override resolve: layers a modifier's serialized fields and the remaining per-range tokens of reader over the values this paint already carries from its swatch (or the engine defaults for a colour literal). Per field, strongest wins: tag/default-parameter token → modifier field → swatch. Inherit enum members and NaN floats/axes mean "no value at that layer"; a non-positive resolved scale normalizes to 1.

methods.name: ApplyProjection
methods.summary: Applies already-resolved projection overrides, strongest layer last: a non-sentinel value replaces what this paint carries from its swatch; Inherit enum members and NaN floats/axes keep the swatch value. A non-positive scale normalizes to 1.

methods.name: ApplyProjectionDetails
methods.summary: Applies already-resolved non-mapping projection overrides under the same sentinel contract as [[ApplyProjection]] — for consumers whose mapping vocabulary differs from [[PaintMapping]] and is resolved separately.

methods.name: ApplyBlend
methods.summary: Applies the modifier/default/tag blend override, retaining the swatch mode when inherited.

methods.name: ApplySpread
methods.summary: Applies the spread override, retaining the swatch value when inherited. Occupies the final slot of its consumer's positional parameter list: call it after every other parameter that consumer reads, since slot positions are part of the authored contract.

fields.name: kind
fields.summary: Resolved solid, gradient, or texture source kind.

fields.name: color
fields.summary: Resolved solid colour or tint multiplied with the sampled source.

fields.name: gradient
fields.summary: Resolved gradient payload when [[kind]] is [[Gradient]].

fields.name: shape
fields.summary: Resolved geometric projection kind.

fields.name: texture
fields.summary: Resolved texture when [[kind]] is [[Texture]].

fields.name: mapping
fields.summary: Text bounds used as the projection frame.

fields.name: fit
fields.summary: Resolved texture fitting policy.

fields.name: spread
fields.summary: Resolved gradient continuation outside the projection frame.

fields.name: angle
fields.summary: Resolved projection rotation in degrees.

fields.name: scale
fields.summary: Resolved projection zoom or texture repeat count.

fields.name: offset
fields.summary: Resolved normalized projection-origin offset.

fields.name: blend
fields.summary: Resolved compositing mode.

fields.name: texWidth
fields.summary: Texture pixel dimensions, populated on the main thread before parallel layout; consumed by worker-thread aspect-fit.

fields.name: texHeight
fields.summary: Texture pixel dimensions, populated on the main thread before parallel layout; consumed by worker-thread aspect-fit.

types.name: UnderlineModifier
types.summary: Renders an underline below text using the font's underline metrics.
types.remarks: No parameter. The underline position is determined by the font's underlineOffset property. Supports line breaks and color inheritance from the text.
attributes: TypeDescription("Draws a line beneath the text.")

types.name: UniTextPaints
types.summary: ScriptableObject of named [[PaintSwatch]] entries (colour / gradient / texture) resolved by name in paint parameters (e.g. <fill=ember>). Reference it in [[UniTextSettings]] for a project-wide catalog, or per modifier via [[AssetPaintProvider]].

types.name: ClipboardFormat
types.summary: Cross-platform identifier for a clipboard payload. The canonical identifier is a MIME-style string (text/plain, text/html, text/uri-list); each platform clipboard provider translates to the correct OS-level identifier at the boundary (UTI on Apple, CF_HTML / "HTML Format" on Windows, MIME on Web / Android / Linux).
types.remarks: Well-known formats: [[PlainText]], [[Html]], [[Url]], [[Markdown]], [[UniTextSource]], and the raster image trio ([[Png]] / [[Jpeg]] / [[Gif]]); integrator formats go through [[Custom]]. RTF / RTFD remain reserved (decision D-005) and land without breaking this contract. Per-platform support is summarised on [[UniTextClipboard]]. Equality and hash are by [[Identifier]] only — provider implementations compare formats via format == ClipboardFormat.Html, not by reference.

methods.name: TryDetectImage
methods.summary: Detects a raster image format from a payload's leading bytes by file signature (magic number) — the content-based identification browsers and file managers use, since a file extension lies or is absent (a pasted path may be a sandbox or content:// URI with none). Recognises [[Png]], [[Jpeg]], and [[Gif]]; pass at least the first 8 bytes. Returns on any other or truncated input.

methods.name: Custom
methods.summary: Integrator-defined format. identifier is passed verbatim to the native channel (Win32 registered format, Apple UTI, Android MIME, Chromium custom format with auto-applied web prefix). Use the vendor MIME tree (application/vnd.<vendor>.<type>) for cross-platform safety.

properties.name: Identifier
properties.summary: MIME-style canonical identifier. Never.

properties.name: IsImage
properties.summary: True for a raster image format (image/*) — the partition marshaled across the native boundary as binary data rather than UTF-8 text.

fields.name: PlainText
fields.summary: UTF-8 plain text (text/plain). Apple UTI: public.utf8-plain-text. Windows: CF_UNICODETEXT.

fields.name: Html
fields.summary: HTML fragment with optional source-URL header (text/html). Apple UTI: public.html. Windows: CF_HTML ("HTML Format").

fields.name: Url
fields.summary: URI list, one URL per line, LF-separated (text/uri-list). Apple UTI: public.url. Windows: UniformResourceLocatorW.

fields.name: Markdown
fields.summary: CommonMark-style markdown source (text/markdown, RFC 7763). On Chromium browsers the Web Async Clipboard API delivers this via the web text/markdown custom format; Firefox / Safari clipboard support is not yet shipping it natively. On Apple platforms the canonical identifier is exposed as the dynamic UTI net.daringfireball.markdown by some apps — UniText negotiates the active identifier at the platform boundary; integrators consume / produce [[Markdown]] through this same constant. Used by chat composers and editor apps to preserve source markdown across copy / paste (Slack, Discord, Notion, Obsidian, Typora, VS Code).

fields.name: UniTextSource
fields.summary: UniText-native round-trip channel as a vendor-tree MIME type (application/vnd.lightside.unitext, RFC 6838). Carries a JSON UniTextClipboardFragment: the selection's visible text plus markup spans keyed by modifier signature — so a copy from one UniText field pastes into another with full semantic fidelity (each span re-emitted in the destination's own syntax, degraded to plain text when the destination lacks the modifier), regardless of which modifiers an HTML or Markdown serializer can represent. Interop consumers must parse the fragment JSON, not treat the payload as raw source markup. Per-platform mapping: Chromium browsers — web application/vnd.lightside.unitext (Async Clipboard custom format, mandatory web prefix). macOS / iOS — UTI com.lightside.unitext (reverse-DNS). Windows — RegisterClipboardFormatW("LightSide.UniText"). Android / Linux — MIME identifier as-is. External apps that do not recognise this format silently fall back to [[PlainText]] / [[Html]] in the same clipboard write — copy always emits the universal floor alongside the custom format.

fields.name: Png
fields.summary: Raster PNG bytes (image/png). Apple UTI public.png; browser image/png blob. Windows writes the registered "PNG" format plus a synthesized CF_DIBV5, and reads either — so PrintScreen screenshots paste in and copied images land in Paint / Word. The cross-app baseline for image copy/paste.

fields.name: Jpeg
fields.summary: Raster JPEG bytes (image/jpeg). Apple UTI public.jpeg.

fields.name: Gif
fields.summary: GIF bytes, animated or still (image/gif).

types.name: ClipboardItem
types.summary: A single (format, payload) pair on the clipboard. Multi-format writes pass a list of items in one atomic [[SetItems]] call; the OS stores them as a single clipboard write whose richest available format is selected by the consumer on paste.
types.remarks: [[Data]] holds the format's bytes. For text formats the bytes are UTF-8 (so a consumer can Encoding.UTF8.GetString(item.Data)); for binary formats (P2 image, RTFD) it is the format's native byte representation.

methods.name: ClipboardItem
methods.summary: Convenience constructor that UTF-8-encodes a string into the payload. Use for any text-style format ([[PlainText]], [[Html]], [[Url]]).

properties.name: Format
properties.summary: Format identifier for [[Data]].

properties.name: Data
properties.summary: Payload bytes. Never; may be empty.

properties.name: Text
properties.summary: Payload decoded as UTF-8 text. Empty string for an empty payload.

types.name: CompositionClause
types.summary: A single clause (segment) within an IME composition string, with its boundaries and style.

methods.name: EnsureCapacity
methods.summary: Ensures that buffer can hold at least count clauses.

methods.name: FillFallback
methods.summary: Writes one unconverted clause spanning the composition and returns one.

fields.name: startOffset
fields.summary: Start char offset within the composition string (inclusive).

fields.name: endOffset
fields.summary: End char offset within the composition string (exclusive).

fields.name: style
fields.summary: Visual style for this clause, derived from the platform's attribute data.

types.name: CompositionClauseStyle
types.summary: Visual classification of one clause in an IME composition.

fields.name: Unconverted
fields.summary: Unconverted input (ATTR_INPUT). Visual: thin underline.

fields.name: TargetConverted
fields.summary: Active clause being converted (ATTR_TARGET_CONVERTED). Visual: thick underline or highlight.

fields.name: Converted
fields.summary: Already converted clause (ATTR_CONVERTED). Visual: thin underline.

fields.name: TargetNotConverted
fields.summary: Selected but not yet converted (ATTR_TARGET_NOTCONVERTED). Visual: thick underline.

fields.name: Error
fields.summary: Input error (ATTR_INPUT_ERROR). Visual: squiggly underline.

types.name: CompositionData
types.summary: Ephemeral composition data whose spans are valid only for the synchronous report call.

fields.name: text
fields.summary: The current composition string. Span into a reusable internal buffer — must be consumed or copied within the callback scope.

fields.name: clauses
fields.summary: Clause boundaries and styles. Span into a reusable internal buffer — must be consumed or copied within the callback scope.

fields.name: cursorPosition
fields.summary: Cursor position (char offset) within the composition string, or -1 while the platform temporarily suppresses the insertion point.

types.name: CursorType
types.summary: Cursor appearance types. Each maps to platform-native cursor IDs via [[UniTextCursor]]'s internal mapping table. If the current platform has no native cursor for a type, the default arrow is used.

types.name: IAsyncClipboardProvider
types.summary: Opt-in extension for clipboard providers that cannot (or should not) read on the caller's thread — WebGL where navigator.clipboard returns Promises, Linux where reads spawn a subprocess. Callers probe via as IAsyncClipboardProvider; providers without it fall through to the sync path wrapped in [[FromResult{TResult}]].

methods.name: GetTextAsync
methods.summary: Async read for format. On WebGL requires a user-activation context (button click / keyboard handler); resolves to on permission denial or unsupported format.

methods.name: HasFormatAsync
methods.summary: Async availability probe. WebGL returns the sync cached answer; true async check would require user activation.

methods.name: GetItemsAsync
methods.summary: Reads every present format of formats in ONE underlying clipboard access. This is the paste pipeline's async entry: on WebGL a single navigator.clipboard.read() already carries all types, and per-format reads there burn the transient user activation after the first (Safari / Firefox reject reads 2..n and Safari shows a paste prompt per read). Resolves to the items found — possibly empty, never.

types.name: IClipboardProvider
types.summary: Pluggable system-clipboard provider. The default implementation wraps the active platform (Win32 / NSPasteboard / UIPasteboard / Android ClipboardManager / navigator.clipboard / xclip-xsel-wl-paste); integrators substitute a custom provider for testing, sandboxed clipboards, or platforms outside the shipped set.
types.remarks: The interface deliberately mirrors the W3C Async Clipboard API (navigator.clipboard.read() / write(ClipboardItem[])) and Apple's UIPasteboard setItems: shape: items are arrays of (format, payload), not single strings. Multi-format writes are atomic — the consumer on paste picks the richest format it understands. This is the foundation D-005 calls out: shipping the primitives in P1 means P2 features (markdown channel, sanitize-on-paste pipeline, atomic-token UTI registration) extend the interface without breaking integrators. Multi-format is supported on Windows / macOS / iOS / Android / WebGL. Linux reads any offered target through the clipboard tools (xclip -t / wl-paste --type) but can only OFFER one format per write — the tool serves a single target — so multi-format writes keep the plain-text floor (or the richest single format when no plain item is present). See the per-platform matrix on [[UniTextClipboard]].

methods.name: HasContent
methods.summary: Whether the clipboard contains at least one item, regardless of format.

methods.name: HasFormat
methods.summary: Reports whether the clipboard currently carries format. This is an availability probe only — implementations must answer it from cheap native presence APIs (Win32 IsClipboardFormatAvailable, NSPasteboard.types, ClipDescription MIME list, X11 TARGETS) and never transfer the payload. Use [[TryGetText]] when the payload is wanted; probing then reading doubles the OS transfer. Provider impls that don't understand a format return regardless of OS-level state.

methods.name: GetText
methods.summary: Reads the clipboard payload for format as text. The default path decodes the format's bytes as UTF-8 — appropriate for [[PlainText]] / [[Html]] / [[Url]]. Returns when the format is not present.

methods.name: TryGetText
methods.summary: Single-transfer read: fetches format's text payload in one OS clipboard access and reports presence and content together. Returns (with text or empty) when the format is absent. The paste pipeline's per-adapter read — never pair [[HasFormat]] with [[GetText]] for that.

methods.name: GetData
methods.summary: Reads the clipboard payload for format as raw bytes. Use for binary formats (P2 image, RTFD) or when the consumer wants control over the text decoding. Returns when the format is not present.

methods.name: SetItems
methods.summary: Writes the entire items list to the clipboard in a single atomic OS-level write. Subsequent reads see all formats simultaneously and the consumer's preferred-format chain selects which one to ingest.

types.name: IMediaClipboardProvider
types.summary: Optional [[IClipboardProvider]] extension for binary media. File copies arrive as references — a path list (desktop) or URI list (sandboxed platforms) — not as a single blob, so they have their own accessor; raster blobs read through [[GetData]]. A provider that does not implement this carries text only.

methods.name: HasFiles
methods.summary: Whether the clipboard carries file references (CF_HDROP / file-url / content-uri / uri-list).

methods.name: GetFiles
methods.summary: File references on the clipboard — absolute paths on desktop, URIs on sandboxed platforms (iOS / Android / web) — or when none. Get a reference's bytes with [[ReadFile]].

methods.name: ReadFile
methods.summary: Reads the bytes of a reference from [[GetFiles]], resolving it however the platform requires — a path read on desktop, a content:// resolver on Android, the captured browser blob on web. if the reference is unreadable.

methods.name: ReadFileAsync
methods.summary: Async variant of [[ReadFile]] for large media (a dropped video must not stall the main thread). Desktop reads on a worker; platforms whose bytes are already in memory (web captured blob) complete synchronously.

methods.name: GetAvailableFormats
methods.summary: Format identifiers currently on the clipboard, for inspection. Answered by availability probes only — no payload transfers. May be empty when the platform cannot enumerate.

types.name: INativeInputBackend
types.summary: Platform transport that binds one native input producer to one reporter epoch at a time.
types.remarks: Methods and reporter calls use the Unity main thread. A backend may replace only a quiesced producer. Each platform callback remains bound to the reporter captured for its producer epoch. Disposal releases all platform resources and permits no later reports.

methods.name: OpenInput
methods.summary: Opens a producer for an epoch, atomically replacing a previously quiesced producer.
methods.remarks: Failure leaves the previously quiesced producer frozen and available for explicit close or another replacement attempt; the facade aborts the failed new reporter.

params.name: request
params.description: Producer and software-keyboard configuration.

params.name: reporter
params.description: Exclusive sink, context, and identity of the new producer epoch.

methods.name: QuiesceInput
methods.summary: Freezes new input, drains prior output in source order, resolves composition, and invokes the barrier completion exactly once.
methods.remarks: Editing output and context access end before the callback. If the method throws before completion, it must not invoke the callback later and the facade aborts the reporter.

params.name: reporter
params.description: Reporter bound to the producer being frozen.

params.name: disposition
params.description: Resolution for an active composition.

params.name: quiesced
params.description: Main-thread barrier completion, which may be invoked synchronously.

methods.name: CloseInput
methods.summary: Terminally releases a producer after its quiescence barrier has completed.
methods.remarks: A failure causes the facade to abort the producer before propagating the close error.

params.name: reporter
params.description: Reporter of the quiesced producer.

methods.name: AbortInput
methods.summary: Terminally releases a producer from any state and suppresses its later editing output.
methods.remarks: A failure retires and disposes the entire backend generation.

params.name: reporter
params.description: Reporter of the producer being abandoned.

methods.name: SetCursorScreenPos
methods.summary: Updates the IME candidate anchor in Unity screen pixels.

methods.name: SetInputFieldRect
methods.summary: Updates the focused editor rectangle in Unity screen pixels.

methods.name: FlushPendingInput
methods.summary: Delivers buffered platform input through the current reporter in source order.

methods.name: PushTextContext
methods.summary: Updates a push-model IME mirror with a UTF-16 document window and selection.

properties.name: WantsTextContext

types.name: KeyboardEvent
types.summary: Snapshot of a single keyboard lifecycle event delivered by the native platform layer.

properties.name: IsHidingPhase

fields.summary: The lifecycle phase that triggered this event.

fields.name: area
fields.summary: Keyboard rect in Unity screen pixels (Y-up, origin bottom-left). For the [[WillShow]] / [[WillChangeFrame]] phases this is the destination rect (where the keyboard will be after the animation).

fields.name: animationDuration
fields.summary: System animation duration in seconds. Zero when the system did not provide animation metadata (Android <30, WebGL). Apply a sensible default (≈0.25s) when zero.

fields.name: easing
fields.summary: Closest standard easing matching the system curve. Falls back to [[EaseInOut]] when the platform does not expose curve data.

fields.name: animationFraction
fields.summary: Animation progress in the range 0..1. Only meaningful in [[AnimationProgress]] events. The value is the system's interpolated fraction — it already incorporates [[easing]].

fields.name: hasFrameSyncedAnimation
fields.summary: True on platforms that emit per-frame [[AnimationProgress]] events (Android API 30+). False on platforms where the keyboard animation must be driven client-side from [[animationDuration]] + [[easing]].

types.name: KeyboardEventPhase
types.summary: Lifecycle phase of a keyboard event delivered by the native layer.
types.remarks: [[WillShow]], [[WillHide]] and [[WillChangeFrame]] arrive before the system animation starts and carry the destination rect plus animation metadata ([[animationDuration]], [[easing]]). Use these to schedule an animation that runs in lockstep with the system. [[AnimationProgress]] is delivered every frame while the system animates the keyboard, with [[animationFraction]] ramping from 0 to 1. Only available on platforms where [[hasFrameSyncedAnimation]] is true (Android API 30+). On platforms without per-frame progress, no [[AnimationProgress]] events are delivered — drive the animation manually using duration+easing from the Will-phase. [[DidShow]] and [[DidHide]] arrive once the system animation has fully completed and the keyboard is in its final state.

fields.name: WillShow

fields.name: AnimationProgress

fields.summary: System has finished showing the keyboard.

fields.name: WillHide

fields.name: DidHide

fields.name: WillChangeFrame
fields.summary: Keyboard frame is changing without a hide/show cycle. Examples: split keyboard toggle on iPad, hardware keyboard connect/disconnect, device rotation, language switch.

The drain consumes those events, so other consumers stop seeing keyboard input while a field is focused. The backend does not show software keyboards, present native fields, or consume pushed document windows.

types.name: NativeKeyCode
types.summary: Platform-agnostic key codes for keys that trigger editing actions.
types.remarks: This is intentionally NOT a full keyboard enum. It contains the navigation and editing keys plus the complete A–Z letter block, so any letter shortcut is bindable through [[Resolve]] and custom key maps. The native platform layer maps OS-specific scan codes / virtual key codes to these values before delivering key-down events; bare unmodified letters are never delivered (they are text, not shortcuts — see [[IsLetter]]). The integer values are mirrored in the native plugin sources (iOS/macOS.mm, WebGL.jslib, Android.java) — append new keys at the end, never reorder.

fields.name: Backslash

types.name: NativeKeyCodeExtensions

The enum's integer values are mirrored in the native plugin sources (macOS/iOS.mm, WebGL.jslib, Android.java) — when a key is appended to the enum, update [[MaxDelivered]] and the native tables together (see Additional/plans ci-checks.md for the sync invariants).

methods.name: IsDeliverable

methods.name: IsLetter

fields.name: MaxDelivered

types.name: UniTextClipboard
types.summary: Cross-platform system-clipboard access. Routes through [[Provider]] to the active [[IClipboardProvider]]; convenience static methods on this class cover the plain-text fast path that most integrators need.
types.remarks: Bypasses Unity's GUIUtility.systemCopyBuffer — that API delivers plain text only and goes through Unity's editor abstractions, missing OS-level features the real clipboard exposes (Win32 CF_HTML, NSPasteboard, UIPasteboard items, etc.). Each platform uses its native clipboard API directly; integrators that need multi-format access (HTML paste from Word / Notion / Chrome, images, custom in-app formats for atomic-token round-trip) go through [[Provider]].[[SetItems]] / [[TryGetText]] / [[GetData]]. Per-platform format support: PlatformFormats WindowsPlain (CF_UNICODETEXT), HTML ("HTML Format" with CF_HTML header), Markdown / UniText source / custom (registered formats, UTF-8 + NUL), URL (UniformResourceLocatorW + text/uri-list), PNG (registered "PNG" + synthesized CF_DIBV5 both directions), files (CF_HDROP). macOSAll formats as pasteboard UTIs in one atomic write (public.html, net.daringfireball.markdown, com.lightside.unitext, public.url, public.png / jpeg / gif, custom UTIs verbatim), files (public.file-url). iOSSame UTI mapping via the native plugin; one items dictionary per write. UIPasteControl feeds captured payloads past the paste-permission prompt. AndroidPlain + HTML in one ClipData (newHtmlText); vendor / custom MIMEs advertised in the ClipDescription with payloads carried by an in-process cache (same-app round-trip; the platform clip has no per-MIME binary slot); images via FileProvider content URI. WebGLAsync Clipboard API: text/plain, text/html, text/uri-list, image/png native; anything else through the Chromium web custom-format prefix (invisible to Firefox / Safari). Sync reads come from the capture cache the browser paste event fills; programmatic paste must use the async path. LinuxAny target via xclip / wl-clipboard subprocesses; reads accept any offered target, writes offer ONE format (plain preferred, else the richest single item). xsel is plain-text only. Prefer the async provider path — sync reads spawn a blocking subprocess. OtherGUIUtility.systemCopyBuffer plain-text fallback. Integrators wanting a mock for tests, a sandboxed clipboard, or platforms outside the shipped set assign [[Provider]] directly. Setting it to falls back to the platform default.

methods.name: GetText
methods.summary: Reads plain text from the system clipboard. Equivalent to Provider.GetText(ClipboardFormat.PlainText). Returns or empty when the clipboard has no text payload.

methods.name: SetText
methods.summary: Writes plain text to the system clipboard, replacing any prior contents. Equivalent to Provider.SetItems(new[] { new ClipboardItem(PlainText, text) }).

methods.name: HasText
methods.summary: Reports whether the clipboard currently carries plain text — an availability probe, no payload transfer. Equivalent to Provider.HasFormat(ClipboardFormat.PlainText).

methods.name: HasContent
methods.summary: Whether the system clipboard contains at least one item, regardless of format.

methods.name: GetTextAsync
methods.summary: Async plain-text read. On WebGL goes through navigator.clipboard.readText() (works for programmatic paste, not just hardware Ctrl+V) and requires a user-activation context. Other platforms wrap [[GetText]] in a completed task.

methods.name: GetTextAsync
methods.summary: Async read for any format. See [[GetTextAsync]] for the WebGL contract.

properties.name: Provider

types.name: CaretAffinity
types.summary: Visual side of the caret at an ambiguous boundary — either a soft-wrap line break (right edge of the upstream line vs left edge of the downstream line) or a BiDi run boundary (LTR-end vs RTL-start). The same hint resolves both cases (Mozilla unified hint pattern: see https://bugzilla.mozilla.org/show_bug.cgi?id=1213589). Without an explicit affinity the caret position at such boundaries is undefined: codepoint indices alone cannot disambiguate "end of line N" from "start of line N+1" when both map to the same buffer offset.

fields.name: Downstream

Default when nothing else dictates: forward typing, click landing inside a glyph, programmatic SetCaret without a specified affinity. [[]] of this enum and of any enclosing [[TextSelection]].

fields.name: Upstream
