types.name: SelectionChangedArgs
types.summary: Payload of [[SelectionChanged]]. Carries previous and current selection state plus a hierarchical [[UserEvent]] string that classifies the change (per revised D-002, CodeMirror 6 convention).
types.remarks: Standard values are the [[SelectionChangeReason]] constants. New categories are just new strings — the struct is durable and never breaks subscribers, which can match a family by prefix (e.g. UserEvent.StartsWith("select.")).

properties.name: Previous
properties.summary: Selection state before the change.

properties.name: Current
properties.summary: Selection state after the change.

properties.name: UserEvent
properties.summary: Hierarchical category string. See remarks for standard values.

types.name: SelectionChangeReason
types.summary: Standard [[UserEvent]] values (CodeMirror 6 convention). Dotted-prefix so subscribers can match a whole family with reason.StartsWith("select."). New categories are just new strings; this is the canonical set the engine emits.

fields.name: Input
fields.summary: Selection moved as a side-effect of a text mutation (insert / delete / IME commit).

fields.name: Clamp
fields.summary: Selection clamped after the text shrank underneath it.

fields.name: Normalize
fields.summary: Selection remapped to an equivalent canonical position after a projection or view change.

fields.name: Style
fields.summary: Selection placed on the result of a style edit (wrap / strip / split).

fields.name: Restore
fields.summary: Selection restored by undo / redo replay.

fields.name: Defocus
fields.summary: Selection collapsed or cleared on focus loss.

types.name: SelectionChangingArgs
types.summary: Vetoable payload of [[SelectionChanging]]. Subscribers inspect [[Proposed]] and may set [[Cancel]] to to block the selection change before it is applied.
types.remarks: Reference type with a mutable [[Cancel]] flag —.NET [[CancelEventArgs]] pattern. A fresh instance is allocated per [[SelectionChanging]] emission so subscribers can synchronously trigger another mutation from inside the handler (re-entrancy is safe). Veto fires only on user-driven mutations (click / move / extend / select-word etc.) — text-edit side effects use the internal non-vetoable path, so the selection hot path remains zero-alloc. Real use cases (P2.A atomic tokens, integrator-defined read-only ranges): block selection from landing inside an atomic pill, or constrain selection to stay within editable regions. Standard shouldX-pattern across UIKit (shouldChangeTextInRange), Web (beforeinput with preventDefault), WPF (PreviewKeyDown) — see D-010. [[UserEvent]] uses the same hierarchical strings as [[UserEvent]].

properties.name: Previous
properties.summary: Selection state before the change.

properties.name: Proposed
properties.summary: Selection state that will be applied if not cancelled.

properties.name: UserEvent
properties.summary: Hierarchical category string — see [[SelectionChangedArgs]].

properties.name: Cancel
properties.summary: When set to, the selection change is aborted; previous state is preserved and [[SelectionChanged]] does not fire.

types.name: SelectionHitTest
types.summary: Line and codepoint navigation helpers shared by the caret hit-test path ([[HitTestCaret]]), the editing layer (vertical caret movement, line edges), and selection-extension code.
types.remarks: Top-level screen-to-codepoint resolution lives on [[UniTextBase]] as the HitTestRange / HitTestCaret instance method pair (range vs. caret are genuinely different operations — the bounding-box hit suits link / range detection while edge-snapping suits caret placement). Helpers in this class compose into both. All methods are pure with respect to layout state — none mutate UniText buffers.

methods.name: FindLineAtLocalY
methods.summary: Determines which text line corresponds to the given local-space point. textRect must be the rect the glyph coordinates are relative to (the padded rect).

methods.name: FindLineAtCodepoint
methods.summary: Finds the line containing a given codepoint via binary search. With upstream set, codepoints that sit at a soft-wrap boundary resolve to the upstream line (useful for caret affinity).

methods.name: FindCodepointAtX
methods.summary: Finds the codepoint index on lineIndex closest to targetX in text-local coordinates. Snaps to grapheme cluster boundaries to keep multi-codepoint sequences atomic. Never returns a position past a trailing mandatory break (see [[LineCaretEnd]]). Scans only the line's own glyph span ([[glyphStart]]/[[glyphCount]]) — the per-call cost is bounded by the line, not the document. Clicks past a visual line edge resolve to the logical line start / end when the edge run follows the paragraph direction, otherwise to the edge glyph's BiDi codepoint (the visual edge — Android getOffsetForHorizontal / Chromium PositionForPoint behavior on mixed-direction lines).

types.name: TextSelection
types.summary: Anchor / focus / affinity selection over codepoint indices. [[Anchor]] is where the selection began; [[Focus]] is the current caret position (always where the caret is rendered). [[Affinity]] disambiguates caret rendering at soft-wrap and BiDi boundaries.
types.remarks: Indices are codepoint offsets — the same space used by [[codepoints]] and [[cluster]]. Cursor movement at the consumer level is grapheme-cluster-aware (via [[GraphemeNavigator]]), but the storage representation is codepoints (D-006). Direction is implicit in the [[Anchor]]/[[Focus]] ordering — matches the W3C Selection API and Flutter TextSelection conventions. Multi-cursor (P3 code-editor) is reserved as a non-breaking IReadOnlyList<TextSelection> overload alongside the single-region property (D-001 revised). Immutable — mutations go through [[UniTextSelectable]] named methods (SetCaret / SetSelection / ExtendSelection). Direct construction is allowed for read-only producers (parsers, deserializers, snapshot diffs).

methods.name: TextSelection
methods.summary: Constructs a selection. anchor equal to focus produces a collapsed caret at that position.

methods.name: Caret
methods.summary: Caret-only selection at codepointIndex with the given affinity.

methods.name: Clamp
methods.summary: Returns a new [[TextSelection]] with both endpoints clamped to [0, codepointCount]. Returns the original instance when no clamping is needed.

properties.name: Anchor
properties.summary: Codepoint index where the selection originated. Equals [[Focus]] when the selection is collapsed (caret only).

properties.name: Focus
properties.summary: Current codepoint index of the cursor — the moving end of the selection. The caret is rendered here.

properties.name: Affinity
properties.summary: Visual side of the caret at a soft-wrap or BiDi run boundary. See [[CaretAffinity]].

properties.name: IsCollapsed
properties.summary: True when [[Anchor]] equals [[Focus]] — there is no selected range, only a caret. Matches the W3C Selection.isCollapsed name and semantics.

properties.name: Start
properties.summary: Smaller of [[Anchor]] and [[Focus]] — start of the selected range (inclusive).

properties.name: End
properties.summary: Larger of [[Anchor]] and [[Focus]] — end of the selected range (exclusive).

properties.name: Length
properties.summary: Length of the selected range in codepoints. Zero when collapsed.

types.name: ToggleContextMenuItem
types.summary: Binds a [[Toggle]] to a custom on/off action.

properties.name: Toggle
properties.summary: Toggle that invokes this menu item.
attributes: Tooltip("The toggle in your menu hierarchy this binds to.")

events.name: ValueChanged
events.summary: Occurs when the bound toggle changes while its menu is visible.

types.name: UniTextContextMenu
types.summary: Text context menu you build yourself: lay out and style the panel, buttons, and toggles in the scene however you like, then list the [[ContextMenuItem]] bindings here — each maps one of your controls to a command. [[PrefabTextContextMenu]] drives it with the applicable capabilities, and standard commands route back to the presenter it passed. One menu is shareable across many fields — actions always reach the field that last showed it. The component only wires control events, shows / hides controls per applicability, positions the panel, and dismisses on an outside click — it draws nothing itself. Prefabs assigned to [[PrefabTextContextMenu]] use density-independent layout units.
types.remarks: Visibility is driven through a [[CanvasGroup]], never by toggling the GameObject active: the panel stays active so a sibling [[FocusGuard]] keeps the editor focused while the user presses a control. Add the guard to this object to preserve focus during interaction.

methods.name: Show
methods.summary: Shows the menu at screenPosition, hiding the controls whose item is not applicable (or has no control assigned), and records presenter as the single receiver of invoked actions until the next Show / [[Hide]]. No-op (hides) when no item applies.

methods.name: Hide
methods.summary: Hides the menu and clears the recorded presenter.

methods.name: RequestAction
methods.summary: Routes the invoked command to the presenter recorded by the last [[Show]] — how command items reach it.

properties.name: IsVisible
properties.summary: Whether the menu is currently shown.

types.name: UniTextMagnifier
types.summary: Shipped Unity-UI presentation used by [[PrefabMagnifier]]: a rectangular panel showing a zoomed capture of the canvas around the focal point, re-rendered through a secondary camera with a zoomed projection matrix. Assign its prefab inside a [[PrefabMagnifier]] entity; the panel lives in a canvas-level overlay container so the field's RectMask2D never clips it.
types.remarks: Capture requires a canvas camera: Built-in RP renders via [[Render]]; URP / HDRP go through RenderPipeline.SubmitRenderRequest with a StandardRequest (2023.1+ — [[Render]] is unsupported under any SRP). When capture is impossible the magnifier stays hidden rather than showing an opaque blank panel: silently on Screen Space - Overlay canvases (no camera), with a one-time informational log on an SRP without the render-request API.

properties.name: MagnifierWidth
properties.summary: Loupe width in density-independent pixels.
attributes: Tooltip("Loupe panel width in dp (density-independent pixels).")

properties.name: MagnifierHeight
properties.summary: Loupe height in density-independent pixels.
attributes: Tooltip("Loupe panel height in dp (density-independent pixels).")

properties.name: VerticalOffset
properties.summary: Vertical lift above the focal point in density-independent pixels.
attributes: Tooltip("Vertical lift above the focal point in dp — keeps the loupe clear of the finger.")

properties.name: ZoomFactor
properties.summary: Magnification applied to the captured region.

properties.name: BorderColor
properties.summary: Colour of the loupe frame.

properties.name: BackgroundColor
properties.summary: Colour behind the captured image and capture clear colour.
attributes: Tooltip("Fill behind the captured image; also the capture clear color.")

properties.name: BorderWidth
properties.summary: Frame thickness in density-independent pixels.

types.name: UniTextSelectable
types.summary: Selection capability for [[UniTextBase]]: caret + range state with explicit affinity, gesture interpretation (multi-click promotion, drag-to-select, word-by-word drag, context-menu coordination), and highlight rendering. Sits on the same GameObject as [[UniTextBase]]; requires an existing [[UniText]] or [[UniTextWorld]] — [[RequireComponent]] validates the dependency but cannot auto-add the abstract base, so add the text component first.
types.remarks: First-class component, not a modifier. The misuse pattern (selection-as-Style, empty OnApply) is gone — selection is a component-level capability with its own lifecycle, distinct from text-range markup. Add this component for read-only selectable text; combine with UniTextEditable for editable input. See Component Composition Model in the roadmap (D-008, D-011). This component owns the uGUI drag surface for text. Drag policy: mouse / pen drags select; touch drags forward to the enclosing scroll container (the iOS / Android convention — selection on touch starts from long-press or double-tap, never from a plain drag) unless a selection gesture armed word-drag mode or the editing layer claimed touch drags for a focused field. Handles, magnifier, and context menu are owner-aware serialized entities. Their implementations choose the presentation mechanism; the component never instantiates UI itself. Multi-click thresholds default to desktop conventions ([[MultiClickMaxInterval]], [[MultiClickMaxDistance]]). Single = caret, double = word, triple = paragraph. Touch-side multi-tap thresholds (different from desktop) are fed in via DispatchTap / DispatchDoubleTap / DispatchTripleTap by the gesture recogniser, which applies its own timing.

methods.name: SetCaret
methods.summary: Collapses the selection to a single caret at codepointIndex with the given affinity. Out-of-range indices are clamped to [0, codepointCount].

methods.name: SetSelection
methods.summary: Sets both endpoints simultaneously. Out-of-range indices are clamped to [0, codepointCount].

methods.name: ExtendSelection
methods.summary: Moves the focus while keeping the anchor fixed. Used for shift-click and drag extension.

methods.name: DragSelectionHandle
methods.summary: Moves one selection endpoint to codepointIndex with the touch selection-handle contract (iOS / Android): the selection never collapses — when the dragged endpoint lands on the fixed one it is clamped one grapheme cluster away — and dragging past the fixed endpoint is allowed, inverting the anchor / focus orientation (the handles swap roles). draggingAnchor selects which endpoint moves; the other stays fixed.

methods.name: SelectWord
methods.summary: Selects the word containing codepointIndex.

methods.name: SelectLine
methods.summary: Selects the visual (soft-wrapped) line containing codepointIndex. Gesture pipelines use [[SelectParagraph]] for triple-click / triple-tap; this stays for consumers that genuinely want the visual row.

methods.name: SelectParagraph
methods.summary: Selects the paragraph (between hard line breaks) containing codepointIndex.

methods.name: SelectAll
methods.summary: Selects the entire text.

methods.name: ClearSelection
methods.summary: Collapses the selection at the current focus.

methods.name: GetSelectedText
methods.summary: Returns the selected text as a new string. Empty string when collapsed. Reads the editing layer's document when present (authoritative during IME composition and password masking), else the rendered codepoint buffer.

methods.name: ResetGestureState
methods.summary: Resets all transient gesture state. Call on focus loss so a stale click count or drag mode does not bleed into the next focus session.

methods.name: HandlePrimaryClick
methods.summary: Programmatic primary-click driver — runs the same press gesture the pointer pipeline uses ([[HandlePressGesture]]): single places the caret, double selects the word, triple the paragraph; [[Shift]] extends. Affinity defaults downstream — the bounding-box [[TextHitResult]] carries none.

methods.name: DispatchTap
methods.summary: Drives selection from a touch-side single tap (caret placement). Bypasses the desktop multi-click counter so the touch gesture recogniser can apply its own thresholds.

methods.name: DispatchDoubleTap
methods.summary: Drives selection from a touch-side double tap (word selection) and arms [[IsWordDragMode]].

methods.name: DispatchTripleTap
methods.summary: Drives selection from a touch-side triple tap (paragraph / line).

methods.name: BeginDrag
methods.summary: Begins a drag-to-select operation at codepointIndex. When extendOnly is, the existing selection's anchor is preserved (used by long-press → drag flow).

methods.name: UpdateDrag
methods.summary: Updates a drag-in-progress to codepointIndex. In word-drag mode, extends by whole-word boundaries; otherwise extends by single codepoints.

methods.name: EndDrag
methods.summary: Ends an active drag-to-select operation.

methods.name: RequestContextMenu
methods.summary: Shows the assigned [[ContextMenu]] (if any) with this component as the presenter, then raises [[ContextMenuRequested]].

methods.name: DismissContextMenu
methods.summary: Hides the assigned [[ContextMenu]] (if any), then raises [[ContextMenuDismissRequested]].

methods.name: RefreshHighlight
methods.summary: Repaints the highlight rects backing the selection. Called automatically after each selection change and after the host commits a relayout; expose for consumers that reposition the text out-of-band (manual scroll offsets) without changing [[Selection]].

properties.name: SelectionHighlight
properties.summary: Selection highlight presentation emitted through the text component's shared range-decoration host. It uses the same paint, mapping and geometry contract as [[HighlightModifier]].
attributes: Tooltip("Presentation of the live selection highlight.")

properties.name: SelectionHandles
properties.summary: Touch handle entity. It may implement [[ISelectionHandles]], [[IInsertionHandle]], or both; shows no handles. The sibling [[UniTextEditable]], when present, drives it.
attributes: Tooltip("Selection and/or insertion handle entity for touch interaction. Unassigned = no handles.")

properties.name: Magnifier
properties.summary: Touch magnifier entity. The implementation owns how it is presented; shows no magnifier.
attributes: Tooltip("Magnifier entity used during long-press placement and handle dragging. Unassigned = no magnifier.")

properties.name: MultiClickMaxInterval
properties.summary: Maximum interval between consecutive primary clicks for multi-click detection (seconds). Defaults to 0.5 s — the Windows (GetDoubleClickTime) and macOS default. Assign to match a user-configured OS value.

properties.name: MultiClickMaxDistance
properties.summary: Maximum distance between consecutive primary clicks for multi-click detection, in density-independent pixels (Android dp, 160 dpi baseline) — the comparison scales by the display density at use so the physical slop stays constant on high-density displays. Defaults to 8.

properties.name: TextComponent
properties.summary: The display component this selection layer operates over. Same GameObject; lazily resolved via [[GetComponent{T}]] on first access so layout / preferred-height queries from the Unity layout system work identically in edit mode and play mode (the runtime path is the single path — no edit-time branch).

properties.name: Selection
properties.summary: Current selection state (anchor / focus / affinity). Immutable.

properties.name: IsWordDragMode
properties.summary: True while word-by-word drag is active (started by a double-click on text). Drag extension snaps to whole-word boundaries instead of individual codepoints. Read by the touch gesture pipeline to decide whether to start a fresh caret-drag or continue extending the word selection.

properties.name: SelectionChanging
properties.summary: Occurs when [[Selection]] is about to change through any of the public mutators ([[SetCaret]] / [[SetSelection]] / [[ExtendSelection]] / Select* / Click+drag dispatchers). Subscribers may set [[Cancel]] to abort, or assign [[Proposed]] to clamp into a permitted range (P2.A atomic-token boundary, integrator-defined read-only ranges). Side-effect movements driven by text mutation (insert / delete / IME commit / undo) bypass this event by design — they go through an internal non-vetoable path. See [[SelectionChangingArgs]]. Callbacks run by ascending order and equal orders retain subscription order.

properties.name: ContextMenu
properties.summary: Menu entity presented on a context-menu request. It owns its presentation and may use Unity UI, native platform UI, or another mechanism. leaves presentation to [[ContextMenuRequested]] subscribers.
attributes: Tooltip("Context-menu entity. Unassigned = handle ContextMenuRequested externally.")

events.name: SelectionChanged
events.summary: Post-change notification with previous and current state plus a hierarchical UserEvent string. See [[SelectionChangedArgs]] for category strings.

events.name: SelectionDragStarted
events.summary: Occurs when a pointer drag has been routed to selection (mouse / pen always; touch only in an armed selection gesture — see the class drag policy). The event is anchored at the press position, not the position where the drag threshold was crossed. The instance is reused across emissions and [[Hit]] is not computed — hit-test from [[ScreenPosition]].

events.name: ContextMenuRequested
events.summary: Occurs when the user has requested a context menu (right-click, long-press) at a screen position — after the assigned [[ContextMenu]] (if any) is shown. Subscribe to present a custom menu.

events.name: ContextMenuDismissRequested
events.summary: Occurs when an open context menu should hide (drag, scroll, edit, focus loss).

types.name: UniTextSelectionHandles
types.summary: Shipped Unity-UI presentation used by [[PrefabSelectionHandles]]. It instantiates a user-authored prefab for the draggable selection handles (one prefab used for both the anchor and focus carets) and for the collapsed-caret insertion handle, and places each at its caret point. The split of ownership: the prefab owns the look — sprite, colour, material, and the pivot, which alone decides how the handle sits relative to the caret (a teardrop pivots at its tip); the code owns the size, forcing each handle to a square of [[handleSize]] dp so the touch target stays a constant physical size across canvases, resolutions, and densities (a fingertip is device-independent). Put Preserve Aspect on the prefab's Image so its sprite fits that square undistorted. Assign its prefab inside a [[PrefabSelectionHandles]] entity; geometry is pulled from [[ActiveEditor]] at call time, the instances live in a canvas-level overlay so the field's RectMask2D never clips them, and a handle whose caret scrolls outside the field box hides until it returns. A [[SelectionHandleDragger]] (drag routing) and a [[FocusGuard]] (so grabbing a handle never defocuses the field) are ensured on each instance, so the prefab need only carry a raycastable Graphic.

properties.name: HandleSize
properties.summary: Square handle size in density-independent pixels.
attributes:
Tooltip("Handle width/height in dp (density-independent pixels): the code sizes every handle to " +
                 "this square, so the physical size stays constant across canvas scale, resolution, and " +
                 "screen density. Put Preserve Aspect on the prefab's Image to fit the sprite. ~44 dp is a " +
                 "comfortable touch target.")

properties.name: SelectionHandlePrefab
properties.summary: Prefab used for both selection endpoints.
attributes:
Tooltip("Prefab instantiated for both selection handles (anchor + focus). Owns sprite/colour/" +
                 "material and the pivot (which places it relative to the caret — no code offset). Its " +
                 "size is overridden to the Handle Size square. Must carry a raycastable Graphic. " +
                 "Unassigned = no selection handles.")

properties.name: InsertionHandlePrefab
properties.summary: Prefab used for the collapsed-caret insertion handle.
attributes:
Tooltip("Prefab instantiated for the collapsed-caret insertion handle. Same contract as the " +
                 "selection prefab. Unassigned = no insertion handle.")

types.name: ParameterAttribute
types.summary: Marks a serialized field as positional parameter metadata: its C# type, declaration order, name, and initializer drive the editor schema and runtime fallback.
types.remarks: The runtime never reflects. Its ParameterReader read order MUST match the reflected declaration order: own-type fields first, then inherited base-type fields.

properties.name: Operations

types.name: ParameterContainerAttribute

properties.name: Invalidate

types.name: SlotlessParameterAttribute
types.summary: Marks a state field as a parameter with no markup presence: it joins the modifier's generated parameter surface — cascade, ownership, effects — without occupying a positional markup slot.

types.name: UnicodeScript
types.summary: Unicode Script property values (UAX #24).
types.remarks: Each codepoint belongs to exactly one script. Used by [[ScriptAnalyzer]] to segment text into runs of uniform script for shaping. Some scripts like [[Common]] (punctuation) and [[Inherited]] (combining marks) can appear in text of any script.

fields.name: Unknown

types.name: UnitAttribute

Each entry is one of px, abs, %, em, delta, optionally with a slider range — em(0,4) for floats, abs[1,1000] for integers. The field's own value carries the authored default unit; this only sets which units the dropdown lists.

types.name: VariantAttribute

types.name: WordSegmentationDictionary
types.summary: Self-contained dictionary asset for word segmentation of a specific script.
types.remarks: Each asset holds a compiled Unicode trie and the target Unicode script. Add to UniText Settings to enable word segmentation for that script. Create via Tools → UniText → Tools → Dictionary Builder tab.

properties.name: Script
properties.summary: The Unicode script inferred from the dictionary contents.

properties.name: IsValid
properties.summary: Returns true if the compiled trie and inferred target script are valid.
